mentions.name: abacavir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro experiments reveal that abacavir does not inhibit human CYP3A4, CYP2D6, or CYP2C9 activity at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: abemaciclib
mentions.excerpt: CYP Metabolic Pathways: In a clinical drug interaction study in patients with cancer, multiple doses of abemaciclib (200 mg twice daily for 7 days) did not result in clinically meaningful changes in the pharmacokinetics of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 substrates.

mentions.name: abiraterone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 and SULT2A1 are the enzymes involved in the formation of N-oxide abiraterone sulphate and SULT2A1 is involved in the formation of abiraterone sulphate.

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism The metabolism of abrocitinib is mediated by multiple CYP enzymes, CYP2C19 (~53%), CYP2C9 (~30%), CYP3A4 (~11%) and CYP2B6 (~6%).

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Acalabrutinib is an inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9, but not CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: acoramidis
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Acoramidis is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP2C9, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: adagrasib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Adagrasib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 following single dose administration.

mentions.name: adefovir dipivoxil
mentions.excerpt: At concentrations substantially higher (greater than 4000-fold) than those observed in vivo , adefovir did not inhibit any of the common human CYP450 enzymes, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ado trastuzumab emtansine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies indicate that DM1, the small molecule component of KADCYLA, undergoes metabolism by CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: afatinib
mentions.excerpt: Approximately 2% of the afatinib dose was metabolized by FMO3; the CYP3A4-dependent N-demethylation was not detected.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP enzymes: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Alectinib is metabolized by CYP3A4 to its major active metabolite M4.

mentions.name: alfuzosin
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is the principal hepatic enzyme isoform involved in its metabolism.

mentions.name: alirocumab
mentions.excerpt: In clinical studies where alirocumab was administered in combination with atorvastatin or rosuvastatin, no relevant changes in statin concentrations were observed in the presence of repeated administration of alirocumab, indicating that cytochrome P450 enzymes (mainly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9) and transporter proteins such as P-gp and OATP were not affected by alirocumab.

mentions.name: aliskiren
mentions.excerpt: Based on the in vitro studies, the major enzyme responsible for aliskiren metabolism appears to be CYP3A4.

mentions.name: almotriptan
mentions.excerpt: Verapamil Co-administration of almotriptan and verapamil (120 mg sustained-release tablets twice daily for 7 days), an inhibitor of CYP3A4, resulted in a 20% increase in the area under the plasma concentration-time curve, and in a 24% increase in maximal plasma concentrations of almotriptan.

mentions.name: alogliptin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate that CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 contribute to the limited metabolism of alogliptin.

mentions.name: alpelisib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Alpelisib is primarily metabolized by chemical and enzymatic hydrolysis to form its metabolite BZG791 and followed by CYP3A4 mediated hydroxylation.

mentions.name: alprazolam
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Alprazolam is extensively metabolized in humans, primarily by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4), to 2 major active metabolites in the plasma: 4-hydroxyalprazolam and α-hydroxyalprazolam.

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450-Related Metabolism In vitro , amisulpride did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4, or induce CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: The CL/F of apalutamide is 1.3 L/h after single dosing and increases to 2.0 L/h at steady-state after once-daily dosing likely due to CYP3A4 auto-induction.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , CYP metabolism of apremilast is primarily mediated by CYP3A4, with minor contributions from CYP1A2 and CYP2A6.

mentions.name: aprepitant
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that aprepitant is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 with minor metabolism by CYP1A2 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Informed Approaches No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with aprocitentan: midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), rosuvastatin (breast cancer resistance protein [BCRP] substrate) or combined oral contraceptive (ethinyl estradiol and levonorgestrel).

mentions.name: arformoterol
mentions.excerpt: Arformoterol did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A9/11 enzymes at >1,000-fold higher concentrations than the expected peak plasma concentrations following a therapeutic dose.

mentions.name: argatroban
mentions.excerpt: The formation of each of the 4 known metabolites is catalyzed in vitro by the human liver microsomal cytochrome P450 enzymes CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: aripiprazole lauroxil
mentions.excerpt: Elimination of aripiprazole is mainly through hepatic metabolism involving CYP3A4 and CYP2D6. [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.4 )].

mentions.name: armodafinil
mentions.excerpt: However, due to the partial involvement of CYP3A enzymes in the metabolic elimination of armodafinil, coadministration of potent inducers of CYP3A4/5 (e.g., carbamazepine, phenobarbital, rifampin) or inhibitors of CYP3A4/5 (e.g., ketoconazole, erythromycin) could alter the plasma concentrations of armodafinil.

mentions.name: asciminib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Asciminib is metabolized by CYP3A4-mediated oxidation, UGT2B7- and UGT2B17-mediated glucuronidation.

mentions.name: asenapine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that asenapine is a substrate for UGT1A4, CYP1A2 and to a lesser extent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: atogepant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Atogepant is eliminated mainly through metabolism, primarily by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), losartan (CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 substrate) or fexofenadine (P-gp substrate) were observed or expected when used concomitantly with VANRAFIA.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism CYP3A4 is the major enzyme responsible for the clearance of avacopan and for the formation and clearance of the major circulating metabolite M1, a mono-hydroxylated product of avacopan.

mentions.name: avanafil
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Excretion Avanafil is cleared predominantly by hepatic metabolism, mainly by the CYP3A4 enzyme and to a minor extent by CYP2C isoform.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avapritinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, CYP3A5 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 in vitro.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avatrombopag is primarily metabolized by cytochrome P450 CYP2C9 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avutometinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and nonenzymatic degradation.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: Axitinib is metabolized primarily in the liver by CYP3A4/5 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and UGT1A1.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when coadministered with baloxavir marboxil: midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), digoxin (P-gp substrate), rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate), or oseltamivir.

mentions.name: balsalazide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Data In an in vitro study using human liver microsomes, balsalazide and its metabolites [5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA), Nacetyl-5-aminosalicylic acid (N-Ac-5-ASA), 4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (4-ABA) and N-acetyl-4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (N-Ac-4-ABA)] were not shown to inhibit the major CYP enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism – Approximately 6% of the orally administered baricitinib dose is identified as metabolites (three from urine and one from feces), with CYP3A4 identified as the main metabolizing enzyme.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Baxdrostat is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 to an intermediate ketone metabolite, which is further metabolized by CBR1 (carbonyl reductase 1) to an alcohol metabolite (M2).

mentions.name: bedaquiline
mentions.excerpt: Apparent clearance of bedaquiline 2.62 L/h Apparent clearance of M2 4.95 L/h Terminal half-life ~ 5.5 months for both bedaquiline and N monodesmethyl metabolite (M2) Metabolism Metabolized to the M2 by CYP3A4;

mentions.name: belinostat
mentions.excerpt: Belinostat also undergoes hepatic metabolism by CYP2A6, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Belzutifan is primarily metabolized by UGT2B17 and CYP2C19 and to a lesser extent by CYP3A4 [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.5) ] .

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: benzgalantamine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Based on in vitro studies, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 were the major enzymes involved in the metabolism of galantamine.

mentions.name: bepotastine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that bepotastine besilate does not inhibit the metabolism of various cytochrome P450 substrates via inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: bepotastine besilate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that bepotastine besilate does not inhibit the metabolism of various cytochrome P450 substrates via inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: berotralstat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Berotralstat is metabolized by CYP2D6 and by CYP3A4 with low turnover in vitro .

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Effect of Other Drugs on Bexarotene CYP3A4 Inhibitors/Inducers: In a clinical study, concomitant administration of multiple doses of ketoconazole with bexarotene did not alter bexarotene plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: binimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Binimetinib on CYP Substrates : Binimetinib did not alter the exposure of a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate (midazolam).

mentions.name: bortezomib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant differences in bortezomib pharmacokinetics were observed when coadministered with dexamethasone (weak CYP3A4 inducer), omeprazole (strong CYP2C19 inhibitor), or melphalan in combination with prednisone.

mentions.name: bosutinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Bosutinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Informed Approaches Strong CYP3A4 and P-gp Inhibitors : Brensocatib C max increased by 68% and AUC increased by 55% following concomitant administration with clarithromycin (a strong CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibitor) 500 mg twice daily for 6 days.

mentions.name: brentuximab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate that the MMAE metabolism that occurs is primarily via oxidation by CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: brexpiprazole
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Based on in vitro metabolism studies of brexpiprazole using recombinant human cytochrome P450 (CYP1A1, 1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 3A4), the metabolism of brexpiprazole was shown to be mainly mediated by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Brigatinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: brodalumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In subjects with plaque psoriasis, one week following a single subcutaneous administration of 210 mg brodalumab, the exposure of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) was increased by 24% [see Drug Interactions ( 7 )].

mentions.name: bromocriptine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Inhibitors and/or potent substrates for CYP3A4 might inhibit the clearance of bromocriptine and lead to increased bromocriptine levels [see Drug Interactions (( 7 )].

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabazitaxel
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cabazitaxel is extensively metabolized in the liver (>95%), mainly by the CYP3A4/5 isoenzyme (80% to 90%), and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8.

mentions.name: cabotegravir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, cabotegravir did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4. ‎ Simulations using PBPK modeling show that no clinically significant interaction is expected during coadministration of cabotegravir with drugs that inhibit UGT1A1.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cabozantinib is a substrate of CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cabozantinib is a substrate of CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: canagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4-mediated (oxidative) metabolism of canagliflozin is minimal (approximately 7%) in humans.

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cannabidiol is metabolized in the liver and the gut (primarily in the liver) by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 enzymes, and UGT1A7, UGT1A9, and UGT2B7 isoforms.

mentions.name: capecitabine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Capecitabine and its metabolites (5’-DFUR, 5’-DFCR, fluorouracil, and FBAL) did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: capivasertib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Capivasertib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and UGT2B7.

mentions.name: capmatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Capmatinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and aldehyde oxidase.

mentions.name: carfilzomib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Carfilzomib on Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Carfilzomib showed direct and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A but did not induce CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Cariprazine is extensively metabolized by CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, by CYP2D6 to DCAR and DDCAR.

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen was a potential inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19 in vitro ; however, considering its short plasma half-life and lack of plasma accumulation with the weekly dosing regimen, clinical drug interaction with substrates for these enzymes is unlikely.

mentions.name: caspofungin
mentions.excerpt: In clinical studies, caspofungin did not induce the CYP3A4 metabolism of other drugs.

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: The primary metabolic pathways are by glucuronidation via UGT2B7 and to a lesser extent by UGT2B4, and by oxidation via CYP2E1, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: chenodiol
mentions.excerpt: Chenodiol and its tauro- conjugate may upregulate CYP3A4 mRNA in vitro.

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: cilostazol
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, the primary isoenzymes involved in cilostazol’s metabolism are CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C19.

mentions.name: cinacalcet
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Excretion Cinacalcet is metabolized by multiple enzymes, primarily CYP3A4, CYP2D6, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: citalopram
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicated that CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 are the primary isozymes involved in the N-demethylation of citalopram.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: The major metabolic pathway of clobazam involves N-demethylation, primarily by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: clofazimine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Clofazimine inhibits the metabolism of CYP2C8, CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5 drug substrates.

mentions.name: clozapine
mentions.excerpt: Clozapine is a substrate for many cytochrome P450 isozymes, in particular CYP1A2, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cocaine
mentions.excerpt: Cocaine is N-demethylated by the CYP3A4 enzyme system to produce the active metabolite, norcocaine.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes have shown that CYP3A4 is involved in the metabolism of colchicine to 2-and 3-DMC.

mentions.name: crofelemer
mentions.excerpt: Midazolam In vitro studies have shown that crofelemer has the potential to inhibit CYP3A4 enzymes at concentrations expected in the gut.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dabigatran etexilate
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Dabigatran on Other Drugs In clinical studies exploring CYP3A4, CYP2C9, P-gp and other pathways, dabigatran did not meaningfully alter the pharmacokinetics of amiodarone, atorvastatin, clarithromycin, diclofenac, clopidogrel, digoxin, pantoprazole, or ranitidine. dabigartanfigure31 dabigartanfigure32

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism The metabolism of dabrafenib is primarily mediated by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 to form hydroxy-dabrafenib.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicated that cytochrome P450 (CYP) 2D6 was the major isozyme involved in the formation of O-desmethyl dacomitinib, while CYP3A4 contributed to the formation of other minor oxidative metabolites.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Dalfampridine on Co-administered Drugs In vitro data with human liver microsomes showed that dalfampridine was not a direct or time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Effect of Danicopan on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs: Dedicated clinical drug interaction studies showed no clinically significant drug interactions with danicopan as an inhibitor or inducer of CYP2B6 (bupropion), CYP2C9 (warfarin), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP3A4 (midazolam), and UGT1A1 and UGT2B7 (mycophenolic acid).

mentions.name: daprodustat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: In vitro, daprodustat is primarily metabolized by CYP2C8 (95% contribution), with a minor contribution by CYP3A4 (5%).

mentions.name: daridorexant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Daridorexant undergoes extensive metabolism and is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 (89%).

mentions.name: darifenacin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism is mediated by cytochrome P450 enzymes CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: darolutamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Darolutamide is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, as well as by UGT1A9 and UGT1A1.

mentions.name: dasatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dasatinib is metabolized in humans, primarily by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, DXd is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan dlnk
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, DXd is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: defactinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avutometinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and nonenzymatic degradation.

mentions.name: deferasirox
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Midazolam : In healthy volunteers, the concomitant administration of deferasirox and midazolam (a CYP3A4 probe substrate) resulted in a decrease of midazolam peak concentration by 23% and exposure by 17%.

mentions.name: deflazacort
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Deflazacort is rapidly converted to the active metabolite 21-desDFZ by esterases after oral administration. 21-desDFZ is further metabolized by CYP3A4 to several other inactive metabolites, including 6β-hydroxy-21-desacetyl deflazacort.

mentions.name: delafloxacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Delafloxacin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit the cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 in vitro in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: delgocitinib
mentions.excerpt: The limited metabolism of delgocitinib occurs primarily though CYP3A4/5 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A1, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: denosumab
mentions.excerpt: Denosumab did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, which is metabolized by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.excerpt: Denosumab did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, which is metabolized by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.excerpt: Denosumab did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, which is metabolized by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.excerpt: Denosumab did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, which is metabolized by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.name: denosumab qbde
mentions.excerpt: Denosumab did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam, which is metabolized by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.name: desvenlafaxine
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 mediates the oxidative metabolism (N-demethylation) of desvenlafaxine.

mentions.name: deucravacitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Deucravacitinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: deuruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Deuruxolitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 (76%) and CYP3A4 (21%) and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 (3%).

mentions.name: deutetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro experiments in human liver microsomes demonstrate that deutetrabenazine is extensively biotransformed, mainly by carbonyl reductase, to its major active metabolites, α-HTBZ and β-HTBZ, which are subsequently metabolized primarily by CYP2D6, with minor contributions of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4/5, to form several minor metabolites.

mentions.name: dexlansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: Oxidative metabolites are formed by the cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzyme system including hydroxylation mainly by CYP2C19, and oxidation to the sulfone by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: diazepam
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Elimination In vitro studies using human liver preparations suggest that CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 are the principal isozymes involved in the initial oxidative metabolism of diazepam.

mentions.name: diazoxide choline
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Diazoxide is mainly metabolized by CYP1A2 and to a minor extent by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: dichlorphenamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dichlorphenamide is not a substrate for CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 isoforms when tested in vitro .

mentions.name: diclofenac epolamine
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is responsible for the formation of minor metabolites, 5-hydroxy and 3'-hydroxy- diclofenac.

mentions.name: dienogest
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 was identified as a predominant enzyme catalyzing the metabolism of dienogest.

mentions.name: difamilast
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Difamilast is substantially metabolized to form three major metabolites in the plasma via CYP3A4-mediated O-deethylation (Metabolite 1), CYP1A2-mediated hydroxylation (Metabolite 2), and enzymatic hydrolysis (Metabolite 3).

mentions.name: diltiazem hcl
mentions.excerpt: The risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis with statins metabolized by CYP3A4 may be increased with concomitant use of diltiazem.

mentions.name: diroximel
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies found diroximel fumarate and its metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 enzymes in human liver microsomes or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4/5 in cultured human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: docetaxel
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Docetaxel is metabolized by the CYP3A4 isoenzyme in vitro [ see Drug Interactions (7) ].

mentions.name: dofetilide
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with human liver microsomes show that dofetilide can be metabolized by CYP3A4, but it has a low affinity for this isoenzyme.

mentions.name: donidalorsen
mentions.excerpt: The most abundant linker-related metabolite (M8) is a substrate of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: dordaviprone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dordaviprone is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 with minor contribution from CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: dronabinol
mentions.excerpt: Published in vitro data indicates that CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 are the primary enzymes in the metabolism of dronabinol.

mentions.name: drospirenone
mentions.excerpt: Drospirenone is also subject to oxidative metabolism catalyzed by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: dutasteride
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that dutasteride is metabolized by the CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 isoenzymes.

mentions.name: duvelisib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Duvelisib is primarily metabolized by cytochrome P450 CYP3A4.

mentions.name: edoxaban
mentions.excerpt: There is minimal metabolism via hydrolysis (mediated by carboxylesterase 1), conjugation, and oxidation by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: efinaconazole
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies using human liver microsomes, efinaconazole did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2PE1 and CYP3A4 enzyme activities at expected clinical systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: elacestrant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Elacestrant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2A6 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: elafibranor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Effect of IQIRVO on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro Studies: Elafibranor, GFT1007 and GFT3351 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: elamipretide
mentions.excerpt: Elamipretide does not induce metabolism by CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eletriptan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that eletriptan is primarily metabolized by cytochrome P-450 enzyme CYP3A4 [see Contraindications ( 4 ) and Drug Interactions ( 7.2 )] .

mentions.name: elexacaftor ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Elexacaftor, Tezacaftor and/or Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Based on in vitro results, elexacaftor and tezacaftor have a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, whereas ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: eliglustat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism CERDELGA is primarily metabolized by CYP2D6 and to a lesser extent by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: elinzanetant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Elinzanetant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 to yield three major active metabolites, M18/21, M27, and M30/34.

mentions.name: eltrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Eltrombopag on Other Drugs Effect of Eltrombopag on Cytochrome P450 Enzymes Substrates: The coadministration of multiple doses of eltrombopag (once daily for 7 days) did not result in the inhibition or induction of the metabolism of a combination of probe substrates for CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) in humans.

mentions.name: eltrombopag choline
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Eltrombopag on Other Drugs Effect of Eltrombopag on Cytochrome P450 Enzymes Substrates: The coadministration of multiple doses of eltrombopag (once daily for 7 days) did not result in the inhibition or induction of the metabolism of a combination of probe substrates for CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) in humans.

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate that eluxadoline is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: emtricitabine
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations up to 14-fold higher than those observed in vivo, FTC did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: enasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of enasidenib is mediated by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4), and by multiple UDP glucuronosyl transferases (UGTs) (e.g., UGT1A1, UGT1A3, UGT1A4, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, and UGT2B15) in vitro.

mentions.name: encorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Encorafenib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 (83%) and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 (16%) and CYP2D6 (1%).

mentions.name: enfortumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: The ADC releases MMAE via proteolytic cleavage, and unconjugated MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: ensifentrine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of OHTUVAYRE on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies Ensifentrine and Cytochrome P450 : At therapeutically relevant concentrations, ensifentrine does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ensitrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Moderate CYP3A4 Inducers : Ensitrelvir AUC is predicted to decrease by approximately 28% following concomitant administration with efavirenz (moderate CYP3A4 inducer) and 10% with bosentan (moderate CYP3A4 inducer) [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: entrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Entrectinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 (~76%).

mentions.name: enzalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Enzalutamide is metabolized by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eplerenone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Excretion Eplerenone metabolism is primarily mediated via CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eravacycline
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Eravacycline is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4- and FMO-mediated oxidation.

mentions.name: erdafitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Erdafitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eribulin
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) negligibly metabolizes eribulin in vitro .

mentions.name: erlotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Erlotinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, and the extrahepatic isoform CYP1A1, in vitro .

mentions.name: esketamine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Esketamine is primarily metabolized to noresketamine metabolite via cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: eslicarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies in human liver microsomes, eslicarbazepine had no clinically relevant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4, and only a moderate inhibitory effect on CYP2C19.

mentions.name: esomeprazole strontium
mentions.excerpt: The remaining amount is dependent on CYP3A4 which forms the sulphone metabolite.

mentions.name: estetrol
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies show that UGT2B7 is the dominant UGT isoform that catalyzes the formation of E4-16-glucuronide CYP3A4; two main metabolites: acid form of DRSP generated by opening of lactone ring and the 4,5-dihydrodrospirenone formed by reduction followed by sulfation.

mentions.name: estradiol cypionate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro and in vivo studies have shown that estrogens are metabolized partially by cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.name: eszopiclone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that CYP3A4 and CYP2E1 enzymes are involved in the metabolism of eszopiclone.

mentions.name: eteplirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data showed that eteplirsen did not significantly inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: etrasimod arginine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Etrasimod is metabolized by oxidation and dehydrogenation mediated primarily by CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4, with a minor contribution by CYP2C19 and CYP2J2.

mentions.name: etripamil
mentions.excerpt: Etripamil is primarily metabolized by blood esterases and hepatic metabolism, primarily via CYP3A4, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: everolimus
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Everolimus is a substrate of CYP3A4 and P-gp.

mentions.name: fam trastuzumab deruxtecan nxki
mentions.excerpt: DXd is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: fedratinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Fedratinib is metabolized by CYP3A4, CYP2C19, and flavin-containing monooxygenase 3 (FMO3).

mentions.name: fenfluramine
mentions.excerpt: Other CYP enzymes involved to a minor extent are CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibrate and fenofibric acid are not inhibitors of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fenofibric acid
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fentanyl
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies CYP3A4 Inhibitors Fentanyl is metabolized mainly via the human cytochrome P450 3A4 isoenzyme system (CYP3A4).

mentions.name: fesoterodine
mentions.excerpt: The active metabolite is further metabolized in the liver to its carboxy, carboxy-N-desisopropyl, and N-desisopropyl metabolites via two major pathways involving CYP2D6 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: fexinidazole
mentions.excerpt: NA 1.39 (0–4.5) 6.45 (0.3–14.9) Mean (Range) CSF to DBS Ratios NA 0.53 (0.1–2.2) 0.36 (0.1–0.8) Elimination Mean (±SD) Day 10 Half-life, hours 15 (±6) 16 (±6) 23 (±4) Mean (±SD) Apparent Clearance on Day 4, L/hour 161 (±37) NA NA Metabolism Fexinidazole Fexinidazole is metabolized to M1 by several CYP450 enzymes, including CYP3A4 and flavin monooxygenases.

mentions.name: fezolinetant
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Fezolinetant and ES259564 are not inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: fidaxomicin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vivo studies were conducted to evaluate intestinal drug-drug interactions of fidaxomicin as a P-gp substrate, P-gp inhibitor, and inhibitor of major CYP enzymes expressed in the gastrointestinal tract (CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19).

mentions.name: finerenone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Finerenone is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 (90%) and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8 (10%) to inactive metabolites.

mentions.name: fingolimod
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in hepatocytes indicated that CYP3A4 may contribute to fingolimod metabolism in the case of strong induction of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: fingolimod lauryl
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in hepatocytes indicated that CYP3A4 may contribute to fingolimod metabolism in the case of strong induction of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: flibanserin
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Flibanserin is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, by CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fluvastatin
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 isoenzyme is primarily involved in the metabolism of fluvastatin (approximately 75%), while CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 isoenzymes are involved to a much less extent, i.e., approximately 5% and approximately 20%, respectively.

mentions.name: fosamprenavir
mentions.excerpt: Amprenavir is metabolized in the liver by the CYP3A4 enzyme system.

mentions.name: fosaprepitant dimeglumine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that aprepitant is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 with minor metabolism by CYP1A2 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fosdenopterin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Fosdenopterin does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fosfomycin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Fosfomycin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fostamatinib
mentions.excerpt: R406 is extensively metabolized, primarily through pathways of CYP450-mediated oxidation (by CYP3A4) and glucuronidation (by UDP glucuronosyltransferase [UGT]1A9).

mentions.name: gabapentin enacarbil
mentions.excerpt: Neither gabapentin enacarbil nor gabapentin are substrates, inhibitors, or inducers of the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: galantamine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that cytochrome CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 were the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes involved in the metabolism of galantamine, and inhibitors of both pathways increase oral bioavailability of galantamine modestly.

mentions.name: ganaxolone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Ganaxolone is metabolized by CYP3A4/5, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, UGT1A3, UGT1A6, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, and UGT2B15.

mentions.name: gefitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Elimination Gefitinib undergoes extensive hepatic metabolism in humans, predominantly by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: gemtuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies At clinically relevant concentrations, gemtuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: gepirone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is the primary enzyme catalyzing the metabolism of EXXUA to its major pharmacologically active metabolites.

mentions.name: gepotidacin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of CYP3A4 Strong Inducers on the Pharmacokinetics of Gepotidacin: Concomitant administration of BLUJEPA (single 1,500 mg dose) with a strong CYP3A4 inducer (rifampin; 600 mg once daily for 7 days) resulted in a decrease of 52% in gepotidacin plasma AUC (0-∞) [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )].

mentions.name: gilteritinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Gilteritinib is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: givinostat
mentions.excerpt: Givinostat showed induction of CYP1A2, 2B6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: givosiran
mentions.excerpt: Effect of givosiran on other CYP450 Substrates: Concomitant use of a single subcutaneous dose of givosiran 2.5 mg/kg increased losartan (CYP2C9 substrate) AUC by 1.1-fold with no change in C max ; increased omeprazole (sensitive CYP2C19 substrate) AUC by 1.6-fold and C max by 1.1-fold; increased midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate) AUC by 1.5-fold and C max by 1.2-fold.

mentions.name: glasdegib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Glasdegib is primarily metabolized by the CYP3A4 pathway, with minor contributions by CYP2C8 and UGT1A9.

mentions.name: glycerol phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, PBA at a concentration of 800 micrograms/mL caused greater than 60% reversible inhibition of cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 (testosterone 6β-hydroxylase activity).

mentions.name: golodirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Golodirsen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5 in vitro .

mentions.name: gozetotide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP450 enzymes Gozetotide is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: guanfacine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with human liver microsomes and recombinant CYP's demonstrated that guanfacine was primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: guselkumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates The effects of guselkumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (metabolized by CYP3A4), warfarin (metabolized by CYP2C9), omeprazole (metabolized by CYP2C19), dextromethorphan (metabolized by CYP2D6), and caffeine (metabolized by CYP1A2) were evaluated in an exploratory study with 6 to 12 evaluable subjects with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.

mentions.name: haloperidol decanoate
mentions.excerpt: The cytochrome P450 enzyme system is also involved, particularly CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2D6.

mentions.name: hydrocodone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 mediated N -demethylation to inactive norhydrocodone is the primary metabolic pathway of hydrocodone with a lower contribution from CYP2B6 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: hydroxyprogesterone caproate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate that the metabolism of hydroxyprogesterone caproate is predominantly mediated by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: iberdomide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Iberdomide does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: icotrokinra
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Icotrokinra does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: iloperidone
mentions.excerpt: Iloperidone is metabolized primarily by 3 biotransformation pathways: carbonyl reduction, hydroxylation (mediated by CYP2D6) and O-demethylation (mediated by CYP3A4).

mentions.name: imatinib
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism CYP3A4 is the major enzyme responsible for metabolism of imatinib.

mentions.name: imlunestrant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Imlunestrant is metabolized by sulfation, CYP3A4, and direct glucuronidation (UGT1A1, 1A3, 1A8, 1A9, 1A10).

mentions.name: inotuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, inotuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5. • Induce CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: irbesartan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate irbesartan is oxidized primarily by CYP2C9; metabolism by CYP3A4 is negligible.

mentions.name: irinotecan
mentions.excerpt: Irinotecan can also undergo CYP3A4-mediated oxidative metabolism to several inactive metabolites, one of which can be hydrolyzed by carboxylesterase to release the active metabolite SN-38.

mentions.name: isavuconazonium
mentions.excerpt: In vivo studies indicate that CYP3A4, CYP3A5 and subsequently uridine diphosphate-glucuronosyltransferases (UGT) are involved in the metabolism of isavuconazole.

mentions.name: istradefylline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that istradefylline is primarily metabolized via CYP1A1 and CYP3A4, with minor contribution from CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, and 2D6.

mentions.name: itraconazole
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that CYP3A4 is the major enzyme involved in the metabolism of itraconazole.

mentions.name: ivacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Figure 1 Potential for Other Drugs to Affect Ivacaftor In vitro studies showed that ivacaftor and metabolite M1 were substrates of CYP3A enzymes (i.e., CYP3A4 and CYP3A5).

mentions.name: ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data suggested that tezacaftor is metabolized mainly by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: ivermectin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies using human hepatic microsomes and recombinant CYP450 enzymes have shown that ivermectin is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ivosidenib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Based Approaches Effect of Strong or Moderate CYP3A4 Inhibitors on Ivosidenib Co-administration of 250 mg ivosidenib with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (200 mg itraconazole once daily for 18 days) increased ivosidenib single-dose AUC by 269% (90% CI: 245%, 295%) with no change in C max in healthy subjects .

mentions.name: ixabepilone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Ixabepilone is metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ixazomib
mentions.excerpt: Ixazomib did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4/5 activity or corresponding immunoreactive protein levels.

mentions.name: ketamine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Ketamine is metabolized via N-dealkylation to the active metabolite norketamine primarily by CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by other CYP enzymes.

mentions.name: lacosamide
mentions.excerpt: The CYP isoforms mainly responsible for the formation of the major metabolite (O-desmethyl) are CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: lansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on Lansoprazole Because lansoprazole is metabolized by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, inducers and inhibitors of these enzymes may potentially alter exposure of lansoprazole.

mentions.name: lanthanum carbonate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Lanthanum carbonate has a low potential for systemic drug-drug interactions because of the very low bioavailability of lanthanum and because it is not a substrate or inhibitor of major cytochrome P450 enzyme groups involved in drug metabolism (CYP1A2, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: lapatinib ditosylate
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism : Lapatinib undergoes extensive metabolism, primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5, with minor contributions from CYP2C19 and CYP2C8 to a variety of oxidated metabolites, none of which accounts for more than 14% of the dose recovered in the feces or 10% of lapatinib concentration in plasma.

mentions.name: larotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Larotrectinib is metabolized predominantly by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lazertinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Lazertinib is primarily metabolized by glutathione conjugation, either enzymatic via glutathione-S-transferase (GST) or non-enzymatic, as well as by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lemborexant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Lemborexant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, and to a lesser extent by CYP3A5.

mentions.name: leniolisib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Leniolisib was 60% metabolized by the liver, with CYP3A4 being the most predominant enzyme involved (95.4%) in the primary oxidative metabolism of leniolisib with minor contribution from other enzymes (3.5% CYP3A5, 0.7% CYP1A2 and 0.4% CYP2D6).

mentions.name: lenvatinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 Substrate : Co-administration of lenvatinib with midazolam had no effect on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam.

mentions.name: letrozole
mentions.excerpt: In human microsomes with specific CYP isozyme activity, CYP3A4 metabolized letrozole to the carbinol metabolite while CYP2A6 formed both this metabolite and its ketone analog.

mentions.name: levocetirizine
mentions.excerpt: Dealkylation pathways are primarily mediated by CYP3A4 while aromatic oxidation involves multiple and/or unidentified CYP isoforms.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is the major enzyme involved in the metabolism of ketoconazole.

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: The desethylation is catalyzed primarily by CYP3A4 with minor contribution by CYP2C8, 2C19, 2D6, and 2J2.

mentions.name: levonorgestrel
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is the main enzyme involved in the oxidative metabolism of LNG.

mentions.name: linagliptin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions Linagliptin is a weak to moderate inhibitor of CYP isozyme CYP3A4, but does not inhibit other CYP isozymes and is not an inducer of CYP isozymes, including CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 4A11.

mentions.name: linerixibat
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, linerixibat did not inhibit cytochrome P450 (CYP)s 1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 2E1, but was an inhibitor of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lomitapide
mentions.excerpt: Lomitapide inhibits CYP3A4.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl
mentions.excerpt: The small molecule cytotoxin, SG3199, is metabolized by CYP3A4/5 in vitro.

mentions.name: loperamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro loperamide is metabolized mainly by cytochrome P450 (CYP450) isozymes, CYP2C8 and CYP3A4, to form- N-demethyl loperamide.

mentions.name: lorlatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Lorlatinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and UGT1A4, with minor contribution from CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP3A5, and UGT1A3.

mentions.name: lovastatin
mentions.excerpt: The increase in AUC for lovastatin and lovastatin acid is presumably due, in part, to inhibition of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: loxapine
mentions.excerpt: The main metabolic pathways include: 1) hydroxylation to form 8-OH-loxapine by CYP1A2 and 7-OH-loxapine by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, 2) N-oxidation to form loxapine N-oxide by flavanoid monoamine oxidases (FMOs), and 3) de-methylation to form amoxapine.

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 substrates : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) or its metabolite 1-hydroxymidazolam were observed when used concomitantly with single or multiple doses of lumateperone in patients with schizophrenia.

mentions.name: lurasidone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Elimination: Lurasidone hydrochloride is metabolized mainly via CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lurbinectedin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes : Lurbinectedin is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lusutrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : lusutrombopag has low potential to inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: macimorelin
mentions.excerpt: Elimination An in vitro human liver microsomes study showed that CYP3A4 is the major enzyme to metabolize macimorelin.

mentions.name: macitentan
mentions.excerpt: This reaction is dependent on the cytochrome P450 (CYP) system, mainly CYP3A4 with minor contributions of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: maralixibat
mentions.excerpt: Maralixibat inhibits CYP3A4 in vitro, however clinically relevant effects on the pharmacokinetics of CYP3A4 substrates are unlikely.

mentions.name: maribavir
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, clinically significant interactions are not expected when LIVTENCITY is coadministered with substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP2D6, CYP3A4; uridine diphosphate-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT)1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A9, UGT2B7;

mentions.name: mavacamten
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Mavacamten is extensively metabolized, primarily through CYP2C19 (74%), CYP3A4 (18%), and CYP2C9 (8%).

mentions.name: mavorixafor
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2D6 are primarily responsible for mavorixafor metabolism.

mentions.name: mefloquine

mentions.name: meperidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data show meperidine is metabolized to normeperidine in liver mainly by CYP3A4 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: metaxalone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Metaxalone is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: methylene blue
mentions.excerpt: Possible time-dependent inhibition of CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4/5 (testosterone as substrate) was also observed.

mentions.name: methylnaltrexone
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Methylnaltrexone and its Metabolites on CYP Enzymes In vitro, methylnaltrexone did not significantly inhibit or induce the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: midazolam
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Midazolam is primarily metabolized by liver and intestinal cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) to its pharmacologic active metabolite, 1-hydroxy midazolam (also termed α-hydroxy-midazolam).

mentions.name: midostaurin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Midostaurin is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: mifepristone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) has been shown to be involved in mifepristone metabolism in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: miglustat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Miglustat does not inhibit the metabolism of various substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes including, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A11 in vitro ; consequently, significant interactions via inhibition of these enzymes are unlikely with drugs that are substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes.

mentions.name: milnacipran
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: In general, milnacipran, at concentrations that were at least 25 times those attained in clinical trials, did not inhibit human CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5 enzyme systems, indicating a low potential of interactions with drugs metabolized by these enzymes.

mentions.name: milsaperidone
mentions.excerpt: Iloperidone is metabolized primarily by 3 biotransformation pathways: carbonyl reduction, hydroxylation (mediated by CYP2D6) and O-demethylation (mediated by CYP3A4).

mentions.name: mirabegron
mentions.excerpt: Although, in vitro studies suggest a role for CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 in the oxidative metabolism of mirabegron, in vivo results indicate that these isozymes play a limited role in the overall elimination.

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl-DM4 undergo metabolism by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine gynx
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl-DM4 undergo metabolism by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: mitapivat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies showed that mitapivat is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: momelotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Momelotinib is metabolized by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes including CYP3A4 (36%), CYP2C8 (19%), CYP2C9 (17%), CYP2C19 (19%), and CYP1A2 (9%).

mentions.name: mometasone
mentions.excerpt: In human liver microsomes, the formation of the metabolite is regulated by cytochrome P-450 3A4 (CYP3A4).

mentions.name: moxidectin
mentions.excerpt: CV = coefficient of variation Drug Interaction Studie s Clinical Study with Midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate ) Co-administration of a single 8 mg dose of Moxidectin Tablets with a single oral 7.5 mg dose of midazolam (a sensitive CYP3A substrate) to healthy subjects (n = 37) did not affect the pharmacokinetics of midazolam or its major metabolite, 1-hydroxy midazolam.

mentions.name: moxifloxacin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with cytochrome (CYP) P450 enzymes indicate that moxifloxacin does not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: naldemedine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Naldemedine on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naldemedine did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (including CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A11 isozymes) and is not an inhibitor of transporters (including OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BCRP, or P-gp).

mentions.name: naloxegol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of MOVANTIK on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naloxegol did not show a significant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4 or CYP2C19, nor a significant induction effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: nateglinide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro drug metabolism studies indicate that Nateglinide Tablets are predominantly metabolized by the cytochrome P450 isozyme CYP2C9 (70%) and to a lesser extent CYP3A4 (30%).

mentions.name: nemolizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nemolizumab ilto
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nepafenac
mentions.excerpt: Nepafenac at concentrations up to 3000 ng/mL and amfenac at concentrations up to 1000 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of six specific marker substrates of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: nerandomilast
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with nerandomilast: oral midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), pirfenidone, and nintedanib.

mentions.name: neratinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Neratinib is metabolized primarily in the liver by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by flavin-containing monooxygenase (FMO).

mentions.name: nicardipine
mentions.excerpt: Nicardipine does not induce or inhibit its own metabolism, however, nicardipine has been shown to inhibit certain cytochrome P450 enzymes (including CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C8, and CYP2C19).

mentions.name: nilotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Nilotinib is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4-mediated oxidation and to a minor extent by CYP2C8.

mentions.name: nimodipine
mentions.excerpt: The metabolism of nimodipine is mediated by CYP3A4 [see Drug Interactions (7.2 , 7.3) ].

mentions.name: nintedanib

mentions.name: nintedanib esylate
mentions.excerpt: Only a minor extent of the biotransformation of nintedanib consisted of CYP pathways, with CYP3A4 being the predominant enzyme involved.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir ritonavir
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4=cytochrome P450 3A4;

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: In vitro studies have shown that nitisinone is relatively stable in human liver microsomes with minor metabolism possibly mediated by CYP3A4 enzyme.

mentions.name: odevixibat
mentions.excerpt: Concomitant use of BYLVAY 7.2 mg once daily for 4 days with oral midazolam (a CYP3A4 substrate) in healthy adults decreased the AUC 0-24h of midazolam and 1-OH midazolam by 29% and 13%, respectively, which is not expected to have a clinically relevant effect.

mentions.name: oliceridine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism In vitro studies suggest that oliceridine is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 P450 hepatic enzymes, with minor contributions from CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 into inactive metabolites.

mentions.name: olodaterol
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 isozymes CYP2C9 and CYP2C8, with negligible contribution of CYP3A4, are involved in the O-demethylation of olodaterol, while uridine diphosphate glycosyl transferase isoforms UGT2B7, UGT1A1, 1A7, and 1A9 were shown to be involved in the formation of olodaterol glucuronides.

mentions.name: olopatadine
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies with cDNA-expressed human cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP) and flavin-containing monooxygenases (FMO), N-desmethyl olopatadine (Ml) formation was catalyzed mainly by CYP3A4, while olopatadine N-oxide (M3) was primarily catalyzed by FMO1 and FMO3.

mentions.name: olutasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Strong CYP3A4 Inducers: Olutasidenib C max decreased by 43% and AUC by 80% when used concomitantly with multiple doses of a strong CYP3A inducer (rifampin).

mentions.name: omaveloxolone
mentions.excerpt: Moderate CYP3A Inhibitors: After single dose administration, omaveloxolone C max and AUC increased approximately 1.25-fold following concomitant use with verapamil (moderate CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibitor) [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )] .

mentions.name: opicapone
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when administered concomitantly with opicapone: S-warfarin (index substrate of CYP2C9), R-Warfarin (substrate of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4), or repaglinide (index substrate of CYP2C8 and OATP1B1).

mentions.name: orforglipron

mentions.name: oritavancin

mentions.name: osilodrostat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Multiple CYP enzymes (i.e., CYP3A4, CYP2B6, and CYP2D6) and UDP-glucuronosyltransferases contribute to osilodrostat metabolism and no single enzyme contributes greater than 25% to the total clearance.

mentions.name: osimertinib
mentions.excerpt: Strong CYP3A Inhibitors: Co-administering TAGRISSO with 200 mg itraconazole twice daily (a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor) had no clinically significant effect on the exposure of osimertinib (AUC increased by 24% and C max decreased by 20%).

mentions.name: ospemifene

mentions.name: oteseconazole
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when co-administered with oteseconazole: Midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate), ethinyl estradiol (CYP3A4 substrate), norethindrone (CYP3A4 substrate), or digoxin (P-gp substrate).

mentions.name: oxcarbazepine

mentions.name: oxycodone

mentions.name: oxymetazoline

mentions.name: ozanimod

mentions.name: paclitaxel

mentions.name: pacritinib

mentions.name: paliperidone

mentions.name: palonosetron

mentions.name: palovarotene

mentions.name: paltusotine

mentions.name: paricalcitol

mentions.name: paroxetine

mentions.name: pazopanib

mentions.name: pemigatinib

mentions.name: perampanel

mentions.name: phenobarbital

mentions.name: pimavanserin
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Pimavanserin is predominantly metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 and to a lesser extent by CYP2J2, CYP2D6, and various other CYP and FMO enzymes.

mentions.name: pirtobrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Pirtobrutinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and direct glucuronidation by UGT1A8 and UGT1A9, in vitro.

mentions.name: pitolisant

mentions.name: plazomicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Drug-Metabolizing Enzymes Plazomicin does not inhibit the following cytochrome P450 isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: plecanatide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Neither plecanatide nor its active metabolite inhibited the cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes 2C9 and 3A4, and they did not induce CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: plerixafor
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies with human hepatocytes, plerixafor does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: pomalidomide

mentions.name: ponatinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent CYP2C8, CYP2D6 and CYP3A5 are involved in the Phase I metabolism of ponatinib in vitro .

mentions.name: ponesimod

mentions.name: posaconazole

mentions.name: pralsetinib

mentions.name: pramipexole

mentions.name: prasugrel

mentions.name: pretomanid

mentions.name: propafenone

mentions.name: prucalopride

mentions.name: quinine sulphate

mentions.name: quizartinib

mentions.name: raltegravir

mentions.name: ramelteon
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 is the major isozyme involved in the hepatic metabolism of ramelteon; the CYP2C subfamily and CYP3A4 isozymes are also involved to a minor degree.

mentions.name: rasagiline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that rasagiline at a concentration of 1 mcg/mL (equivalent to a level that is 160 times the average C max ~ 5.9 to 8.5 ng/mL in Parkinson’s disease patients after 1 mg rasagiline multiple dosing) did not inhibit cytochrome P450 isoenzymes, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A.

mentions.name: regorafenib

mentions.name: relacorilant

mentions.name: relugolix
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Relugolix is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: remibrutinib

mentions.name: revefenacin

mentions.name: revumenib

mentions.name: ribociclib

mentions.name: rifaximin

mentions.name: rilzabrutinib

mentions.name: rimegepant

mentions.name: riociguat

mentions.name: ripretinib

mentions.name: rivastigmine

mentions.name: roflumilast

mentions.name: rolapitant

mentions.name: romidepsin

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b njft

mentions.name: rotigotine

mentions.name: rucaparib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro, rucaparib is primarily metabolized by CYP2D6 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Ruxolitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 in vitro.

mentions.name: safinamide
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 and other CYP iso-enzymes play only a minor role in its overall biotransformation.

mentions.name: sarecycline
mentions.excerpt: Sarecycline does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 isozymes, and does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, or BCRP.

mentions.name: sarilumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions CYP450 Substrates Simvastatin is a CYP3A4 and OATP1B1 substrate.

mentions.name: saxagliptin
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism The metabolism of saxagliptin is primarily mediated by cytochrome P450 3A4/5 (CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: scopolamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study using human hepatocytes examined the induction of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 by scopolamine.

mentions.name: sebetralstat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Sebetralstat is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8.

mentions.name: seladelpar lysine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Seladelpar is primarily metabolized in vitro by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4, resulting in the three major metabolites: seladelpar sulfoxide (M1), desethyl-seladelpar (M2), and desethyl-seladelpar sulfoxide (M3).

mentions.name: selegiline
mentions.excerpt: CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 appeared to be the major contributing enzymes in the formation of R(-)-methamphetamine from selegiline, with CYP2A6 having a minor role.

mentions.name: selexipag
mentions.excerpt: Oxidative metabolism, catalyzed mainly by CYP2C8 and to a smaller extent by CYP3A4, leads to the formation of hydroxylated and dealkylated products.

mentions.name: selinexor
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selinexor is metabolized by CYP3A4, multiple UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) and glutathione S-transferases (GSTs).

mentions.name: selpercatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selpercatinib is metabolized predominantly by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: selumetinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selumetinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2E1, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: sildenafil
mentions.excerpt: It is eliminated predominantly by hepatic metabolism (mainly CYP3A4) and is converted to an active metabolite with properties similar to the parent, sildenafil.

mentions.name: silodosin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Silodosin undergoes extensive metabolism through glucuronidation, alcohol and aldehyde dehydrogenase, and cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) pathways.

mentions.name: siponimod
mentions.excerpt: Residual elimination of siponimod is ascribed to various other cytochromes, including CYP3A4 (6%), which are considered to be minor across all CYP2C9 genotypes.

mentions.name: sirolimus
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Sirolimus is a substrate for both CYP3A4 and P-gp.

mentions.name: sofpironium
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Sofpironium is metabolized by nonenzymatic hydrolysis, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 mediated-oxidative metabolism, and glycine conjugation.

mentions.name: solifenacin
mentions.excerpt: The primary pathway for elimination is by way of CYP3A4; however, alternate metabolic pathways exist.

mentions.name: sorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Sorafenib undergoes oxidative metabolism by hepatic CYP3A4, as well as glucuronidation by UGT1A9.

mentions.name: sotagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: The key enzymes responsible for the metabolism of sotagliflozin were UGT1A9 and, to a lesser extent, CYP3A4.

mentions.name: sotorasib
mentions.excerpt: Strong CYP3A4 Inducers : Coadministration of repeat doses of rifampin (a strong CYP3A4 inducer) with a single dose of LUMAKRAS decreased sotorasib C max by 35% and AUC by 51%.

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), pitavastatin (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, substrate), or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) were observed when co-administered with sparsentan.

mentions.name: stiripentol
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism : On the basis of in vitro studies, the main liver cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoenzymes involved in metabolism are considered to be CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: sunitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Sunitinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 to its primary active metabolite, which is further metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: tafamidis
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies CYP3A4 substrates: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (a CYP3A4 substrate) or on the formation of its active metabolite (1-hydroxymidazolam) were observed when a single 7.5-mg dose of midazolam was administered prior to and after a 14-day regimen of VYNDAQEL 20-mg once daily.

mentions.name: tafenoquine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant effects on the pharmacokinetics of substrates of cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP)1A2 (caffeine), CYP2D6 (desipramine), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) were observed following coadministration with tafenoquine in healthy adult subjects.

mentions.name: talazoparib
mentions.excerpt: CYP Enzymes: Talazoparib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: taletrectinib adipate
mentions.excerpt: Taletrectinib induces CYP1A2 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: tapinarof
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tapinarof is not an inhibitor of CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: tasimelteon
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 are the major isozymes involved in the metabolism of tasimelteon.

mentions.name: tecovirimat
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tecovirimat is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8 and CYP2C19, and a weak inducer of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: telisotuzumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: MMAE is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: telisotuzumab vedotin tllv
mentions.excerpt: MMAE is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: telotristat ethyl
mentions.excerpt: Midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate) Following administration of multiple doses of telotristat ethyl, the systemic exposure to concomitant midazolam was significantly decreased.

mentions.name: telotristat etiprate
mentions.excerpt: Midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate) Following administration of multiple doses of telotristat ethyl, the systemic exposure to concomitant midazolam was significantly decreased.

mentions.name: temsirolimus
mentions.excerpt: However, there was no effect observed in vivo when temsirolimus was administered with desipramine (a CYP2D6 substrate), and no effect is anticipated with substrates of CYP3A4 metabolism.

mentions.name: tenapanor
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Tenapanor is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4/5 and low levels of its major metabolite, M1, are detected in plasma.

mentions.name: tenofovir disoproxil
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations substantially higher (~300-fold) than those observed in vivo, tenofovir did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: tepotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Tepotinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: teriflunomide
mentions.excerpt: Teriflunomide did not affect the pharmacokinetics of bupropion (a CYP2B6 substrate), midazolam (a CYP3A4 substrate), S-warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (a CYP2C19 substrate), and metoprolol (a CYP2D6 substrate).

mentions.name: tetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that neither Tetrabenazine nor its α- or β-HTBZ or 9-desmethyl-β-DHTBZ metabolites are likely to result in clinically significant induction of CYP1A2, CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2C19.

mentions.name: thiotepa
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data suggests that CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 may be responsible for the metabolism of thiotepa to TEPA, a major active metabolite.

mentions.name: ticagrelor
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism CYP3A4 is the major enzyme responsible for ticagrelor metabolism and the formation of its major active metabolite.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab asmn
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tinidazole
mentions.excerpt: Tinidazole is biotransformed mainly by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: tirbanibulin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, tirbanibulin is mainly metabolized by CYP3A4, and to a lesser extent, CYP2C8.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: Tisotumab vedotin-tftv releases unconjugated MMAE via proteolytic cleavage, and unconjugated MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin tftv
mentions.excerpt: Tisotumab vedotin-tftv releases unconjugated MMAE via proteolytic cleavage, and unconjugated MMAE is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: tivozanib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Tivozanib is metabolized predominantly by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: tocilizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab aazg
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab anoh
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab bavi
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tofacitinib
mentions.excerpt: The metabolism of tofacitinib is primarily mediated by CYP3A4 with minor contribution from CYP2C19.

mentions.name: tolterodine
mentions.excerpt: The identified pathway of metabolism for these individuals (“poor metabolizers”) is dealkylation via cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) to N -dealkylated tolterodine.

mentions.name: tolvaptan
mentions.excerpt: Moderate CYP3A4 Inhibitors Fluconazole: Fluconazole 400 mg given one day prior and 200 mg given concomitantly produced an 80% and 200% increase in tolvaptan C max and AUC, respectively.

mentions.name: topotecan
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of single oral dose of cyclosporine A (15 mg/kg), an inhibitor of P-gp, multidrug-resistance-associated protein (MRP-1) and CYP3A4, within 4 hours of oral topotecan increased the dose-normalized AUC 0-24h of topotecan lactone and total topotecan 2- to 3-fold compared to topotecan alone [see Drug Interactions (7.1)].

mentions.name: toremifene
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism - Toremifene is extensively metabolized, principally by CYP3A4 to N-demethyltoremifene which is also antiestrogenic but with weak in vivo antitumor potency.

mentions.name: tovorafenib
