mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Informed Approaches CYP3A Substrates: Midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) steady-state C max and AUC are predicted to decrease by at least 20% following coadministration with tovorafenib.

mentions.name: tradipitant
mentions.excerpt: In vitro findings suggest that non-CYP450-mediated processes and CYP enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2C19, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8) are involved in the metabolism of tradipitant.

mentions.name: trametinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Trametinib on CYP Substrates: Coadministration of MEKINIST tablets 2 mg once daily with a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate had no clinically relevant effect on the AUC and C max of the sensitive CYP3A4 substrate.

mentions.name: trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Trametinib on CYP Substrates: Coadministration of MEKINIST tablets 2 mg once daily with a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate had no clinically relevant effect on the AUC and C max of the sensitive CYP3A4 substrate.

mentions.name: trastuzumab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: DXd is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: trastuzumab emtansine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies indicate that DM1, the small molecule component of KADCYLA, undergoes metabolism by CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: treosulfan
mentions.excerpt: Treosulfan inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 (using midazolam as substrate), but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 (using testosterone as substrate).

mentions.name: tretinoin
mentions.excerpt: Tretinoin is metabolized by cytochrome P450 enzymes, CYP3A4, 2C8, and 2E and undergoes glucuronidation by UGT2B7.

mentions.name: triclabendazole
mentions.excerpt: This sulfoxide metabolite is further metabolized primarily by CYP2C9 to the active sulfone metabolite and to a lesser extent by CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP1B1, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, in vitro.

mentions.name: trifarotene
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Trifarotene is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9, CYP3A4, CYP2C8, and to a lesser extent by CYP2B6 in vitro .

mentions.name: triheptanoin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Heptanoate is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: trilaciclib
mentions.excerpt: Trilaciclib is an inducer for CYP1A2, and is not an inducer for CYP2B6 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: triptorelin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Metabolizing Enzyme Induction In fresh human hepatocytes from three human donors, triptorelin did not induce CYP1A2 or CYP3A4/5 activity.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Ubrogepant is eliminated mainly through metabolism, primarily by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ulipristal
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate that this is predominantly mediated by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: upadacitinib
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Upadacitinib metabolism is mediated by mainly CYP3A4 with a potential minor contribution from CYP2D6.

mentions.name: uridine triacetate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro enzyme inhibition data did not reveal meaningful inhibitory effects of uridine triacetate or uridine on CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: valbenazine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Valbenazine is extensively metabolized after oral administration by hydrolysis of the valine ester to form the active metabolite ([+]-α-HTBZ) and by oxidative metabolism, primarily by CYP3A4/5, to form mono-oxidized valbenazine and other minor metabolites. [+]-α-HTBZ appears to be further metabolized in part by CYP2D6.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of vamorolone is mediated through CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8, UGT1A3, UGT2B7, and UGT2B17.

mentions.name: vandetanib
mentions.excerpt: N-desmethyl-vandetanib is primarily produced by CYP3A4 and vandetanib-N-oxide by flavin-containing monooxygenase enzymes FMO1 and FMO3.

mentions.name: vardenafil
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Vardenafil is metabolized predominantly by the hepatic enzyme CYP3A4, with contribution from the CYP3A5 and CYP2C isoforms.

mentions.name: vemurafenib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitors: Coadministration of 960 mg ZELBORAF twice daily with once daily doses of 200 mg itraconazole, a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, increased steady state vemurafenib AUC 0-τ by 40% (90% CI: 21%, 61%) with a similar magnitude of increase in C max [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ].

mentions.name: venetoclax
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Venetoclax is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vepdegestrant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Vepdegestrant is primarily metabolized through direct sulfation via multiple SULT isoforms and oxidation via CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: vibegron
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is the predominant enzyme responsible for in vitro metabolism.

mentions.name: vilazodone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is primarily responsible for its metabolism among CYP pathways, with minor contributions from CYP2C19 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Viltolarsen did not inhibit CYP3A4/5, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, or UGT2B7.

mentions.name: vimseltinib
mentions.excerpt: Vimseltinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vismodegib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant differences in vismodegib pharmacokinetics were observed when used concomitantly with fluconazole (moderate CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 inhibitor), itraconazole (strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and P-gp inhibitor) and rabeprazole (gastric acid reducing agent, proton pump inhibitor).

mentions.name: voclosporin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Voclosporin is predominantly metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vonoprazan
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Vonoprazan is metabolized to inactive metabolites via multiple pathways by a combination of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoforms (predominantly CYP3A4/5, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2B6) along with sulfo- and glucuronosyl-transferases.

mentions.name: voriconazole
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism In vitro studies showed that voriconazole is metabolized by the human hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes, CYP2C19, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: vorinostat
mentions.excerpt: Gene expression studies in human hepatocytes detected some potential for suppression of CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 activities by vorinostat at concentrations higher (≥10 µM) than pharmacologically relevant.

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Vortioxetine is extensively metabolized primarily through oxidation via cytochrome P450 isozymes CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, and CYP2B6 and subsequent glucuronic acid conjugation.

mentions.name: voxelotor
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of voxelotor is mediated by CYP3A4, CYP3A5, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, UGT1A1, and UGT1A9.

mentions.name: zafirlukast
mentions.excerpt: Additional in vitro studies utilizing human liver microsomes show that zafirlukast inhibits the cytochrome P450 CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 isoenzymes at concentrations close to the clinically achieved total plasma concentrations (see Drug Interactions ).

mentions.name: zaleplon
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions Because zaleplon is primarily metabolized by aldehyde oxidase, and to a lesser extent by CYP3A4, inhibitors of these enzymes might be expected to decrease zaleplon’s clearance and inducers of these enzymes might be expected to increase its clearance.

mentions.name: zavegepant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Zavegepant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2D6, in vitro.

mentions.name: ziftomenib
mentions.excerpt: Strong, Moderate, or Weak CYP3A4 Inhibitors: Itraconazole, voriconazole, and posaconazole (strong CYP3A4 inhibitors) are estimated to increase ziftomenib AUC by up to 3-fold and C max by up to 2-fold.

mentions.name: zileuton
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies utilizing human liver microsomes have shown that zileuton and its N-dehydroxylated metabolite can be oxidatively metabolized by CYP1A2, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ziprasidone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes and recombinant enzymes indicate that CYP3A4 is the major CYP contributing to the oxidative metabolism of ziprasidone.

mentions.name: zolpidem
mentions.excerpt: Rifampin, a CYP3A4 inducer, significantly reduced the exposure to and the pharmacodynamic effects of zolpidem [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: zongertinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Based on in vitro metabolite profiling, CYP-mediated oxidation pathways represent 48% to 62% (mainly CYP3A4 and CYP3A5), glucuronidation 13% to 25% (mainly UGT1A4), and glutathione conjugation 13% to 26% of total hepatic metabolism.

mentions.name: zonisamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Zonisamide is metabolized by N-acetyl-transferases to form N-acetyl zonisamide and by CYP3A4 to form 2–sulfamoylacetylphenol (SMAP).

mentions.name: zuranolone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Zuranolone undergoes extensive metabolism, with CYP3A4 identified as a primary enzyme involved.

mentions.name: abemaciclib
mentions.excerpt: CYP Metabolic Pathways: In a clinical drug interaction study in patients with cancer, multiple doses of abemaciclib (200 mg twice daily for 7 days) did not result in clinically meaningful changes in the pharmacokinetics of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 substrates.

mentions.name: abiraterone
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 substrates : When abiraterone acetate 1,000 mg daily (plus prednisone 5 mg twice daily) was given with a single dose of 100 mg theophylline (CYP1A2 substrate), no increase in systemic exposure of theophylline was observed.

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Abrocitinib and its metabolites M1 and M2 are not inhibitors or inducers of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Acalabrutinib is an inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9, but not CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: acamprosate
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions Acamprosate had no inducing potential on the cytochrome CYP1A2 and 3A4 systems, and in vitro inhibition studies suggest that acamprosate does not inhibit in vivo metabolism mediated by cytochrome CYP1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A4.

mentions.name: acoramidis
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Acoramidis is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP2C9, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: adagrasib
mentions.excerpt: Adagrasib inhibits its own CYP3A4 metabolism following multiple dosing to steady-state which permits CYP2C8, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 to contribute to its metabolism at steady-state.

mentions.name: adefovir dipivoxil
mentions.excerpt: At concentrations substantially higher (greater than 4000-fold) than those observed in vivo , adefovir did not inhibit any of the common human CYP450 enzymes, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: afatinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Afatinib on CYP450 Enzymes: Afatinib is not an inhibitor or an inducer of CYP450 enzymes (CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, and 3A4) in cultured primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP enzymes: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that alectinib and M4 do not inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19 or 2D6.

mentions.name: alfuzosin
mentions.excerpt: In human liver microsomes, at concentrations that are achieved at the therapeutic dose, alfuzosin did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 or 3A4 isoenzymes.

mentions.name: alogliptin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on the Pharmacokinetic Exposure of Alogliptin In Vitro Studies Effect of Alogliptin on CYP Enzymes Alogliptin is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alosetron
mentions.excerpt: However, in vivo data suggest that CYP1A2 plays a more prominent role in alosetron metabolism (62% to 97% of alosetron clearance) based on correlation of alosetron clearance with in vivo CYP1A2 activity measured by probe substrate, increased clearance induced by smoking and inhibition of clearance by fluvoxamine [see Contraindications (4) , Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: amantadine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies show that amantadine does not significantly inhibit the enzyme activity of drug metabolizing cytochrome P450 isoforms (CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C19, 2C8, 2C9, 2D6, 2E1, 3A4, and 3A5).

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450-Related Metabolism In vitro , amisulpride did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4, or induce CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: amphetamine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro experiments with human microsomes indicate minor inhibition of CYP2D6 by amphetamine and minor inhibition of CYP1A2, 2D6, and 3A4 by one or more metabolites.

mentions.name: anagrelide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Anagrelide is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 to the active metabolite, 3-hydroxy anagrelide, which is subsequently metabolized by CYP1A2 to the inactive metabolite, RL603.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Apalutamide does not inhibit or induce CYP1A2 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , CYP metabolism of apremilast is primarily mediated by CYP3A4, with minor contributions from CYP1A2 and CYP2A6.

mentions.name: aprepitant
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that aprepitant is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 with minor metabolism by CYP1A2 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: CYP450 enzymes: Aprocitentan inhibits CYP3A4 and all members of the CYP2C family, but did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: arformoterol
mentions.excerpt: Arformoterol did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A9/11 enzymes at >1,000-fold higher concentrations than the expected peak plasma concentrations following a therapeutic dose.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: armodafinil
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro data demonstrated that armodafinil weakly induces CYP1A2 and possibly CYP3A activities in a concentration-related manner and that CYP2C19 activity is reversibly inhibited by armodafinil.

mentions.name: asenapine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination of asenapine is primarily through direct glucuronidation by UGT1A4 and oxidative metabolism by cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (predominantly CYP1A2).

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Clinically significant interactions are not expected between atazanavir and substrates of CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2B6, CYP2A6, CYP1A2, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: atogepant
mentions.excerpt: Atogepant is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Atrasentan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and is not an inducer of CYP1A2.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: Effect of TAVNEOS on Other Drug Substances In vitro studies indicate that avacopan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6, and does not induce CYP1A2 and CYP2B6, but shows induction and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Avapritinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Avutometinib is a CYP3A4 substrate, but not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: Axitinib is metabolized primarily in the liver by CYP3A4/5 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and UGT1A1.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Both baloxavir marboxil and baloxavir do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: balsalazide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Data In an in vitro study using human liver microsomes, balsalazide and its metabolites [5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA), Nacetyl-5-aminosalicylic acid (N-Ac-5-ASA), 4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (4-ABA) and N-acetyl-4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (N-Ac-4-ABA)] were not shown to inhibit the major CYP enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes: Baxdrostat did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: belatacept
mentions.excerpt: NULOJIX did not alter the pharmacokinetics of drugs that are substrates of CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C9 (losartan), CYP2D6 (dextromethorphan), CYP3A (midazolam), and CYP2C19 (omeprazole) [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: belumosudil
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 Substrates: Concomitant use of belumosudil is predicted to increase caffeine (sensitive CYP1A2 substrate) C max and AUC approximately 1.1- and 1.6-fold, respectively.

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Belzutifan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Two active minor metabolites, M3 and M4, are primarily formed via CYP1A2 in vitro.

mentions.name: benzgalantamine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Galantamine on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies In vitro studies show that galantamine did not inhibit the metabolic pathways catalyzed by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP4A, CYP2C, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: bepotastine
mentions.excerpt: The effect of bepotastine besilate on the metabolism of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, and CYP2D6 was not studied.

mentions.name: bepotastine besilate
mentions.excerpt: The effect of bepotastine besilate on the metabolism of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2C8 and CYP2D6 was not studied.

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Bexarotene on Other Drugs Bexarotene did not significantly inhibit the following enzymes in human liver microsomes: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: binimetinib
mentions.excerpt: The active metabolite M3 produced by CYP1A2 and CYP2C19 represents 8.6% of the binimetinib exposure.

mentions.name: bortezomib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Bortezomib is primarily oxidatively metabolized to several inactive metabolites in vitro via cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes 3A4, CYP2C19, and CYP1A2, and to a lesser extent by CYP2D6 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Brensocatib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Brigatinib did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, or 3A4/5 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: brincidofovir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP Enzymes: Brincidofovir is a direct and reversible inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP4F2.

mentions.name: brivaracetam
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions Drug-Metabolizing Enzyme Inhibition Brivaracetam did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2D6, or 3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabotegravir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, cabotegravir did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4. ‎ Simulations using PBPK modeling show that no clinically significant interaction is expected during coadministration of cabotegravir with drugs that inhibit UGT1A1.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: calcium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: Effect of EPIDIOLEX on Other Drugs CYP1A2 Substrates Coadministration of EPIDIOLEX (750 mg twice daily) with a single dose of caffeine (200 mg), a sensitive CYP1A2 substrate, showed increased caffeine exposure by 15% for C max and 95% for AUC compared to caffeine administered alone [see Drug Interactions ( 7.2 )] .

mentions.name: capecitabine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Capecitabine and its metabolites (5’-DFUR, 5’-DFCR, fluorouracil, and FBAL) did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: capivasertib
mentions.excerpt: In-Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Capivasertib induces CYP1A2.

mentions.name: capmatinib
mentions.excerpt: Substrates of CYP Enzymes: Coadministration of capmatinib increased caffeine (a CYP1A2 substrate) AUC 0-INF by 134% with no change in its C max .

mentions.name: carfilzomib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Carfilzomib on Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Carfilzomib showed direct and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A but did not induce CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies Cariprazine and its major active metabolites did not induce CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 enzymes and were weak inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, or CYP2D6 in vitro .

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes Cenobamate inhibits CYP2B6, CYP2C19, and CYP3A, but cenobamate does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: cinacalcet
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Excretion Cinacalcet is metabolized by multiple enzymes, primarily CYP3A4, CYP2D6, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: citalopram
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro enzyme inhibition data did not reveal an inhibitory effect of citalopram on CYP3A4, -2C9, or -2E1, but did suggest that it is a weak inhibitor of CYP1A2, -2D6, and -2C19.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies: Clobazam did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, UGT1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, or UGT2B4 in vitro.

mentions.name: clopidogrel bisulfate
mentions.excerpt: The active metabolite is formed mostly by CYP2C19 with contributions from several other CYP enzymes, including CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: clozapine
mentions.excerpt: Clozapine is a substrate for many cytochrome P450 isozymes, in particular CYP1A2, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cobimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Cobimetinib at clinically relevant concentrations is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9 and 2C19 or inducer of CYP1A2, 2B6 and 3A4.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Drug Interactions In vitro studies in human liver microsomes have shown that colchicine is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4 activity.

mentions.name: copper histidinate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro Studies: Copper histidinate is a weak inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 (IC 50 >100 μM).

mentions.name: crisaborole
mentions.excerpt: In vitro human liver microsomes studies for metabolite 2 showed that it did not inhibit activities of CYP2C19, 2D6, and 3A4; was a weak inhibitor of CYP1A2 and 2B6; and a moderate inhibitor of CYP2C8 and 2C9.

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: Crizotinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of TAFINLAR 150 mg twice daily for 15 days and a single dose of warfarin decreased the AUC of S-warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate) by 37% and the AUC of R-warfarin (CYP3A4/CYP1A2 substrate) by 33%.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Dacomitinib and O-desmethyl Dacomitinib on CYP Enzymes: Dacomitinib and its metabolite O-desmethyl dacomitinib do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Dalfampridine on Co-administered Drugs In vitro data with human liver microsomes showed that dalfampridine was not a direct or time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Danicopan is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 or CYP2C9.

mentions.name: daprodustat
mentions.excerpt: Daprodustat is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: darifenacin
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Darifenacin on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies: Based on in vitro human microsomal studies, darifenacin extended-release tablet is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2 or CYP2C9 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: darolutamide
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , darolutamide did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 3A4) or transporters (MRP2, BSEP, OATs, OCTs, MATEs, OATP2B1, and NTCP) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: dasatinib
mentions.excerpt: Dasatinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, or 2E1.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan dlnk
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: defactinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Avutometinib is a CYP3A4 substrate, but not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: deferasirox
mentions.excerpt: Theophylline : In a healthy volunteer study, the concomitant administration of deferasirox (repeated dose of 30 mg per kg/day) and the CYP1A2 substrate theophylline (single dose of 120 mg) resulted in an approximate doubling of the theophylline AUC and elimination half-life.

mentions.name: deflazacort
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Metabolizing Enzyme Induction 21-desDFZ and 6β-hydroxy-21-desacetyl deflazacort at clinically relevant concentrations did not significantly induce CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4.

mentions.name: delafloxacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Delafloxacin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit the cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 in vitro in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: desvenlafaxine
mentions.excerpt: Desvenlafaxine does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19 CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 isozymes.

mentions.name: deucravacitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Deucravacitinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: deuruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Deuruxolitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 (76%) and CYP3A4 (21%) and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 (3%).

mentions.name: deutetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro experiments in human liver microsomes demonstrate that deutetrabenazine is extensively biotransformed, mainly by carbonyl reductase, to its major active metabolites, α-HTBZ and β-HTBZ, which are subsequently metabolized primarily by CYP2D6, with minor contributions of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4/5, to form several minor metabolites.

mentions.name: dexlansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: Furthermore, in vivo studies showed that dexlansoprazole did not have an impact on the pharmacokinetics of coadministered phenytoin (CYP2C9 substrate) or theophylline (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: dexmethylphenidate
mentions.excerpt: Conversely, the d- and l- enantiomers of methylphenidate did not relevantly inhibit CYP1A2, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A.

mentions.name: diazepam
mentions.excerpt: No inhibition was demonstrated in the presence of inhibitors selective for CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2, indicating that these enzymes are not significantly involved in metabolism of diazepam.

mentions.name: diazoxide choline
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Diazoxide is mainly metabolized by CYP1A2 and to a minor extent by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: dichlorphenamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dichlorphenamide is not a substrate for CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 isoforms when tested in vitro .

mentions.name: difamilast
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Difamilast is substantially metabolized to form three major metabolites in the plasma via CYP3A4-mediated O-deethylation (Metabolite 1), CYP1A2-mediated hydroxylation (Metabolite 2), and enzymatic hydrolysis (Metabolite 3).

mentions.name: difelikefalin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Difelikefalin is not metabolized by cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C19, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 or CYP3A observed in human hepatic microsomes or hepatocytes, in vitro.

mentions.name: diroximel
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies found diroximel fumarate and its metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 enzymes in human liver microsomes or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4/5 in cultured human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: doravirine
mentions.excerpt: Doravirine did not inhibit major drug metabolizing enzymes in vitro , including CYPs 1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4, and UGT1A1 and is not likely to be an inducer of CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4.

mentions.name: dordaviprone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Dordaviprone inhibits CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP2C19 and induces CYP2B6.

mentions.name: doxepin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that CYP2C19 and CYP2D6 are the major enzymes involved in doxepin metabolism, and that CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 are involved to a lesser extent.

mentions.name: dronedarone
mentions.excerpt: Dronedarone has no significant potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2C8 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: dutasteride
mentions.excerpt: Dutasteride is not metabolized in vitro by human cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: edaravone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that, at the recommended dosage, edaravone and its metabolites are not expected to significantly inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A), conjugating enzymes UGT1A1 and UGT2B7, or other transporters (P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K) in humans.

mentions.name: edoxaban
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro Drug Interactions Studies In vitro studies indicate that edoxaban does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8/9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A4) and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP3A4 or the P-gp transporter (MDR1).

mentions.name: efavirenz
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, efavirenz did not inhibit CYP2E1 and inhibited CYP2D6 and CYP1A2 (Ki values 82-160 μM) only at concentrations well above those achieved clinically.

mentions.name: efinaconazole
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies using human liver microsomes, efinaconazole did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2PE1 and CYP3A4 enzyme activities at expected clinical systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: elacestrant
mentions.excerpt: Elacestrant is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: elafibranor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Effect of IQIRVO on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro Studies: Elafibranor, GFT1007 and GFT3351 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: elamipretide
mentions.excerpt: Elamipretide does not induce metabolism by CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eletriptan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro human liver microsome studies suggest that eletriptan has little potential to inhibit CYP1A2, 2C9, 2E1 and 3A4 at concentrations up to 100 µM.

mentions.name: elexacaftor ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Elexacaftor, Tezacaftor and/or Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Based on in vitro results, elexacaftor and tezacaftor have a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, whereas ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: elinzanetant
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) Enzymes: Elinzanetant and its metabolites M18/21, M27, and M30/M34 inhibited CYP3A4 but did not inhibit CYP1A1, 1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 2J2, or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C19, or 3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: eltrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that CYP1A2 and CYP2C8 are responsible for the oxidative metabolism of eltrombopag.

mentions.name: eltrombopag choline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that CYP1A2 and CYP2C8 are responsible for the oxidative metabolism of eltrombopag.

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate that eluxadoline is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: emtricitabine
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations up to 14-fold higher than those observed in vivo, FTC did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: enasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of enasidenib is mediated by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4), and by multiple UDP glucuronosyl transferases (UGTs) (e.g., UGT1A1, UGT1A3, UGT1A4, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, and UGT2B15) in vitro.

mentions.name: encorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of encorafenib on Other CYP Substrates: There was no clinically significant effect of repeat dose administration of BRAFTOVI 450 mg once daily and binimetinib 45 mg twice daily on the exposure of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ensartinib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Ensartinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ensifentrine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of OHTUVAYRE on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies Ensifentrine and Cytochrome P450 : At therapeutically relevant concentrations, ensifentrine does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ensitrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Ensitrelvir does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: enzalutamide
mentions.excerpt: No clinically meaningful changes in exposure of pioglitazone (a sensitive CYP2C8 substrate), caffeine (a sensitive CYP1A2 substrate), dextromethorphan (a sensitive CYP2D6 substrate), or rosuvastatin (a BCRP substrate) were observed following coadministration with XTANDI.

mentions.name: eplerenone
mentions.excerpt: Eplerenone is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: eravacycline
mentions.excerpt: Eravacycline is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, or 3A4/5.

mentions.name: eribulin
mentions.excerpt: No significant inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 was detected with eribulin concentrations up to 5 μM in pooled human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: erlotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Erlotinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, and the extrahepatic isoform CYP1A1, in vitro .

mentions.name: esketamine
mentions.excerpt: Esketamine and its major metabolites do not induce CYP1A2.

mentions.name: eslicarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies in human liver microsomes, eslicarbazepine had no clinically relevant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4, and only a moderate inhibitory effect on CYP2C19.

mentions.name: estazolam
mentions.excerpt: The ability of estazolam to induce or inhibit human enzyme systems The results from in vitro human liver microsomal studies suggest that at therapeutic concentrations, estazolam has no significant inhibitory effect on the major human cytochrome P450 enzyme activities (i.e., CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A).

mentions.name: estetrol
mentions.excerpt: E4 is unlikely to induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP3A4 or inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, drug transporters P-pg, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1 and MATE2-K or at clinically relevant dose.

mentions.name: eteplirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data showed that eteplirsen did not significantly inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: etrasimod arginine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Based on in vitro studies, etrasimod is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4, nor an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: etripamil
mentions.excerpt: Etripamil does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: fam trastuzumab deruxtecan nxki
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A nor induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: febuxostat
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Febuxostat is extensively metabolized by both conjugation via uridine diphosphate glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) enzymes including UGT1A1, UGT1A3, UGT1A9, and UGT2B7 and oxidation via cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes including CYP1A2, 2C8 and 2C9 and non-P450 enzymes.

mentions.name: fenfluramine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Over 75% of fenfluramine is metabolized to norfenfluramine prior to elimination, primarily by CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibrate and fenofibric acid are not inhibitors of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fenofibric acid
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fesoterodine
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 At therapeutic concentrations, the active metabolite of fesoterodine does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A4, or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19, or 3A4 in vitro [see Drug Interactions ( 7.5 )] .

mentions.name: fexinidazole
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) and UDP-glucuronosyl transferase (UGT) Enzymes: Fexinidazole has the potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5;

mentions.name: fezolinetant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Fezolinetant is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fingolimod
mentions.excerpt: Potential of Fingolimod and Fingolimod-phosphate to Induce its Own and/or the Metabolism of Comedications Fingolimod was examined for its potential to induce human CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP4F2, and MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) mRNA and CYP3A, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP4F2 activity in primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: fingolimod lauryl
mentions.excerpt: Potential of Fingolimod and Fingolimod-phosphate to Induce its Own and/or the Metabolism of Comedications Fingolimod was examined for its potential to induce human CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP4F2, and MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) mRNA and CYP3A, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP4F2 activity in primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: flibanserin
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro and/or in vivo data, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 contribute minimally to the metabolism of flibanserin.

mentions.name: fosamprenavir
mentions.excerpt: Amprenavir does not inhibit CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or uridine glucuronosyltransferase (UDPGT).

mentions.name: fosaprepitant dimeglumine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that aprepitant is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 with minor metabolism by CYP1A2 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fosdenopterin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Fosdenopterin does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fosfomycin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Fosfomycin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fostemsavir
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, significant interactions are not expected when RUKOBIA is coadministered with substrates of CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2E1, 2D6, and 3A4;

mentions.name: fruquintinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Fruquintinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A, or an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP3A.

mentions.name: futibatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Futibatinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2 or CYP2B6.

mentions.name: gabapentin enacarbil
mentions.excerpt: Neither gabapentin enacarbil nor gabapentin are substrates, inhibitors, or inducers of the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: galantamine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Galantamine on Other Drugs: • In Vitro Studies : In vitro studies show that galantamine did not inhibit the metabolic pathways catalyzed by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP4A, CYP2C, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: ganaxolone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes Ganaxolone does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: gefitinib
mentions.excerpt: In human liver microsome studies, gefitinib had no inhibitory effect on CYP1A2, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 activities at concentrations ranging from 2 to 5000 ng/mL.

mentions.name: gemtuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies At clinically relevant concentrations, gemtuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: gepotidacin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies: In vitro, gepotidacin was not an inducer of CYP1A2, 2B6 or 3A4.

mentions.name: givinostat
mentions.excerpt: Givinostat and its metabolites ITF2374, ITF2375, ITF2440, and ITF2563 were investigated as inhibitors of the main CYP450 subfamilies, and the results indicated no inhibition is expected of CYP1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2B6, 2C8, and 3A4.

mentions.name: givosiran
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Effect of givosiran on CYP1A2 Substrates: Concomitant use of a single subcutaneous dose of givosiran 2.5 mg/kg increased caffeine (sensitive CYP1A2 substrate) AUC by 3.1-fold and C max by 1.3-fold [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ] .

mentions.name: glasdegib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Glasdegib on Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Substrates: Glasdegib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A, and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A in vitro .

mentions.name: glycerol phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro PBA or PAA did not induce CYP1A2, suggesting that in vivo drug interactions via induction of CYP1A2 is unlikely.

mentions.name: golodirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Golodirsen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5 in vitro .

mentions.name: gozetotide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP450 enzymes Gozetotide is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: guanfacine
mentions.excerpt: In pooled human hepatic microsomes, guanfacine did not inhibit the activities of the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5); guanfacine is also not an inducer of CYP3A, CYP1A2 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: guselkumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates The effects of guselkumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (metabolized by CYP3A4), warfarin (metabolized by CYP2C9), omeprazole (metabolized by CYP2C19), dextromethorphan (metabolized by CYP2D6), and caffeine (metabolized by CYP1A2) were evaluated in an exploratory study with 6 to 12 evaluable subjects with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.

mentions.name: hydromorphone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data suggest that hydromorphone in clinically relevant concentrations has minimal potential to inhibit the activity of human hepatic CYP450 enzymes including CYP1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4, and 4A11.

mentions.name: iberdomide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Iberdomide does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Ibrutinib on CYP Substrates: In vitro studies suggest that ibrutinib and PCI-45227 are unlikely to inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 or 3A at clinical doses.

mentions.name: icotrokinra
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Icotrokinra does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: iloperidone
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Smoking Based on in vitro studies utilizing human liver enzymes, Iloperidone is not a substrate for CYP1A2; smoking should therefore not have an effect on the pharmacokinetics of Iloperidone.

mentions.name: imatinib
mentions.excerpt: Other cytochrome P450 enzymes, such as CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19, play a minor role in its metabolism.

mentions.name: imlunestrant
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Imlunestrant is an inhibitor of CYP2B6 and CYP2C9 but is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2.

mentions.name: inavolisib
mentions.excerpt: Inavolisib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: inotuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, inotuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5. • Induce CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: istradefylline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that istradefylline is primarily metabolized via CYP1A1 and CYP3A4, with minor contribution from CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, and 2D6.

mentions.name: ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro results, tezacaftor has a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ixabepilone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that clinically relevant concentrations of ixabepilone do not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ixazomib
mentions.excerpt: Strong CYP1A2 Inhibitors Coadministration of NINLARO with strong CYP1A2 inhibitors did not result in a clinically meaningful change in the systemic exposure of ixazomib based on a population PK analysis.

mentions.name: ixekizumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed in subjects with plaque psoriasis when used concomitantly with a single 160 mg dose of ixekizumab, or multiple doses of 80 mg every 2 weeks.

mentions.name: lacosamide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro metabolism studies indicate that lacosamide does not induce the enzyme activity of drug metabolizing cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19 and 3A4.

mentions.name: lansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: These compounds are metabolized through various cytochrome P450 isozymes including CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: lanthanum carbonate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Lanthanum carbonate has a low potential for systemic drug-drug interactions because of the very low bioavailability of lanthanum and because it is not a substrate or inhibitor of major cytochrome P450 enzyme groups involved in drug metabolism (CYP1A2, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: larotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Larotrectinib on CYP Substrates: Larotrectinib is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: lasmiditan
mentions.excerpt: Daily dosing of lasmiditan did not alter the PK of midazolam, caffeine, or tolbutamide, which are substrates of CYP3A, CYP1A2, and CYP2C9, respectively.

mentions.name: lazertinib
mentions.excerpt: Lazertinib does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lemborexant
mentions.excerpt: Lemborexant and M10 do not inhibit other CYP isoforms (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K).

mentions.name: lenacapavir
mentions.excerpt: (substrate of CYP3A) 0.54 (0.50, 0.59) 0.76 (0.72, 0.80) Midazolam (1 day after lenacapavir, fed) (substrate of CYP3A) 2.5 single dose 2.16 (2.02, 2.30) 4.08 (3.77, 4.41) 1-hydroxymidazolam (substrate of CYP3A) 0.52 (0.48, 0.57) 0.84 (0.80, 0.88) In Vitro Studies Lenacapavir is not a substrate, inducer, or inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: leniolisib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Leniolisib was 60% metabolized by the liver, with CYP3A4 being the most predominant enzyme involved (95.4%) in the primary oxidative metabolism of leniolisib with minor contribution from other enzymes (3.5% CYP3A5, 0.7% CYP1A2 and 0.4% CYP2D6).

mentions.name: lenvatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies with Substrates of CYP or UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) : Lenvatinib inhibits CYP2C8, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: letermovir
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, the metabolism of letermovir is not mediated by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP4A11, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A7, UGT1A8, UGT1A9, UGT1A10, UGT2B4, UGT2B7, UGT2B15, or UGT2B17.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: Levoketoconazole does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6, does not induce CYP2B6, and does not inhibit the OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that levomilnacipran is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: linagliptin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions Linagliptin is a weak to moderate inhibitor of CYP isozyme CYP3A4, but does not inhibit other CYP isozymes and is not an inducer of CYP isozymes, including CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 4A11.

mentions.name: lofexidine
mentions.excerpt: LUCEMYRA is metabolized when incubated in vitro with human liver microsomes, the major contributor to the hepatic metabolism of LUCEMYRA is CYP2D6, with CYP1A2 and CYP2C19 also capable of metabolizing LUCEMYRA.

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Lonafarnib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: lorlatinib
mentions.excerpt: Lorlatinib and the major circulating metabolite, M8, do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: loxapine
mentions.excerpt: The main metabolic pathways include: 1) hydroxylation to form 8-OH-loxapine by CYP1A2 and 7-OH-loxapine by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, 2) N-oxidation to form loxapine N-oxide by flavanoid monoamine oxidases (FMOs), and 3) de-methylation to form amoxapine.

mentions.name: luliconazole
mentions.excerpt: Results of in vitro studies indicated that therapeutic doses of Luliconazole Cream, 1% did not induce CYP1A2, 2B6, and 3A4.

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies: Lumateperone showed little to no inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: lurasidone
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, lurasidone hydrochloride is not a substrate of CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP4A11, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1 enzymes.

mentions.name: lurbinectedin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes : Lurbinectedin is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lusutrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : lusutrombopag has low potential to inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan
mentions.excerpt: Vipivotide tetraxetan did not induce CYP1A2, 2B6 or 3A4; and did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 or 3A in vitro.

mentions.name: maraviroc
mentions.excerpt: Maraviroc does not induce CYP1A2 in vitro.

mentions.name: maribavir
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, clinically significant interactions are not expected when LIVTENCITY is coadministered with substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP2D6, CYP3A4; uridine diphosphate-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT)1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A9, UGT2B7;

mentions.name: mavacamten
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Mavacamten does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: mavorixafor
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), losartan (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), furosemide (OAT1 and OAT3 substrate) and oral contraceptives were observed following concomitant use with mavorixafor.

mentions.name: memantine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Memantine Hydrochloride on the Metabolism of Other Drugs In vitro studies conducted with marker substrates of CYP450 enzymes (CYP1A2, -2A6, -2C9, -2D6, -2E1, -3A4) showed minimal inhibition of these enzymes by memantine.

mentions.name: metaxalone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Metaxalone is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: methylene blue
mentions.excerpt: Methylene blue induces CYP1A2 but does not induce CYP2B6 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: methylnaltrexone
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Methylnaltrexone and its Metabolites on CYP Enzymes In vitro, methylnaltrexone did not significantly inhibit or induce the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: mexiletine
mentions.excerpt: Mexiletine is mainly metabolized in the liver, the primary pathway being CYP2D6 metabolism, although it is also a substrate for CYP1A2.

mentions.name: midostaurin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Midostaurin on CYP Enzymes Midostaurin inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP2E1;

mentions.name: mifepristone
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate a potential for CYP-mediated drug interactions by mifepristone and/or its metabolites with substrates of CYP2A6, CYP2C8/2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: miglustat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Miglustat does not inhibit the metabolism of various substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes including, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A11 in vitro ; consequently, significant interactions via inhibition of these enzymes are unlikely with drugs that are substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes.

mentions.name: milnacipran
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: In general, milnacipran, at concentrations that were at least 25 times those attained in clinical trials, did not inhibit human CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5 enzyme systems, indicating a low potential of interactions with drugs metabolized by these enzymes.

mentions.name: mirabegron
mentions.excerpt: Mirabegron is unlikely to inhibit the metabolism of co-administered drugs metabolized by the following cytochrome P450 enzymes: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 because mirabegron did not inhibit the activity of these enzymes at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: mirikizumab
mentions.excerpt: Based on a clinical drug-drug interaction study conducted in subjects with another condition, multiple subcutaneous doses of 250 mg every 4 weeks of mirikizumab-mrkz did not result in changes in the exposure of midazolam (CYP3A substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), or caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: mirikizumab mrkz
mentions.excerpt: Based on a clinical drug-drug interaction study conducted in subjects with another condition, multiple subcutaneous doses of 250 mg every 4 weeks of mirikizumab-mrkz did not result in changes in the exposure of midazolam (CYP3A substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), or caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl DM4 are not inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine gynx
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl DM4 are not inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: momelotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Momelotinib is metabolized by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes including CYP3A4 (36%), CYP2C8 (19%), CYP2C9 (17%), CYP2C19 (19%), and CYP1A2 (9%).

mentions.name: moxifloxacin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with cytochrome (CYP) P450 enzymes indicate that moxifloxacin does not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: nabilone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro P450 inhibition studies using human liver microsomes showed that nabilone did not significantly inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A4 (using midazolam and nifedipine as substrates).

mentions.name: naldemedine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Naldemedine on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naldemedine did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (including CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A11 isozymes) and is not an inhibitor of transporters (including OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BCRP, or P-gp).

mentions.name: naloxegol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of MOVANTIK on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naloxegol did not show a significant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4 or CYP2C19, nor a significant induction effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: nelfinavir
mentions.excerpt: The potential ability of nelfinavir to inhibit the major human cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP3A, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP1A2 and CYP2E1) has been investigated in vitro .

mentions.name: nemolizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nemolizumab ilto
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nepafenac
mentions.excerpt: Nepafenac at concentrations up to 3000 ng/mL and amfenac at concentrations up to 1000 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of six specific marker substrates of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: nerandomilast
mentions.excerpt: Nerandomilast does not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Ritonavir is an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir ritonavir
mentions.excerpt: Ritonavir is an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: nirogacestat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 enzymes: Nirogacestat does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, and 2D6.

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically In vitro studies showed that nitisinone does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2C19, or 3A4.

mentions.name: olopatadine
mentions.excerpt: Olopatadine at concentrations up to 33,900 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of specific substrates for CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: olutasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Olutasidenib is primarily (90%) metabolized by cytochrome P450(CYP)3A4, with minor contributions from CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP1A2, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: omaveloxolone
mentions.excerpt: Omaveloxolone is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: opicapone
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when administered concomitantly with opicapone: S-warfarin (index substrate of CYP2C9), R-Warfarin (substrate of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4), or repaglinide (index substrate of CYP2C8 and OATP1B1).

mentions.name: orforglipron
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Assessments of Drug Interactions CYP Enzymes : In in vitro studies, orforglipron did not inhibit or induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: osilodrostat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction In a healthy volunteer study (N = 20) using a single dose of osilodrostat (50 mg) and a probe drugs cocktail, osilodrostat showed inhibition potential on CYP1A2, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 isozymes with 2.5-, 1.9-, 1.5- and 1.5-fold increase in caffeine, omeprazole, dextromethorphan, and midazolam exposure, respectively [see Drug Interactions (7.1) , (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: osimertinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Metabolic Pathways: Osimertinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 and 2E1.

mentions.name: oxcarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: Results demonstrate that oxcarbazepine and its pharmacologically active 10-monohydroxy metabolite (MHD) have little or no capacity to function as inhibitors for most of the human cytochrome P450 enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP4A9 and CYP4A11) with the exception of CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: oxymetazoline
mentions.excerpt: Treatment of cultured human hepatocytes with up to 100 nM oxymetazoline did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: pacritinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Pacritinib is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, and a reversible inhibitor of CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 (Ki ≤10 µM).

mentions.name: palbociclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, palbociclib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, and 2D6, and is not an inducer of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, and 3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: paliperidone
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies utilizing human liver enzymes, paliperidone is not a substrate for CYP1A2; smoking should, therefore, not have an effect on the pharmacokinetics of paliperidone.

mentions.name: palonosetron
mentions.excerpt: In vitro metabolism studies have suggested that CYP2D6 and to a lesser extent, CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 are involved in the metabolism of palonosetron.

mentions.name: palovarotene
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Palovarotene is an inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2B6, but not CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: paltusotine
mentions.excerpt: Paltusotine does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, UGT1A6, or UGT2B15.

mentions.name: paricalcitol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions An in vitro study indicates that paricalcitol is neither an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A nor an inducer of CYP2B6, CYP2C9 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: pazopanib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro studies demonstrated that pazopanib is metabolized by CYP3A4 with a minor contribution from CYP1A2 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: pemetrexed
mentions.excerpt: Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 Enzymes In vitro studies suggest that pemetrexed does not inhibit the clearance of drugs metabolized by CYP3A, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: pemetrexed disodium hemipentahydrate
mentions.excerpt: Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 Enzymes In vitro studies suggest that pemetrexed does not inhibit the clearance of drugs metabolized by CYP3A, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: pemigatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Pemigatinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 or an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: perampanel
mentions.excerpt: Oxidative metabolism is primarily mediated by CYP3A4/5 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 and CYP2B6, based on results of in vitro studies using recombinant human CYPs and human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: pimavanserin
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro data, pimavanserin is not an irreversible inhibitor of any of the major hepatic and intestinal human CYP enzymes involved in drug metabolism (CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A4).

mentions.name: pirfenidone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: In vitro profiling studies in hepatocytes and liver microsomes have shown that pirfenidone is primarily metabolized in the liver by CYP1A2 and multiple other CYPs (CYP2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 2E1).

mentions.name: pirtobrutinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 Substrates: Pirtobrutinib did not have a clinically meaningful effect on the exposures of caffeine (sensitive CYP1A2 substrate) or S-warfarin (moderate sensitive CYP2C9 substrate).

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : FGN849 is primarily a CYP3A substrate but is not a significant substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine pvzy
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : FGN849 is primarily a CYP3A substrate but is not a significant substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: plazomicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Drug-Metabolizing Enzymes Plazomicin does not inhibit the following cytochrome P450 isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: plerixafor
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies with human hepatocytes, plerixafor does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: pomalidomide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Pomalidomide is primarily metabolized in the liver by CYP1A2 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ponatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Ponatinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A, or CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: potassium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: pralsetinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Pralsetinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2D6 and CYP1A2, in vitro.

mentions.name: pramipexole
mentions.excerpt: Pramipexole does not inhibit CYP enzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: prasugrel
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Prasugrel to Affect Other Drugs In vitro metabolism studies demonstrate that prasugrel's main circulating metabolites are not likely to cause clinically significant inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A, or induction of CYP1A2 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: pretomanid
mentions.excerpt: Pretomanid is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations based on in vitro studies.

mentions.name: primaquine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of primaquine on the Pharmacokinetics of other drugs In vitro data suggest primaquine has the potential to inhibit CYP1A2 enzyme activity, but no or low potential to inhibit MAO-A, MAO-B, or CYP450 isoforms 2A6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4 enzymes involved in drug biotransformation.

mentions.name: propafenone
mentions.excerpt: These patients metabolize propafenone into 2 active metabolites: 5-hydroxypropafenone, which is formed by CYP2D6, and N-depropylpropafenone (norpropafenone), which is formed by both CYP3A4 and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: propranolol
mentions.excerpt: Side-chain oxidation is mediated mainly by CYP1A2 and to some extent by CYP2D6. 4-hydroxy propranolol is a weak inhibitor of CYP2D6.

mentions.name: quinine sulphate
mentions.excerpt: Depending on the in vitro experimental conditions, other enzymes, including CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1 were shown to have some role in the metabolism of quinine.

mentions.name: quizartinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes Quizartinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: raltegravir
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro , raltegravir does not inhibit (IC50>100 µM) CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ramelteon
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 is the major isozyme involved in the hepatic metabolism of ramelteon; the CYP2C subfamily and CYP3A4 isozymes are also involved to a minor degree.

mentions.name: rasagiline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro experiments indicate that both routes of rasagiline metabolism are dependent on the cytochrome P450 (CYP) system, with CYP1A2 being the major isoenzyme involved in rasagiline metabolism.

mentions.name: regorafenib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggested that regorafenib is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4 enzyme activity.

mentions.name: relacorilant
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Relacorilant and CORT125295 are inducers of CYP1A2.

mentions.name: relugolix
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Relugolix is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: remibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with remibrutinib: oral midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), oral contraceptives containing ethinyl estradiol and levonorgestrel (CYP3A4 substrate), tolbutamide (CYP2C9 substrate), caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), and coproporphyrin I (an endogenous OATP1B substrate).

mentions.name: remimazolam
mentions.excerpt: There were no inducing effects on CYP1A2, 2B6, and 3A4.

mentions.name: repotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Repotrectinib does not induce CYP1A2.

mentions.name: reslizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro data indicate that IL-5 and reslizumab are unlikely to affect CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4 enzyme activity.

mentions.name: revefenacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Revefenacin and Cytochrome P450 Neither revefenacin nor its active metabolite inhibits the following cytochrome P450 isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: revumenib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Revumenib inhibits CYP3A4, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: ribociclib
mentions.excerpt: Drugs That are Affected by KISQALI CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 Substrates: In a cocktail study with midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate) multiple doses of ribociclib (400 mg once daily for 8 days) increased midazolam C max by 2.1-fold and increased AUC inf by 3.8-fold compared to midazolam alone.

mentions.name: riluzole
mentions.excerpt: Accumulation Approximately 2-fold Metabolism Fraction metabolized (% dose) At least 88% Primary metabolic pathway(s) [in vitro] Oxidation: CYP1A2 Direct and sequential glucoronidation: UGT-HP4 Active Metabolites Some metabolites appear pharmacologically active in vitro, but the clinical implications are not known.

mentions.name: rimegepant
mentions.excerpt: Rimegepant is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, or UGT1A1 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: ripretinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Ripretinib and DP-5439 are not inducers of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: risdiplam
mentions.excerpt: Effect of EVRYSDI on Other Drugs Risdiplam and its major circulating metabolite M1 did not induce CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, or 3A4 in vitro.

mentions.name: ritlecitinib
