mentions.excerpt: These pathways include: • Glutathione S-transferase (GST): cytosolic GST A1/3, M1/3/5, P1, S1, T2, Z1 and microsomal GST 1/2/3 • CYP enzymes (CYP3A, CYP2C8, CYP1A2, and CYP2C9) Excretion Approximately 66% of radiolabeled ritlecitinib dose is excreted in the urine and 20% in the feces.

mentions.name: rivastigmine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, no pharmacokinetic drug interactions with drugs metabolized by the following isoenzyme systems are expected: CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2E1, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2B6.

mentions.name: roflumilast
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies and clinical drug-drug interaction studies suggest that the biotransformation of roflumilast to its N-oxide metabolite is mediated by CYP1A2 and 3A4.

mentions.name: rolapitant
mentions.excerpt: Substrates for other CYP enzymes In vitro studies suggest that rolapitant is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: romidepsin
mentions.excerpt: At therapeutic concentrations, romidepsin did not competitively inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b njft
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: ropinirole
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that the major cytochrome P450 enzyme involved in the metabolism of ropinirole is CYP1A2, an enzyme known to be induced by smoking and omeprazole and inhibited by, for example, fluvoxamine, mexiletine, and the older fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin and norfloxacin.

mentions.name: rotigotine
mentions.excerpt: Rotigotine, the 5-O-glucuronide and its desalkyl and monohydroxy metabolites were analyzed for interactions with the human CYP isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: rucaparib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro, rucaparib is primarily metabolized by CYP2D6 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Ruxolitinib is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6 and CYP3A4 or induce CYP1A2, 2B6 and 3A4 following topical application.

mentions.name: sarecycline
mentions.excerpt: Sarecycline does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 isozymes, and does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, or BCRP.

mentions.name: saxagliptin
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, saxagliptin and its active metabolite did not inhibit CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A4, or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C9, or 3A4.

mentions.name: scopolamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study using human hepatocytes examined the induction of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 by scopolamine.

mentions.name: sebetralstat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Sebetralstat is a substrate of CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, and is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: selegiline
mentions.excerpt: Olanzapine In subjects who had received EMSAM 6 mg per 24 hours for 10 days, co-administration with olanzapine, a substrate for CYP1A2, CYP2D6, and possibly CYP2A6, did not affect the pharmacokinetics of selegiline or olanzapine [see Drug Interactions (7.4) and (7.5) ] .

mentions.name: selinexor
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Selinexor does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: selpercatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Selpercatinib does not inhibit or induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: selumetinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selumetinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2E1, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: sevabertinib

mentions.name: arformoterol
mentions.excerpt: Arformoterol did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A9/11 enzymes at >1,000-fold higher concentrations than the expected peak plasma concentrations following a therapeutic dose.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: asciminib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 Substrates: The S-warfarin AUC inf and C max increased by 41% and 8%, respectively, following coadministration of CYP2C9 substrate (warfarin) with SCEMBLIX at 40 mg twice daily.

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Clinically significant interactions are not expected between atazanavir and substrates of CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2B6, CYP2A6, CYP1A2, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), losartan (CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 substrate) or fexofenadine (P-gp substrate) were observed or expected when used concomitantly with VANRAFIA.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: Effect of TAVNEOS on Other Drug Substances In vitro studies indicate that avacopan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6, and does not induce CYP1A2 and CYP2B6, but shows induction and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avapritinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4, CYP3A5 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 in vitro.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Avatrombopag is primarily metabolized by cytochrome P450 CYP2C9 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: Defactinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicated that axitinib does not inhibit CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or UGT1A1 at therapeutic plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: azilsartan kamedoxomil
mentions.excerpt: The major enzyme responsible for azilsartan metabolism is CYP2C9.

mentions.name: azilsartan medoxomil
mentions.excerpt: The major enzyme responsible for azilsartan metabolism is CYP2C9.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Both baloxavir marboxil and baloxavir do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: balsalazide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Data In an in vitro study using human liver microsomes, balsalazide and its metabolites [5-aminosalicylic acid (5-ASA), Nacetyl-5-aminosalicylic acid (N-Ac-5-ASA), 4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (4-ABA) and N-acetyl-4-aminobenzoyl-ß-alanine (N-Ac-4-ABA)] were not shown to inhibit the major CYP enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: There were no clinically meaningful changes in the PK of baricitinib when co-administered with fluconazole (CYP3A/CYP2C19/CYP2C9 inhibitor) or rifampicin (CYP3A inducer).

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes: Baxdrostat did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: belatacept
mentions.excerpt: NULOJIX did not alter the pharmacokinetics of drugs that are substrates of CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C9 (losartan), CYP2D6 (dextromethorphan), CYP3A (midazolam), and CYP2C19 (omeprazole) [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: belinostat
mentions.excerpt: Belinostat also undergoes hepatic metabolism by CYP2A6, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: belumosudil
mentions.excerpt: Other drugs : Concomitant use of belumosudil is not predicted to have clinically significant effects on the exposure of ( S )-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and CYP2C8 substrates that are not an OATP1B1 substrate.

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Belzutifan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bempedoic acid
mentions.excerpt: Warfarin In vitro studies indicate that bempedoic acid is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP2C9.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: bepotastine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that bepotastine besilate does not inhibit the metabolism of various cytochrome P450 substrates via inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: bepotastine besilate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that bepotastine besilate does not inhibit the metabolism of various cytochrome P450 substrates via inhibition of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: berotralstat
mentions.excerpt: Effect of ORLADEYO on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs Berotralstat 150 mg once daily is a moderate inhibitor of CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and a weak inhibitor of CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Bexarotene on Other Drugs Bexarotene did not significantly inhibit the following enzymes in human liver microsomes: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: binimetinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Binimetinib on CYP Substrates: Binimetinib is not a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: bortezomib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Bortezomib is primarily oxidatively metabolized to several inactive metabolites in vitro via cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes 3A4, CYP2C19, and CYP1A2, and to a lesser extent by CYP2D6 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: bosentan
mentions.excerpt: Bosentan is an inducer of CYP2C9 and CYP3A and possibly also of CYP2C19.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Brensocatib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: brincidofovir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP Enzymes: Brincidofovir is a direct and reversible inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP4F2.

mentions.name: brivaracetam
mentions.excerpt: An additional hydroxy acid metabolite is created by hydrolysis of the amide moiety on the hydroxy metabolite or hydroxylation of the propyl side chain on the carboxylic acid metabolite (mainly by CYP2C9).

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP2C9 had a minimal effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation (i.e., a <20% reduction).

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP2C9 had a minimal effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation (i.e., a <20% reduction).

mentions.name: calcium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: canagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Canagliflozin did not inhibit the CYP450 isoenzymes (1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, or 2E1) and weakly inhibited CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 based on in vitro studies with human hepatic microsomes.

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 Substrates Coadministration of EPIDIOLEX (7.5 mg/kg twice daily) with a single dose of tolbutamide (500 mg), a moderately sensitive CYP2C9 substrate, did not result in changes in plasma exposures of tolbutamide compared to tolbutamide administered alone.

mentions.name: capecitabine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Capecitabine on Celecoxib: Concomitant administration of multiple doses of capecitabine (capecitabine tablets 1,000 mg/m 2 twice daily for 14 days) increased celecoxib (sensitive CYP2C9 substrate) AUC by 28%, C max by 24% and C trough by 30%.

mentions.name: capivasertib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Capivasertib on CYP2C9 Substrates: Concomitant use of TRUQAP with warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate) is not predicted to have a clinically meaningful effect on warfarin pharmacokinetics.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies Cariprazine and its major active metabolites did not induce CYP1A2 and CYP3A4 enzymes and were weak inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen was a potential inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19 in vitro ; however, considering its short plasma half-life and lack of plasma accumulation with the weekly dosing regimen, clinical drug interaction with substrates for these enzymes is unlikely.

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with cenobamate.

mentions.name: ceritinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Ceritinib on CYP2C9 Substrates: Coadministration of a single dose of warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate) following 3 weeks of ZYKADIA (750 mg daily under fasted conditions) increased the S-warfarin AUC by 54% with no change in C max compared to warfarin administered alone [see Drug Interactions (7.2)] .

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: It is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and CYP2A6, and mild-to-moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: cinacalcet
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate that cinacalcet is a strong inhibitor of CYP2D6, but not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies: Clobazam did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, UGT1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, or UGT2B4 in vitro.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Drug Interactions In vitro studies in human liver microsomes have shown that colchicine is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4 activity.

mentions.name: copper histidinate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro Studies: Copper histidinate is a weak inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 (IC 50 >100 μM).

mentions.name: crisaborole
mentions.excerpt: The most sensitive enzyme, CYP2C9, was further investigated in a clinical trial using warfarin as a CYP2C9 substrate.

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: Crizotinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dabigatran etexilate
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Dabigatran on Other Drugs In clinical studies exploring CYP3A4, CYP2C9, P-gp and other pathways, dabigatran did not meaningfully alter the pharmacokinetics of amiodarone, atorvastatin, clarithromycin, diclofenac, clopidogrel, digoxin, pantoprazole, or ranitidine. dabigartanfigure31 dabigartanfigure32

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of TAFINLAR 150 mg twice daily for 15 days and a single dose of warfarin decreased the AUC of S-warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate) by 37% and the AUC of R-warfarin (CYP3A4/CYP1A2 substrate) by 33%.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Dacomitinib and O-desmethyl Dacomitinib on CYP Enzymes: Dacomitinib and its metabolite O-desmethyl dacomitinib do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Dalfampridine on Co-administered Drugs In vitro data with human liver microsomes showed that dalfampridine was not a direct or time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Effect of Danicopan on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs: Dedicated clinical drug interaction studies showed no clinically significant drug interactions with danicopan as an inhibitor or inducer of CYP2B6 (bupropion), CYP2C9 (warfarin), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP3A4 (midazolam), and UGT1A1 and UGT2B7 (mycophenolic acid).

mentions.name: daprodustat
mentions.excerpt: Daprodustat is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and P-gp.

mentions.name: darifenacin
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Darifenacin on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies: Based on in vitro human microsomal studies, darifenacin extended-release tablet is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2 or CYP2C9 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan dlnk
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: defactinib
mentions.excerpt: Defactinib is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: delafloxacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Delafloxacin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit the cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 in vitro in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: delgocitinib
mentions.excerpt: The limited metabolism of delgocitinib occurs primarily though CYP3A4/5 and to a lesser extent by CYP1A1, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: deucravacitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Deucravacitinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: deuruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Deuruxolitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 (76%) and CYP3A4 (21%) and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2 (3%).

mentions.name: deutetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of AUSTEDO/AUSTEDO XR on Other Drugs CYP Enzymes In vitro studies showed that at clinically relevant concentrations, deutetrabenazine, and its active metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 enzymes, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: dexlansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: Furthermore, in vivo studies showed that dexlansoprazole did not have an impact on the pharmacokinetics of coadministered phenytoin (CYP2C9 substrate) or theophylline (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: diazepam
mentions.excerpt: No inhibition was demonstrated in the presence of inhibitors selective for CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2, indicating that these enzymes are not significantly involved in metabolism of diazepam.

mentions.name: dichlorphenamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dichlorphenamide is not a substrate for CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 isoforms when tested in vitro .

mentions.name: difamilast
mentions.excerpt: Difamilast is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: difelikefalin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Difelikefalin is not metabolized by cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C19, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 or CYP3A observed in human hepatic microsomes or hepatocytes, in vitro.

mentions.name: diroximel
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies found diroximel fumarate and its metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 enzymes in human liver microsomes or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4/5 in cultured human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: dordaviprone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dordaviprone is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 with minor contribution from CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: doxepin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that CYP2C19 and CYP2D6 are the major enzymes involved in doxepin metabolism, and that CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 are involved to a lesser extent.

mentions.name: dronabinol
mentions.excerpt: Published in vitro data indicates that CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 are the primary enzymes in the metabolism of dronabinol.

mentions.name: dronedarone
mentions.excerpt: Dronedarone has no significant potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2C8 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: dutasteride
mentions.excerpt: Dutasteride is not metabolized in vitro by human cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: edaravone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that, at the recommended dosage, edaravone and its metabolites are not expected to significantly inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A), conjugating enzymes UGT1A1 and UGT2B7, or other transporters (P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K) in humans.

mentions.name: efavirenz
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of efavirenz with drugs primarily metabolized by CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A, or CYP2B6 isozymes may result in altered plasma concentrations of the coadministered drug.

mentions.name: efinaconazole
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies using human liver microsomes, efinaconazole did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2PE1 and CYP3A4 enzyme activities at expected clinical systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: elacestrant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Elacestrant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2A6 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: elafibranor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Effect of IQIRVO on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro Studies: Elafibranor, GFT1007 and GFT3351 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: elamipretide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies CYP enzymes: Elamipretide does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: elexacaftor ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Elexacaftor, Tezacaftor and/or Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Based on in vitro results, elexacaftor and tezacaftor have a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, whereas ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: eltrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Eltrombopag on Other Drugs Effect of Eltrombopag on Cytochrome P450 Enzymes Substrates: The coadministration of multiple doses of eltrombopag (once daily for 7 days) did not result in the inhibition or induction of the metabolism of a combination of probe substrates for CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) in humans.

mentions.name: eltrombopag choline
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Eltrombopag on Other Drugs Effect of Eltrombopag on Cytochrome P450 Enzymes Substrates: The coadministration of multiple doses of eltrombopag (once daily for 7 days) did not result in the inhibition or induction of the metabolism of a combination of probe substrates for CYP1A2 (caffeine), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) in humans.

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate that eluxadoline is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: emtricitabine
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations up to 14-fold higher than those observed in vivo, FTC did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: enasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of enasidenib is mediated by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4), and by multiple UDP glucuronosyl transferases (UGTs) (e.g., UGT1A1, UGT1A3, UGT1A4, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, and UGT2B15) in vitro.

mentions.name: encorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of encorafenib on Other CYP Substrates: There was no clinically significant effect of repeat dose administration of BRAFTOVI 450 mg once daily and binimetinib 45 mg twice daily on the exposure of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ensartinib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Ensartinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ensifentrine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro results indicate that, at physiologically relevant concentrations, ensifentrine was predominantly metabolized by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ensitrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Ensitrelvir does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: enzalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of XTANDI 160 mg orally once daily with warfarin (a sensitive CYP2C9 substrate) decreased S‑warfarin AUC by 56% and C max by 17%.

mentions.name: eplerenone
mentions.excerpt: Eplerenone is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: erdafitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Erdafitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: eribulin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Eribulin on CYP Substrates: Eribulin shows no induction potential for CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A in primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: esketamine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Esketamine is primarily metabolized to noresketamine metabolite via cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: estazolam
mentions.excerpt: The ability of estazolam to induce or inhibit human enzyme systems The results from in vitro human liver microsomal studies suggest that at therapeutic concentrations, estazolam has no significant inhibitory effect on the major human cytochrome P450 enzyme activities (i.e., CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A).

mentions.name: estetrol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies E4 is not a substrate of CYP1A1, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K.

mentions.name: eteplirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data showed that eteplirsen did not significantly inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: etrasimod arginine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Etrasimod is metabolized by oxidation and dehydrogenation mediated primarily by CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4, with a minor contribution by CYP2C19 and CYP2J2.

mentions.name: etravirine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro experiments with human liver microsomes (HLMs) indicate that etravirine primarily undergoes metabolism by CYP3A, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19 enzymes.

mentions.name: etripamil
mentions.excerpt: Etripamil inhibits CYP2D6, CYP3A4, and CYP2C9 but does not inhibit CYP2B6 or CYP2C8.

mentions.name: fam trastuzumab deruxtecan nxki
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A nor induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: fenfluramine
mentions.excerpt: Other CYP enzymes involved to a minor extent are CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: They are weak inhibitors of CYP2C8, CYP2C19 and CYP2A6, and mild-to-moderate inhibitors of CYP2C9 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: fenofibric acid
mentions.excerpt: It is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and CYP2A6, and mild-to-moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: fexinidazole
mentions.excerpt: This model-based analysis predicted no significant drug interaction of fexinidazole with drugs that are substrates of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: fezolinetant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Fezolinetant is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fidaxomicin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vivo studies were conducted to evaluate intestinal drug-drug interactions of fidaxomicin as a P-gp substrate, P-gp inhibitor, and inhibitor of major CYP enzymes expressed in the gastrointestinal tract (CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19).

mentions.name: finerenone
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed or predicted when used concomitantly with finerenone: S-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), digoxin (P-gp substrate), and rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP substrate).

mentions.name: fingolimod
mentions.excerpt: Potential of Fingolimod and Fingolimod-phosphate to Induce its Own and/or the Metabolism of Comedications Fingolimod was examined for its potential to induce human CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP4F2, and MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) mRNA and CYP3A, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP4F2 activity in primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: fingolimod lauryl
mentions.excerpt: Potential of Fingolimod and Fingolimod-phosphate to Induce its Own and/or the Metabolism of Comedications Fingolimod was examined for its potential to induce human CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP4F2, and MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) mRNA and CYP3A, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP4F2 activity in primary human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: flibanserin
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro and/or in vivo data, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 contribute minimally to the metabolism of flibanserin.

mentions.name: flurbiprofen
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have demonstrated that cytochrome CYP2C9 plays an important role in the metabolism of flurbiprofen to its major metabolite 4'-hydroxy-flurbiprofen.

mentions.name: fluvastatin
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 isoenzyme is primarily involved in the metabolism of fluvastatin (approximately 75%), while CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 isoenzymes are involved to a much less extent, i.e., approximately 5% and approximately 20%, respectively.

mentions.name: formoterol
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that multiple drug-metabolizing enzymes catalyze glucuronidation (UGT1A1, 1A8, 1A9, 2B7 and 2B15 were the most predominant enzymes) and O-demethylation (CYP2D6, CYP2C19, CYP2C9 and CYP2A6) of formoterol.

mentions.name: fosamprenavir
mentions.excerpt: Amprenavir does not inhibit CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or uridine glucuronosyltransferase (UDPGT).

mentions.name: fosaprepitant dimeglumine
mentions.excerpt: No metabolism by CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1 was detected.

mentions.name: fosdenopterin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Fosdenopterin does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fosfomycin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Fosfomycin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: fosphenytoin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Phenytoin derived from administration of CEREBYX is extensively metabolized in the liver by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19.

mentions.name: fruquintinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A and to a lesser extent CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19 are the CYP450 enzymes involved in fruquintinib metabolism.

mentions.name: futibatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Futibatinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: gabapentin enacarbil
mentions.excerpt: Neither gabapentin enacarbil nor gabapentin are substrates, inhibitors, or inducers of the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: ganaxolone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes Ganaxolone does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: gefitinib
mentions.excerpt: In human liver microsome studies, gefitinib had no inhibitory effect on CYP1A2, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 activities at concentrations ranging from 2 to 5000 ng/mL.

mentions.name: gemtuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies At clinically relevant concentrations, gemtuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: givosiran
mentions.excerpt: Effect of givosiran on other CYP450 Substrates: Concomitant use of a single subcutaneous dose of givosiran 2.5 mg/kg increased losartan (CYP2C9 substrate) AUC by 1.1-fold with no change in C max ; increased omeprazole (sensitive CYP2C19 substrate) AUC by 1.6-fold and C max by 1.1-fold; increased midazolam (sensitive CYP3A4 substrate) AUC by 1.5-fold and C max by 1.2-fold.

mentions.name: glasdegib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Glasdegib on Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Substrates: Glasdegib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A, and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A in vitro .

mentions.name: glycerol phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, PBA at a concentration of 800 micrograms/mL caused greater than 60% reversible inhibition of cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 (testosterone 6β-hydroxylase activity).

mentions.name: golodirsen
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Golodirsen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5 in vitro .

mentions.name: guanfacine
mentions.excerpt: In pooled human hepatic microsomes, guanfacine did not inhibit the activities of the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5); guanfacine is also not an inducer of CYP3A, CYP1A2 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: guselkumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates The effects of guselkumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (metabolized by CYP3A4), warfarin (metabolized by CYP2C9), omeprazole (metabolized by CYP2C19), dextromethorphan (metabolized by CYP2D6), and caffeine (metabolized by CYP1A2) were evaluated in an exploratory study with 6 to 12 evaluable subjects with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.

mentions.name: iberdomide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Iberdomide does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ibuprofen lysine
mentions.excerpt: Ibuprofen is eliminated primarily by metabolism in the liver where CYP2C9 mediates the 2- and 3-hydroxylations of R- and S-ibuprofen.

mentions.name: icotrokinra
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Icotrokinra does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: iloperidone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Based on the in vitro data, iloperidone is not a substrate for CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2E1 enzymes.

mentions.name: imatinib
mentions.excerpt: Other cytochrome P450 enzymes, such as CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19, play a minor role in its metabolism.

mentions.name: imlunestrant
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Imlunestrant is an inhibitor of CYP2B6 and CYP2C9 but is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2.

mentions.name: inavolisib
mentions.excerpt: Inavolisib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: inotuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, inotuzumab ozogamicin had a low potential to: • Inhibit CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5. • Induce CYP450 Enzymes : CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: irbesartan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate irbesartan is oxidized primarily by CYP2C9; metabolism by CYP3A4 is negligible.

mentions.name: isavuconazonium
mentions.excerpt: Isavuconazole is an inhibitor of CYP3A4, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: istradefylline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that istradefylline is primarily metabolized via CYP1A1 and CYP3A4, with minor contribution from CYP1A2, 2B6, 2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, and 2D6.

mentions.name: ivacaftor
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that ivacaftor and M1 may inhibit CYP2C9.

mentions.name: ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro results, ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP3A and P-gp, and may also inhibit CYP2C9.

mentions.name: ivosidenib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Metabolic Pathways Ivosidenib may induce CYP2B6, CYP2C8, and CYP2C9 .

mentions.name: ixabepilone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that clinically relevant concentrations of ixabepilone do not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ixekizumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed in subjects with plaque psoriasis when used concomitantly with a single 160 mg dose of ixekizumab, or multiple doses of 80 mg every 2 weeks.

mentions.name: lacosamide
mentions.excerpt: The CYP isoforms mainly responsible for the formation of the major metabolite (O-desmethyl) are CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: lansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: These compounds are metabolized through various cytochrome P450 isozymes including CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: lanthanum carbonate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Lanthanum carbonate has a low potential for systemic drug-drug interactions because of the very low bioavailability of lanthanum and because it is not a substrate or inhibitor of major cytochrome P450 enzyme groups involved in drug metabolism (CYP1A2, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: larotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Larotrectinib on CYP Substrates: Larotrectinib is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: lasmiditan
mentions.excerpt: Daily dosing of lasmiditan did not alter the PK of midazolam, caffeine, or tolbutamide, which are substrates of CYP3A, CYP1A2, and CYP2C9, respectively.

mentions.name: lemborexant
mentions.excerpt: Physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling predicted that concomitant use of weak CYP3A inhibitors increased lemborexant exposure by less than 2-fold [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.2 ), Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )] , and that lemborexant is expected to have minimal effect on the pharmacokinetics of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2C19 substrates.

mentions.name: lenacapavir
mentions.excerpt: (substrate of CYP3A) 0.54 (0.50, 0.59) 0.76 (0.72, 0.80) Midazolam (1 day after lenacapavir, fed) (substrate of CYP3A) 2.5 single dose 2.16 (2.02, 2.30) 4.08 (3.77, 4.41) 1-hydroxymidazolam (substrate of CYP3A) 0.52 (0.48, 0.57) 0.84 (0.80, 0.88) In Vitro Studies Lenacapavir is not a substrate, inducer, or inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: lenvatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies with Substrates of CYP or UDP-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT) : Lenvatinib inhibits CYP2C8, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: letermovir
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, the metabolism of letermovir is not mediated by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP4A11, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A7, UGT1A8, UGT1A9, UGT1A10, UGT2B4, UGT2B7, UGT2B15, or UGT2B17.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: Levoketoconazole does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6, does not induce CYP2B6, and does not inhibit the OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that levomilnacipran is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: linagliptin
mentions.excerpt: In vivo studies indicated evidence of a low propensity for causing drug interactions with substrates of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, P-gp and organic cationic transporter (OCT).

mentions.name: linezolid
mentions.excerpt: Concurrent administration of linezolid does not substantially alter the pharmacokinetic characteristics of (S)-warfarin, which is extensively metabolized by CYP2C9.

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Lonafarnib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: lorlatinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 Substrates : LORBRENA 100 mg orally once daily for 15 days decreased AUC by 43% and C max by 15% of a single oral 100 mg dose of tolbutamide (a sensitive CYP2C9 substrate).

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies: Lumateperone showed little to no inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: lurasidone
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, lurasidone hydrochloride is not a substrate of CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP4A11, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1 enzymes.

mentions.name: lurbinectedin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes : Lurbinectedin is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: lusutrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : lusutrombopag has low potential to inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: macitentan
mentions.excerpt: This reaction is dependent on the cytochrome P450 (CYP) system, mainly CYP3A4 with minor contributions of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: maraviroc
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also indicate that polymorphic enzymes CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP2C19 do not contribute significantly to the metabolism of maraviroc.

mentions.name: maribavir
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Based on in vitro studies, the metabolism of maribavir is not mediated by CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A5, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A10, or UGT2B15.

mentions.name: mavacamten
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Mavacamten is extensively metabolized, primarily through CYP2C19 (74%), CYP3A4 (18%), and CYP2C9 (8%).

mentions.name: mavorixafor
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), losartan (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), furosemide (OAT1 and OAT3 substrate) and oral contraceptives were observed following concomitant use with mavorixafor.

mentions.name: mefenamic acid
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Mefenamic acid is metabolized by cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP2C9 to 3-hydroxymethyl mefenamic acid (Metabolite I).

mentions.name: metaxalone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Metaxalone is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: methylene blue
mentions.excerpt: Possible time-dependent inhibition of CYP2C9, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4/5 (testosterone as substrate) was also observed.

mentions.name: methylnaltrexone
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Methylnaltrexone and its Metabolites on CYP Enzymes In vitro, methylnaltrexone did not significantly inhibit or induce the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: miglustat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Miglustat does not inhibit the metabolism of various substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes including, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A11 in vitro ; consequently, significant interactions via inhibition of these enzymes are unlikely with drugs that are substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes.

mentions.name: milnacipran
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: In general, milnacipran, at concentrations that were at least 25 times those attained in clinical trials, did not inhibit human CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5 enzyme systems, indicating a low potential of interactions with drugs metabolized by these enzymes.

mentions.name: mirabegron
mentions.excerpt: Sulfonylurea hypoglycemic agents glibenclamide (a CYP3A4 substrate), gliclazide (a CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 substrate), and tolbutamide (a CYP2C9 substrate) did not affect the in vitro metabolism of mirabegron.

mentions.name: mirikizumab
mentions.excerpt: Based on a clinical drug-drug interaction study conducted in subjects with another condition, multiple subcutaneous doses of 250 mg every 4 weeks of mirikizumab-mrkz did not result in changes in the exposure of midazolam (CYP3A substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), or caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: mirikizumab mrkz
mentions.excerpt: Based on a clinical drug-drug interaction study conducted in subjects with another condition, multiple subcutaneous doses of 250 mg every 4 weeks of mirikizumab-mrkz did not result in changes in the exposure of midazolam (CYP3A substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), or caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate).

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl DM4 are not inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine gynx
mentions.excerpt: Unconjugated DM4 and S-methyl DM4 are not inhibitors of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: mitapivat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies CYP450 and UGT Enzymes Mitapivat induces CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and UGT1A1 .

mentions.name: momelotinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Momelotinib is metabolized by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes including CYP3A4 (36%), CYP2C8 (19%), CYP2C9 (17%), CYP2C19 (19%), and CYP1A2 (9%).

mentions.name: moxifloxacin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with cytochrome (CYP) P450 enzymes indicate that moxifloxacin does not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: naldemedine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Naldemedine on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naldemedine did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (including CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A11 isozymes) and is not an inhibitor of transporters (including OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BCRP, or P-gp).

mentions.name: naloxegol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of MOVANTIK on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naloxegol did not show a significant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP3A4 or CYP2C19, nor a significant induction effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: nateglinide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro drug metabolism studies indicate that Nateglinide Tablets are predominantly metabolized by the cytochrome P450 isozyme CYP2C9 (70%) and to a lesser extent CYP3A4 (30%).

mentions.name: nelfinavir
mentions.excerpt: The potential ability of nelfinavir to inhibit the major human cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP3A, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP1A2 and CYP2E1) has been investigated in vitro .

mentions.name: nemolizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nemolizumab ilto
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies The effects of nemolizumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4/5 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), metoprolol (CYP2D6 substrate), and caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate) were evaluated in a study in 14 subjects with moderate to severe AD receiving an initial SC dose of 60 mg followed by 30 mg SC every four weeks for 12 weeks.

mentions.name: nepafenac
mentions.excerpt: Nepafenac at concentrations up to 3000 ng/mL and amfenac at concentrations up to 1000 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of six specific marker substrates of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: nerandomilast
mentions.excerpt: Nerandomilast does not inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: nilotinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C9 Substrates: Single-dose of nilotinib did not change the pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate).

mentions.name: niraparib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 ( CYP) Enzymes: Niraparib and M1 did not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Ritonavir is an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir ritonavir
mentions.excerpt: Ritonavir is an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2B6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: nirogacestat
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences were predicted in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs when used concomitantly with nirogacestat: rosiglitazone (CYP2C8 substrate) or S-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate).

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Nitisinone is a moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9, and a weak inducer of CYP2E1 (Table 5).

mentions.name: oliceridine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism In vitro studies suggest that oliceridine is metabolized primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 P450 hepatic enzymes, with minor contributions from CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 into inactive metabolites.

mentions.name: olodaterol
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 isozymes CYP2C9 and CYP2C8, with negligible contribution of CYP3A4, are involved in the O-demethylation of olodaterol, while uridine diphosphate glycosyl transferase isoforms UGT2B7, UGT1A1, 1A7, and 1A9 were shown to be involved in the formation of olodaterol glucuronides.

mentions.name: olopatadine
mentions.excerpt: Olopatadine at concentrations up to 33,900 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of specific substrates for CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: olutasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Olutasidenib is primarily (90%) metabolized by cytochrome P450(CYP)3A4, with minor contributions from CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP1A2, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: omaveloxolone
mentions.excerpt: Omaveloxolone is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: opicapone
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when administered concomitantly with opicapone: S-warfarin (index substrate of CYP2C9), R-Warfarin (substrate of CYP1A2 and CYP3A4), or repaglinide (index substrate of CYP2C8 and OATP1B1).

mentions.name: orforglipron
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Assessments of Drug Interactions CYP Enzymes : In in vitro studies, orforglipron did not inhibit or induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: oritavancin
mentions.excerpt: ORBACTIV was also a weak inhibitor of CYP2C19 (increase of 15% in the ratio of omeprazole to 5-OH-omeprazole concentrations in the plasma after administration of omeprazole) and also showed to be a weak inhibitor of CYP2C9 (with an increase of 31% in the mean AUC of warfarin) [see Warnings and Precautions (5.5) , and Drug Interactions (7.1) ] .

mentions.name: ospemifene
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism In vitro experiments with human liver microsomes indicated that ospemifene primarily undergoes metabolism via CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: oxcarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: Results demonstrate that oxcarbazepine and its pharmacologically active 10-monohydroxy metabolite (MHD) have little or no capacity to function as inhibitors for most of the human cytochrome P450 enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP4A9 and CYP4A11) with the exception of CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: pacritinib
mentions.excerpt: Pacritinib shows less direct inhibition towards CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 (Ki >10 µM).

mentions.name: palonosetron
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies indicated that palonosetron is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 (CYP2C19 was not investigated) nor does it induce the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: palovarotene
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Palovarotene is an inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2B6, but not CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: paltusotine
mentions.excerpt: Paltusotine does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, UGT1A6, or UGT2B15.

mentions.name: paricalcitol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions An in vitro study indicates that paricalcitol is neither an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A nor an inducer of CYP2B6, CYP2C9 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: pazopanib
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2, CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 Substrates: Clinical studies, using pazopanib tablets 800 mg once daily, have demonstrated that pazopanib does not have a clinically relevant effect on the pharmacokinetics of caffeine (CYP1A2 probe substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 probe substrate), or omeprazole (CYP2C19 probe substrate) in patients with cancer.

mentions.name: pemetrexed
mentions.excerpt: Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 Enzymes In vitro studies suggest that pemetrexed does not inhibit the clearance of drugs metabolized by CYP3A, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: pemetrexed disodium hemipentahydrate
mentions.excerpt: Drugs Metabolized by Cytochrome P450 Enzymes In vitro studies suggest that pemetrexed does not inhibit the clearance of drugs metabolized by CYP3A, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, and CYP1A2.

mentions.name: pemigatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Pemigatinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 or an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: perampanel
mentions.excerpt: Perampanel did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, UGT1A4, and UGT1A6 up to a concentration of 30 µmol/L.

mentions.name: pexidartinib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: When coadministered with omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), tolbutamide (CYP2C9 substrate), digoxin (P-gp substrate), or CYP2C8 substrate with TURALIO, no clinically significant differences in their pharmacokinetics were observed or predicted.

mentions.name: phenobarbital
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Published literature reports that phenobarbital is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and UGTs.

mentions.name: phenytoin
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Phenytoin is metabolized by the hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19.

mentions.name: pirfenidone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: In vitro profiling studies in hepatocytes and liver microsomes have shown that pirfenidone is primarily metabolized in the liver by CYP1A2 and multiple other CYPs (CYP2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 2E1).

mentions.name: piroxicam
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate cytochrome P4502C9 (CYP2C9) as the main enzyme involved in the formation to the 5′-hydroxy-piroxicam, the major metabolite [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.5 )].

mentions.name: pirtobrutinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 Substrates: Pirtobrutinib did not have a clinically meaningful effect on the exposures of caffeine (sensitive CYP1A2 substrate) or S-warfarin (moderate sensitive CYP2C9 substrate).

mentions.name: pitavastatin
mentions.excerpt: Pitavastatin is marginally metabolized by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8.

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : FGN849 is primarily a CYP3A substrate but is not a significant substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine pvzy
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : FGN849 is primarily a CYP3A substrate but is not a significant substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: plazomicin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Drug-Metabolizing Enzymes Plazomicin does not inhibit the following cytochrome P450 isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: ponatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Ponatinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A, or CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: potassium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: pralsetinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Pralsetinib is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP3A and an inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A, but not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19 or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: pramipexole
mentions.excerpt: Pramipexole does not inhibit CYP enzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: prasugrel
mentions.excerpt: It is rapidly hydrolyzed in the intestine to a thiolactone, which is then converted to the active metabolite by a single step, primarily by CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: pretomanid
mentions.excerpt: Pretomanid is not a substrate of CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: quinine sulphate
mentions.excerpt: Depending on the in vitro experimental conditions, other enzymes, including CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1 were shown to have some role in the metabolism of quinine.

mentions.name: quizartinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes Quizartinib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: raltegravir
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro , raltegravir does not inhibit (IC50>100 µM) CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ramelteon
mentions.excerpt: Fluconazole (strong CYP2C9 inhibitor) The total and peak systemic exposure (AUC 0-inf and C max ) of ramelteon after a single 16 mg dose of ramelteon was increased by approximately 150% when administered with fluconazole.

mentions.name: rasagiline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that rasagiline at a concentration of 1 mcg/mL (equivalent to a level that is 160 times the average C max ~ 5.9 to 8.5 ng/mL in Parkinson’s disease patients after 1 mg rasagiline multiple dosing) did not inhibit cytochrome P450 isoenzymes, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A.

mentions.name: regorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Regorafenib on Cytochrome P450 Substrates: In vitro studies suggested that regorafenib is an inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2B6, CYP3A4 and CYP2C19;

mentions.name: relacorilant
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with relacorilant: metoprolol (CYP2D6), tolbutamide (CYP2C9), omeprazole (CYP2C19), or dabigatran etexilate (P-gp).

mentions.name: relugolix
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Relugolix is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: remibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with remibrutinib: oral midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), oral contraceptives containing ethinyl estradiol and levonorgestrel (CYP3A4 substrate), tolbutamide (CYP2C9 substrate), caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), and coproporphyrin I (an endogenous OATP1B substrate).

mentions.name: repotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Repotrectinib induces CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2C9 and inhibits CYP3A4/5 (GI tract).

mentions.name: revefenacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Revefenacin and Cytochrome P450 Neither revefenacin nor its active metabolite inhibits the following cytochrome P450 isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: revumenib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Revumenib inhibits CYP3A4, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: ribociclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro evaluations indicated that ribociclib has no potential to inhibit the activities of CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: rimegepant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Rimegepant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9.

mentions.name: ritlecitinib
mentions.excerpt: These pathways include: • Glutathione S-transferase (GST): cytosolic GST A1/3, M1/3/5, P1, S1, T2, Z1 and microsomal GST 1/2/3 • CYP enzymes (CYP3A, CYP2C8, CYP1A2, and CYP2C9) Excretion Approximately 66% of radiolabeled ritlecitinib dose is excreted in the urine and 20% in the feces.

mentions.name: rivastigmine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, no pharmacokinetic drug interactions with drugs metabolized by the following isoenzyme systems are expected: CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2E1, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2B6.

mentions.name: romidepsin
mentions.excerpt: At therapeutic concentrations, romidepsin did not competitively inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b njft
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: rotigotine
mentions.excerpt: Rotigotine, the 5-O-glucuronide and its desalkyl and monohydroxy metabolites were analyzed for interactions with the human CYP isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Ruxolitinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9 in vitro.

mentions.name: sarecycline
mentions.excerpt: Sarecycline does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 isozymes, and does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, or BCRP.

mentions.name: sebetralstat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Sebetralstat is a substrate of CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, and is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: seladelpar lysine
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Seladelpar is primarily metabolized in vitro by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4, resulting in the three major metabolites: seladelpar sulfoxide (M1), desethyl-seladelpar (M2), and desethyl-seladelpar sulfoxide (M3).

mentions.name: selegiline
mentions.excerpt: CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 appeared to be the major contributing enzymes in the formation of R(-)-methamphetamine from selegiline, with CYP2A6 having a minor role.

mentions.name: selinexor
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Selinexor does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: selpercatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Selpercatinib does not inhibit or induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: selumetinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selumetinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2E1, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: sevabertinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro studies CYP450 Enzymes: Sevabertinib inhibits CYP1A1 and CYP2C8 but does not inhibit CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, CYP2C19, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: sildenafil
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism and Excretion: Sildenafil is cleared predominantly by the CYP3A4 (major route) and CYP2C9 (minor route) hepatic microsomal isoenzymes.

mentions.name: silodosin
mentions.excerpt: Other Metabolic Enzymes and Transporters In vitro studies indicated that silodosin administration is not likely to inhibit the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, and P-gp.

mentions.name: siponimod
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Siponimod is extensively metabolized, mainly via CYP2C9 accounting for 80% of the metabolism in those who are normal metabolizers (i.e., those with the CYP2C9*1/*1 genotype).

mentions.name: sodium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: sonidegib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Sonidegib on Cytochrome P450 Enzymes and Transporters In vitro studies suggested that sonidegib inhibits CYP2B6 and CYP2C9 and it does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6 or CYP3A expression or activity.

mentions.name: sorafenib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Sorafenib competitively inhibited CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: sotorasib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Sotorasib may induce CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Sparsentan on Other Drugs CYP2C9 substrates: Concomitant use with sparsentan decreased the exposure of tolbutamide (CYP2C9 substrate) C max by 9% and AUC 0-inf by 25%.

mentions.name: sunitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies In vitro studies in human hepatocytes and microsomes indicated that sunitinib and the primary active metabolite do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4/5, or inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, and CYP4A9/11 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: suvorexant
mentions.excerpt: Figure 1: Effects of Co-Administered Drugs on the Pharmacokinetics of Suvorexant Figure 1 Effects of BELSOMRA on Other Drugs In vitro metabolism studies demonstrate that suvorexant has the potential to inhibit CYP3A and intestinal P-gp; however, suvorexant is unlikely to cause clinically significant inhibition of human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: suzetrigine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) Enzymes: Suzetrigine inhibits CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19, but is not expected to result in clinically significant drug interactions.

mentions.name: tafamidis
mentions.excerpt: Tafamidis does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4/5 or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: tafenoquine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant effects on the pharmacokinetics of substrates of cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP)1A2 (caffeine), CYP2D6 (desipramine), CYP2C9 (flurbiprofen), or CYP3A4 (midazolam) were observed following coadministration with tafenoquine in healthy adult subjects.

mentions.name: talazoparib
mentions.excerpt: CYP Enzymes: Talazoparib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: taletrectinib adipate
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9 are the CYP450 enzymes involved in taletrectinib metabolism.

mentions.name: tapentadol
mentions.excerpt: Tapentadol is additionally metabolized to N-desmethyl tapentadol (13%) by CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 and to hydroxy tapentadol (2%) by CYP2D6, which are further metabolized by conjugation.

mentions.name: tapinarof
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tapinarof is not an inhibitor of CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: tasimelteon
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies No potential drug interactions were identified in in vitro studies with CYP inducers or inhibitors of CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9/2C19, CYP2E1, CYP2D6, and transporters including P-glycoprotein, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, and OAT3.

mentions.name: tazemetostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Metabolic Enzymes: Tazemetostat does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tecovirimat
mentions.excerpt: Tecovirimat is not an inhibitor or an inducer of CYP2B6 or CYP2C9.

mentions.name: tenapanor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies CYP Metabolism Mediated Drug Interactions Tenapanor and M1 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 in vitro.

mentions.name: tenofovir disoproxil
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations substantially higher (~300-fold) than those observed in vivo, tenofovir did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: tepotinib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed or predicted when coadministered with tepotinib: midazolam (sensitive CYP3A substrate) or CYP2C9 substrates.

mentions.name: teriflunomide
mentions.excerpt: Teriflunomide did not affect the pharmacokinetics of bupropion (a CYP2B6 substrate), midazolam (a CYP3A4 substrate), S-warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (a CYP2C19 substrate), and metoprolol (a CYP2D6 substrate).

mentions.name: tetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies do not suggest that tetrabenazine, α-HTBZ, β-HTBZ or 9‑ desmethyl-β-DHTBZ are likely to result in clinically significant inhibition of CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab asmn
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tinidazole
mentions.excerpt: In an in vitro metabolic drug interaction study, tinidazole concentrations of up to 75 µg/mL did not inhibit the enzyme activities of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin

mentions.name: dalfampridine

mentions.name: golodirsen

mentions.name: gozetotide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP450 enzymes Gozetotide is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: guanfacine
mentions.excerpt: In pooled human hepatic microsomes, guanfacine did not inhibit the activities of the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5); guanfacine is also not an inducer of CYP3A, CYP1A2 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: guselkumab
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 Substrates The effects of guselkumab on the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (metabolized by CYP3A4), warfarin (metabolized by CYP2C9), omeprazole (metabolized by CYP2C19), dextromethorphan (metabolized by CYP2D6), and caffeine (metabolized by CYP1A2) were evaluated in an exploratory study with 6 to 12 evaluable subjects with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis.

mentions.name: haloperidol decanoate
mentions.excerpt: The cytochrome P450 enzyme system is also involved, particularly CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2D6.

mentions.name: hydrocodone

mentions.name: iberdomide

mentions.name: ibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: It is metabolized to several metabolites primarily by cytochrome P450 (CYP) 3A and to a minor extent by CYP2D6.

mentions.name: icotrokinra

mentions.name: iloperidone

mentions.name: imatinib

mentions.name: imlunestrant

mentions.name: inavolisib

mentions.name: inotuzumab ozogamicin

mentions.name: iptacopan
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of iptacopan includes N-dealkylation, O-deethylation, oxidation, and dehydrogenation, mostly driven by CYP2C8 (98%) with a small contribution from CYP2D6 (2%).

mentions.name: isavuconazonium

mentions.name: ivacaftor tezacaftor

mentions.name: ixabepilone

mentions.name: ixekizumab
mentions.excerpt: The potential effect of ixekizumab on the CYP2D6 activity cannot be ruled out due to high variability in exposure (approximately ±2-fold) of dextromethorphan and its CYP2D6 metabolite dextrorphan in psoriasis subjects.

mentions.name: lansoprazole
mentions.excerpt: These compounds are metabolized through various cytochrome P450 isozymes including CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: lanthanum carbonate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Lanthanum carbonate has a low potential for systemic drug-drug interactions because of the very low bioavailability of lanthanum and because it is not a substrate or inhibitor of major cytochrome P450 enzyme groups involved in drug metabolism (CYP1A2, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5).

mentions.name: larotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Larotrectinib on CYP Substrates: Larotrectinib is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: lasmiditan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Potential for Lasmiditan to Affect Other Drugs Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Lasmiditan is an in-vitro inhibitor of CYP2D6 but did not significantly inhibit the activity of other CYP450 enzymes.

mentions.name: lemborexant

mentions.name: leniolisib

mentions.name: lenvatinib

mentions.name: letermovir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro results indicate that letermovir is a substrate of drug metabolizing enzymes CYP3A, CYP2D6, UGT1A1, and UGT1A3, and transporters OATP1B1/3 and P-gp.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: Levoketoconazole does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6, does not induce CYP2B6, and does not inhibit the OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: PK Interactions between Levomilnacipran (LVM) and Other Drugs In vitro Studies In vitro studies suggested that CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2J2 had minimal contributions to metabolism of levomilnacipran.

mentions.name: lofexidine

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Lonafarnib is not considered an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl

mentions.name: loperamide

mentions.name: lorlatinib
