mentions.excerpt: Other Metabolic Enzymes and Transporters In vitro studies indicated that silodosin administration is not likely to inhibit the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, and P-gp.

mentions.name: sodium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: sodium phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Sodium phenylbutyrate or phenylacetate is not an inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C19 and CYP3A at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: sorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Sorafenib on Other Drugs : Sorafenib 400 mg twice daily for 28 days did not increase the systemic exposure of concomitantly administered midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), and omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )].

mentions.name: sotorasib
mentions.excerpt: Sotorasib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C19 substrates : Concomitant use with sparsentan decreased the exposure of omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) C max by 49% and AUC 0-inf by 60%.

mentions.name: stiripentol
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism : On the basis of in vitro studies, the main liver cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoenzymes involved in metabolism are considered to be CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: sunitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies In vitro studies in human hepatocytes and microsomes indicated that sunitinib and the primary active metabolite do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4/5, or inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, and CYP4A9/11 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: suvorexant
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Suvorexant is mainly eliminated by metabolism, primarily by CYP3A with a minor contribution from CYP2C19.

mentions.name: suzetrigine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) Enzymes: Suzetrigine inhibits CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19, but is not expected to result in clinically significant drug interactions.

mentions.name: tafamidis
mentions.excerpt: Tafamidis does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4/5 or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: talazoparib
mentions.excerpt: CYP Enzymes: Talazoparib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: tapentadol
mentions.excerpt: Tapentadol is additionally metabolized to N-desmethyl tapentadol (13%) by CYP2C9 and CYP2C19 and to hydroxy tapentadol (2%) by CYP2D6, which are further metabolized by conjugation.

mentions.name: tapinarof
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tapinarof is not an inhibitor of CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: tasimelteon
mentions.excerpt: Rifampin (strong CYP3A4 and moderate CYP2C19 inducer): the exposure of tasimelteon decreased by approximately 90% when co-administered with rifampin 600 mg (after 11 days of rifampin 600 mg per day).

mentions.name: tazemetostat
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Tazemetostat on CYP2C8 and CYP2C19 Substrates: Coadministration of TAZVERIK 800 mg twice daily with repaglinide (a sensitive CYP2C8 substrate) and omeprazole (a sensitive CYP2C19 substrate) in patients increased repaglinide AUC 0-8h by 80% and C max by 51%; and had no effect on the exposure of omeprazole.

mentions.name: tecovirimat
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tecovirimat is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8 and CYP2C19, and a weak inducer of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: telmisartan
mentions.excerpt: Telmisartan is not metabolized by the cytochrome P450 system and had no effects in vitro on cytochrome P450 enzymes, except for some inhibition of CYP2C19.

mentions.name: tenapanor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies CYP Metabolism Mediated Drug Interactions Tenapanor and M1 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 in vitro.

mentions.name: tepotinib
mentions.excerpt: Tepotinib and M506 do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1, and do not induce CYP1A2 or 2B6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: teriflunomide
mentions.excerpt: Teriflunomide did not affect the pharmacokinetics of bupropion (a CYP2B6 substrate), midazolam (a CYP3A4 substrate), S-warfarin (a CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (a CYP2C19 substrate), and metoprolol (a CYP2D6 substrate).

mentions.name: tetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies do not suggest that tetrabenazine, α-HTBZ, β-HTBZ or 9‑ desmethyl-β-DHTBZ are likely to result in clinically significant inhibition of CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ticagrelor
mentions.excerpt: Ticagrelor and AR-C124910XX were shown to have no inhibitory effect on human CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 activity.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tildrakizumab asmn
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in AUC inf of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) were observed.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: MMAE does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin tftv
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: MMAE does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: tivozanib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Tivozanib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab aazg
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab anoh
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tocilizumab bavi
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro data suggested that IL-6 reduced mRNA expression for several CYP450 isoenzymes including CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, and this reduced expression was reversed by co-incubation with tocilizumab at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tofacitinib
mentions.excerpt: The metabolism of tofacitinib is primarily mediated by CYP3A4 with minor contribution from CYP2C19.

mentions.name: topotecan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Topotecan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8/9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E, CYP3A, CYP4A, or dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase.

mentions.name: tovorafenib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19 metabolize tovorafenib to a minor extent.

mentions.name: tradipitant
mentions.excerpt: In vitro findings suggest that non-CYP450-mediated processes and CYP enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2C19, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8) are involved in the metabolism of tradipitant.

mentions.name: trametinib
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, trametinib is an inhibitor of CYP2C8, but is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at a clinically relevant systemic concentration.

mentions.name: trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, trametinib is an inhibitor of CYP2C8, but is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at a clinically relevant systemic concentration.

mentions.name: trastuzumab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A nor induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: treosulfan
mentions.excerpt: Treosulfan inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 (using midazolam as substrate), but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 (using testosterone as substrate).

mentions.name: triclabendazole
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Based on in vitro studies, triclabendazole is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 (approximately 64%) into its active sulfoxide metabolite and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A, and FMO.

mentions.name: triheptanoin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Heptanoate is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: trilaciclib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Trilaciclib did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: tucatinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Tucatinib is a reversible inhibitor of CYP2C8 and CYP3A and a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP3A, but is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: upadacitinib
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Upadacitinib to Influence the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro studies indicate that upadacitinib does not inhibit the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: uridine triacetate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro enzyme inhibition data did not reveal meaningful inhibitory effects of uridine triacetate or uridine on CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: ustekinumab aauz
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn’s disease. [see Drug Interactions ( 7.2 )] .

mentions.name: ustekinumab aekn
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn’s disease [see Drug Interactions (7.2)] .

mentions.name: ustekinumab auub
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn's disease [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: ustekinumab hmny
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn’s disease [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: ustekinumab srlf
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn’s disease [ see Drug Interactions (7.2) ].

mentions.name: ustekinumab stba
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn's disease [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: ustekinumab ttwe
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in exposure of caffeine (CYP1A2 substrate), warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), dextromethorphan (CYP2D6 substrate), or midazolam (CYP3A substrate) were observed when used concomitantly with ustekinumab at the approved recommended dosage in subjects with Crohn's disease [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ].

mentions.name: vemurafenib
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of vemurafenib did not change the mean systemic exposure to omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) .

mentions.name: venetoclax
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Venetoclax is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vepdegestrant
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies: CYP450 Enzymes: Vepdegestrant does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 or CYP2D6 and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2C19.Vepdegestrant is an inhibitor of CYP2B6.

mentions.name: vibegron
mentions.excerpt: Vibegron did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vilazodone
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4 is primarily responsible for its metabolism among CYP pathways, with minor contributions from CYP2C19 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Viltolarsen did not inhibit CYP3A4/5, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, or UGT2B7.

mentions.name: vimseltinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP 450 enzymes: Vimseltinib is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: vonoprazan
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Vonoprazan is metabolized to inactive metabolites via multiple pathways by a combination of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoforms (predominantly CYP3A4/5, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2B6) along with sulfo- and glucuronosyl-transferases.

mentions.name: vorasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Vorasidenib is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 with minor contributions from CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: voriconazole
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism In vitro studies showed that voriconazole is metabolized by the human hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes, CYP2C19, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Vortioxetine is extensively metabolized primarily through oxidation via cytochrome P450 isozymes CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, and CYP2B6 and subsequent glucuronic acid conjugation.

mentions.name: voxelotor
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of voxelotor is mediated by CYP3A4, CYP3A5, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, UGT1A1, and UGT1A9.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C19 Substrates : Coadministration of multiple doses of zanubrutinib decreased omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate) C max by 20% and AUC by 36%.

mentions.name: zidesamtinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Zidesamtinib and M9 do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ziftomenib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: Ziftomenib is not predicted to have clinically significant effects on the exposure of repaglinide (CYP2C8 substrate), ( S )-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and raltegravir (UGT1A1 substrate).

mentions.name: zoliflodacin
mentions.excerpt: CYP-mediated metabolism is predominantly via CYP 3A4/5 enzymes, with lesser contributions from CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: abacavir
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro study results, abacavir at therapeutic drug exposures is not expected to affect the pharmacokinetics of drugs that are substrates of the following transporters: organic anion transporter polypeptide (OATP)1B1/3, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) or P-glycoprotein (P-gp), organic cation transporter (OCT)1, OCT2, or multidrug and toxic extrusion protein (MATE)1 and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: abemaciclib
mentions.excerpt: Abemaciclib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter System : Acalabrutinib is an inhibitor of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but not multidrug and toxin extrusion protein 1 (MATE1).

mentions.name: acoramidis
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Acoramidis is a substrate for OAT1 and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: adagrasib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of adagrasib were predicted or observed when used concomitantly with efavirenz (a moderate CYP3A inducer), pantoprazole (a proton pump inhibitor), rosuvastatin (a BCRP/OATP substrate), or eltrombopag (a BCRP inhibitor).

mentions.name: afatinib
mentions.excerpt: Interaction of Afatinib with BCRP: Based on in vitro data, afatinib is a substrate and an inhibitor of the transporter BCRP.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit BCRP, OCT2, OCT3, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1 or MATE2-K drug transporters at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: Alectinib and M4 are not substrates of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion-transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: alpelisib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Transporter on Alpelisib: Alpelisib is a substrate of BCRP.

mentions.name: amantadine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that amantadine has negligible or no inhibitory activity against cellular transporters (P-gp, BCRP, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3) at plasma concentrations observed in patients with Parkinson's disease on a GOCOVRI 274 mg dose.

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: Amisulpride does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: P-gp, BCRP and OATP1B1 substrates : Co-administration of ERLEADA with single oral doses of transporter substrates resulted in a 30% decrease in the AUC of fexofenadine (a P-gp substrate) and 41% decrease in the AUC of rosuvastatin (a BCRP/OATP1B1 substrate) but had no impact on C max .

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: Apremilast is a substrate, but not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and is not a substrate or an inhibitor of organic anion transporter (OAT)1 and OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)2, organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1 and OATP1B3, or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Informed Approaches No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with aprocitentan: midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), rosuvastatin (breast cancer resistance protein [BCRP] substrate) or combined oral contraceptive (ethinyl estradiol and levonorgestrel).

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1 and MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: asciminib
mentions.excerpt: Asciminib is eliminated by biliary secretion via breast cancer-resistant protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: atogepant
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Atogepant is a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OAT1.

mentions.name: atorvastatin calcium propylene glycol solvate
mentions.excerpt: Atorvastatin is also identified as a substrate of the efflux transporter BCRP, which may limit the intestinal absorption and biliary clearance of atorvastatin.

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Atrasentan is a substrate of P-gp and OATP1B1/1B3 but not a substrate of BCRP, MRP2/4, NTCP, OCT1, or OATP2B1.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that avacopan is not a substrate of BCRP and P-gp efflux, and OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 uptake transporters.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Avapritinib is an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), intestinal BCRP, MATE1, MATE2-K, and BSEP, but not an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, or OCT2.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Avatrombopag inhibits organic anion transporter (OAT) 3 and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but not organic anion transporter polypeptide (OATP) 1B1 or 1B3, organic cation transporter (OCT) 2 or OAT1.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Avutometinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 and OCT2.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: Azacitidine does not inhibit, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion transporters (OAT) OAT1 and OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP) OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, or organic cation transporter (OCT) OCT2 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant changes in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when coadministered with baloxavir marboxil: midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), digoxin (P-gp substrate), rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate), or oseltamivir.

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: Baricitinib is a substrate of the Pgp, BCRP, OAT3 and MATE2-K transporters, which play roles in drug distribution.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Baxdrostat is a P-gp and BCRP substrate, but this is not expected to result in clinically significant drug-drug interactions.

mentions.name: belumosudil
mentions.excerpt: BCRP/OATP1B1 Substrates : Concomitant use of belumosudil increased rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP1B1 substrate) C max and AUC by 3.6- and 4.6-fold, respectively .

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Belzutifan is a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3, but is not a substrate of BCRP.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Bendamustine Hydrochloride: Bendamustine hydrochloride is a substrate of P-glycoprotein and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: berotralstat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Other Drugs on the Pharmacokinetics of ORLADEYO Berotralstat is a P-gp and BCRP substrate.

mentions.name: binimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Binimetinib: Binimetinib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: bosutinib
mentions.excerpt: I n Vitro Studies Transporters Systems: Bosutinib inhibits breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP)but, does not inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Brensocatib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but is not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: brexpiprazole
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies of brexpiprazole did not indicate that brexpiprazole is a substrate of efflux transporters such as MDRI (P-gp) and BCRP.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of P-glycoprotein and BCRP Inhibitors on Brigatinib: Brigatinib is a substrate of the efflux transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: brincidofovir
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Brincidofovir is an inhibitor of Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP), multidrug resistance-associated protein 2 (MRP2), bile salt export pump (BSEP), OATP1B1, Organic Anion Transporter 1 (OAT1), and OAT3.

mentions.name: brivaracetam

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod

mentions.name: cabazitaxel

mentions.name: cannabidiol

mentions.name: carglumic acid

mentions.name: cariprazine

mentions.name: casimersen

mentions.name: cefiderocol

mentions.name: ceftobiprole medocaril

mentions.name: cenobamate

mentions.name: cladribine

mentions.name: cobimetinib

mentions.name: copper histidinate

mentions.excerpt: Effect of lazertinib on BCRP substrates: Concomitant use of LAZCLUZE increased rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) C max by 2.2-fold and AUC by 2-fold.

mentions.name: lemborexant
mentions.excerpt: Lemborexant and M10 do not inhibit other CYP isoforms (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K).

mentions.name: lenacapavir
mentions.excerpt: Lenacapavir is an inhibitor of P-gp and BCRP but does not inhibit OATP.

mentions.name: lenalidomide
mentions.excerpt: Lenalidomide is not an inhibitor of P-gp, bile salt export pump (BSEP), BCRP, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: leniolisib
mentions.excerpt: Intestinal secretion by BCRP as well as extrahepatic CYP1A1 cannot be excluded as excretion routes.

mentions.name: lenvatinib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Other D rugs on L envatinib CYP3A, P-gp, and BCRP Inhibitor s : Ketoconazole (400 mg daily for 18 days) increased lenvatinib (administered as a single 5 mg dose on Day 5) AUC by 15% and C max by 19%.

mentions.name: letermovir
mentions.excerpt: Changes in letermovir plasma concentrations due to inhibition of P-gp/BCRP by itraconazole were not clinically relevant.

mentions.name: levacetylleucine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Levacetylleucine is a substrate of organic anion transporter (OAT)1 and OAT3, but not organic cation transporter (OCT)2, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), or P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: In addition, levomilnacipran is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2 and is a weak substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: linerixibat
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, linerixibat did not inhibit the transporters, P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion transporters (OAT) 1 and 3, organic cation transporter (OCT) 2, and multidrug and toxin extrusion protein (MATE) 1 and 2K.

mentions.name: lomitapide
mentions.excerpt: Lomitapide inhibits P-gp but does not inhibit breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Lonafarnib is not a substrate of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or BCRP, but is likely a marginal substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: SG3199 is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but not a substrate of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion-transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, or organic cation transporter (OCT)1.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: SG3199 is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but not a substrate of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion-transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, or organic cation transporter (OCT)1.

mentions.name: lorlatinib
mentions.excerpt: Lorlatinib inhibits OCT1, OAT3, MATE1, and intestinal BCRP.

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: Lumateperone did not appear to be a P-gp or BCRP substrate.

mentions.name: lurasidone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter proteins: In vitro studies suggest lurasidone hydrochloride is not a substrate of OATP1B1 or OATP1B3, however, is probably a substrate of P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: lurbinectedin
mentions.excerpt: Lurbinectedin inhibits MDR1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OCT1 but not BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: lusutrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant changes in lusutrombopag exposure were observed when co-administered with cyclosporine (an inhibitor of P-gp and BCRP) or an antacid containing a multivalent cation (calcium carbonate).

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 dotatate
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Vipivotide tetraxetan is not a substrate of BCRP, P-gp, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3 or OCT2.

mentions.name: lutetium oxodotreotide lu 177
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: macitentan
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrate drugs : Macitentan 10 mg once daily did not affect the pharmacokinetics of concomitant use of a BCRP substrate drug (riociguat 1 mg and rosuvastatin 10 mg). macitentan-figure1.jpg

mentions.name: maralixibat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Other Drugs on Maralixibat Maralixibat is not a substrate of the drug transporters MDR1 (P-gp), BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OATP2B2; therefore, concomitant drug products are not predicted to affect the disposition of maralixibat.

mentions.name: mavacamten
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Mavacamten does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, MATE2-K, organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATPs), organic cation transporters (OCTs), or organic anion transporters (OATs).

mentions.name: mavorixafor
mentions.excerpt: Mavorixafor is an inhibitor of P-gp, OCT2, and MATE1, but is not an inhibitor of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: methylene blue
mentions.excerpt: Methylene Blue is a substrate for the P-glycoprotein (P-gp, ABCB1) transporter, but not for BCRP or OCT2 in vitro .

mentions.name: methylnaltrexone
mentions.excerpt: Methylnaltrexone : Methylnaltrexone was a substrate of OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K, but not a substrate for P-gp, BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1 and OAT3.

mentions.name: midostaurin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Midostaurin on P-gp, BCRP, and OATP1B1 Substrates Coadministration of a single dose of RYDAPT (100 mg) with a single dose of rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP1B1 substrate) increased the AUC last of rosuvastatin by 48%.

mentions.name: mifepristone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also indicated an interaction potential for drug transport mediated by P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: migalastat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Migalastat is not a known inhibitor or inducer of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, nor is it an inhibitor of BCRP, MDR1, P‑glycoprotein (P‑gp), or BSEP human efflux transporters, or OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2‑K human uptake transporters.

mentions.name: momelotinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates: A BCRP substrate (rosuvastatin) C max increased by 220% and AUC increased by 170% following concomitant use of a single dose of rosuvastatin at 10 mg with multiple doses of momelotinib (200 mg once daily).

mentions.name: naldemedine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Naldemedine on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naldemedine did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (including CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A11 isozymes) and is not an inhibitor of transporters (including OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BCRP, or P-gp).

mentions.name: naloxegol
mentions.excerpt: Naloxegol is not a significant inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: nerandomilast
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Nerandomilast is a P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate, but is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, and OCT2.

mentions.name: nifurtimox
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Nifurtimox is not a substrate or inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistant protein (BCRP), and is not an inhibitor of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATPs), multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) proteins (MATE1/MATE2-K), organic anion transporter 1/3 (OAT1/OAT3), or organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2).

mentions.name: nintedanib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also showed that nintedanib has weak inhibitory potential on OCT-1, BCRP, and P-gp; these findings are considered to be of low clinical relevance.

mentions.name: nintedanib esylate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also showed that nintedanib has weak inhibitory potential on OCT-1, BCRP, and P-gp; these findings are considered to be of low clinical relevance.

mentions.name: niraparib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Niraparib inhibits BCRP, MATE1, and MATE2K, but does not inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp), BSEP, or MRP2.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Nirmatrelvir is a substrate for P-gp, but not BCRP, MATE1, MATE2K, NTCP, OAT1, OAT2, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, PEPT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, or OATP4C1.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir ritonavir
mentions.excerpt: Nirmatrelvir is a substrate for P-gp, but not BCRP, MATE1, MATE2K, NTCP, OAT1, OAT2, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, PEPT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, or OATP4C1.

mentions.name: nirogacestat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Nirogacestat is a P-gp substrate, but not of BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Nitisinone does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3 and OCT2-mediated transports at therapeutically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: odevixibat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Other Drugs on Odevixibat Odevixibat is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) but not a substrate of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: olaparib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters : Olaparib is an inhibitor of BCRP, OATP1B1, OCT1, OCT2, OAT3, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: olezarsen
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Olezarsen is not a substrate or inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP.

mentions.name: oliceridine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate that oliceridine is not an inhibitor of any of the major transporters, including breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) and MDR1, at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: olutasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Olutasidenib is not a substrate of BCRP, BSEP, MRP2, MRP3, or MRP4.

mentions.name: omadacycline
mentions.excerpt: Omadacycline is not a substrate or inhibitor of the major organic anion transporters (OAT-1 and 3), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), or multidrug resistance-associated protein 2 (MRP2).

mentions.name: omaveloxolone
mentions.excerpt: Certain CYP450 Enzymes or Transporter Substrates: Omaveloxolone decreased the AUC of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate) by approximately 45%, AUC of repaglinide (CYP2C8 substrate) by approximately 35%, and AUC of rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP1B1 substrate) by approximately 30% [see Drug Interactions ( 7.2 )].

mentions.name: opicapone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Opicapone is a substrate of P-gp (MDR1) (see Clinical Studies), BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B3, and OATP2B1.

mentions.name: orforglipron
mentions.excerpt: Orforglipron is a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, and is not a substrate of BCRP or OCT1.

mentions.name: osimertinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Osimertinib on Other Drugs in Clinical Pharmacokinetic Studies BCRP substrates: Co-administering TAGRISSO with rosuvastatin (a BCRP substrate) increased rosuvastatin AUC by 35% and C max by 72% [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: oteseconazole
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies BCRP substrates: Oteseconazole increased the C max and AUC 0-24h of rosuvastatin, a BCRP substrate, by 118% and 114%, respectively .

mentions.name: ozanimod
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Inhibitors Co-administration of ozanimod with cyclosporine (BCRP inhibitor) had no effect on the exposure of ozanimod or the major active metabolites CC112273 and CC1084037.

mentions.name: pacritinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Transporter Systems: Pacritinib is not a substrate of BCRP, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, or P-gp.

mentions.name: pafolacianine
mentions.excerpt: Pafolacianine is not an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, or BCRP 12.1 Mechanism of Action Pafolacianine binds to alpha and beta folate receptors (FR) on cells, is internalized via receptor-mediated endocytosis, and accumulates intracellularly.

mentions.name: palbociclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, palbociclib has the potential to inhibit OCT1 at clinically relevant concentrations, as well as the potential to inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) in the gastrointestinal tract at the proposed dose.

mentions.name: palovarotene
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Palovarotene is not an inhibitor of P-gp, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2 K, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and BSEP.

mentions.name: paltusotine
mentions.excerpt: Paltusotine is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP transporters.

mentions.name: pasireotide
mentions.excerpt: At therapeutic dose levels, pasireotide is not expected to be a substrate of BCRP (breast cancer resistance protein), OCT1 (organic cation transporter 1), or OATP (organic anion-transporting polypeptides) 1B1, 1B3, or 2B1.

mentions.name: pasireotide diaspartate
mentions.excerpt: Pasireotide is not a substrate of efflux transporter BCRP (breast cancer resistance protein), influx transporter OCT1 (organic cation transporter 1), or influx transporters OATP (organic anion-transporting polypeptide) 1B1, 1B3, or 2B1.

mentions.name: pazopanib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that pazopanib is a substrate for P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: pemigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Pemigatinib is a substrate of both P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: pexidartinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Pexidartinib is not a substrate for P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, and BSEP.

mentions.name: phenobarbital
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Phenobarbital is an inhibitor of BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: pirtobrutinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates: Multiple doses of pirtobrutinib (200 mg daily) increased the AUC and C max of rosuvastatin (sensitive BCRP substrate) by 140% and 146%, respectively.

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter system s : FGN849 is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP but is not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: pivekimab sunirine pvzy
mentions.excerpt: Transporter system s : FGN849 is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP but is not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: pivmecillinam
mentions.excerpt: Mecillinam does not inhibit breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), P-glycoprotein (PgP), MATE1, MATE2-K, organic anion transporter-1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptides -1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1 B1/B3), and organic cation transporter-2 (OCT2) drug transporters.

mentions.name: plazomicin
mentions.excerpt: Membrane Transporters Plazomicin is not a substrate of P-gp or BCRP transporters.

mentions.name: plecanatide
mentions.excerpt: Plecanatide and its active metabolite were neither substrates nor inhibitors of the transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) in vitro .

mentions.name: plozasiran
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Plozasiran is not a substrate or an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: ponatinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ponatinib is a weak substrate for both P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: ponesimod
mentions.excerpt: Ponesimod is not a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 transporters.

mentions.name: pralatrexate
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Pralatrexate is a substrate for BCRP, MRP2, MRP3, and OATP1B3, but is not a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: pralsetinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Pralsetinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate of BSEP, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: pretomanid
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies cannot exclude the possibility that pretomanid is an inhibitor of BCRP, OATP1B3, and P-gp transporters.

mentions.name: primaquine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of other Drugs on the Pharmacokinetics of primaquine In vitro data suggest primaquine is not a substrate of either P-gp or BCRP membrane transporters.

mentions.name: prucalopride
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on Prucalopride Ketoconazole Ketoconazole (200 mg twice daily), a strong CYP3A inhibitor and inhibitor of P-gp and BCRP, increased the C max and AUC of prucalopride by approximately 40%.

mentions.name: quizartinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Quizartinib is a substrate for P-gp but not for BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT2, MATE1, or MRP2.

mentions.name: regorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Regorafenib on BCRP Substrates: Administration of regorafenib (160 mg for 14 days) prior to administration of a single dose of rosuvastatin (5 mg), a BCRP substrate, resulted in a 3.8-fold increase in mean exposure (AUC) of rosuvastatin and a 4.6-fold increase in C max [see Drug Interactions ( 7.3 )] .

mentions.name: relacorilant
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Relacorilant and CORT125295 are inhibitors of BCRP.

mentions.name: relugolix
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (sensitive CYP3A substrate) or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate), or dabigatran etexilate (P-gp substrate) were observed upon co-administration with relugolix.

mentions.name: remibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates: Co-administration of remibrutinib at four times the recommended dosage with a single dose of 10 mg rosuvastatin (a BCRP and OATP1B substrate) increased rosuvastatin C max by 1.6-fold and AUC by 1.7-fold.

mentions.name: remimazolam
mentions.excerpt: BYFAVO was not a relevant substrate of a panel of human drug transporters (OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BCRP).

mentions.name: repotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Repotrectinib inhibits P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: resmetirom
mentions.excerpt: Specific Populations No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of resmetirom were observed based on age (18 to 83 years), sex, race (White, Black, or Asian), or ABCG2 genotype (BCRP p.Gln141Lys, p.Val12Met).

mentions.name: revefenacin
mentions.excerpt: Revefenacin and Efflux Transporters Revefenacin is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: revumenib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Revumenib is a substrate of OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, and MATE1, but is not a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE2-K, or BSEP.

mentions.name: ribociclib
mentions.excerpt: Ribociclib may inhibit BCRP, OCT2, MATE1, and human BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: rifaximin
mentions.excerpt: Cyclosporine is also an inhibitor of OATP, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) and a weak inhibitor of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: rilzabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters : Rilzabrutinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate for OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or BSEP.

mentions.name: rimegepant
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Rimegepant is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP (see In Vivo Studies ) .

mentions.name: riociguat
mentions.excerpt: Riociguat is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: ripretinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ripretinib and DP-5439 are substrates for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: risdiplam
mentions.excerpt: Risdiplam is a weak substrate of human MDR-1 and breast cancer resistant protein (BCRP) transporters in vitro.

mentions.name: rolapitant
mentions.excerpt: When sulfasalazine (BCRP substrate) was administered with a single oral dose of 180 mg rolapitant on Day 1 and without rolapitant on Day 8, a 140% increase in C max and a 130% increase in AUC of sulfasalazine 500 mg was observed on Day 1, a 17% increase in C max and a 32% increase in AUC was observed on Day 8 [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: romidepsin
mentions.excerpt: Romidepsin is not a substrate of the following uptake transporters: BCRP, BSEP, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: rucaparib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Rucaparib on Other Drugs Concomitant administration of Rubraca with rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) had no clinically meaningful effect on the concentrations of rosuvastatin.

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ruxolitinib is not expected to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 transporter systems following topical application.

mentions.name: sapropterin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , sapropterin inhibits breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) but the potential for a clinically significant increase in systemic exposure of BCRP substrates by sapropterin dihydrochloride appears to below.

mentions.name: sarecycline
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Sarecycline is not a substrate for P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: sebetralstat
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in sebetralstat pharmacokinetics were observed when administered concomitantly with quinidine (P-gp inhibitor), eltrombopag (BCRP inhibitor), cimetidine (evaluated as a weak CYP3A4 inhibitor), or modafinil (weak CYP3A4 inducer).

mentions.name: seladelpar lysine
mentions.excerpt: Cyclosporine Seladelpar AUC 0–inf increased by 2.1-fold and C max by 2.9-fold following concomitant use of a single 10 mg seladelpar dose with 600 mg cyclosporine (OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and BCRP inhibitor) in healthy subjects.

mentions.name: selexipag
mentions.excerpt: Selexipag is a substrate of P-gp, and the active metabolite is a substrate of the transporter of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: selinexor
mentions.excerpt: Selinexor is not a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: selpercatinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates: Coadministration of RETEVMO with rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) increased the rosuvastatin AUC 0-INF by 1.9-fold and C max by 1.7-fold.

mentions.name: selumetinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Selumetinib does not inhibit BCRP, P-glycoprotein (P-gp), OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: sepiapterin
mentions.excerpt: Specific Populations No clinically significant difference in pharmacokinetics of sepiapterin were observed based on age (range 0.5 to 61 years), sex (female 52%, male 48%), race/ethnicity (White 74%, Asian 16%, Other or not specified 7%, or American Indian or Alaska Native 3%) or ABCG2 genotype (BCRP p.Gln141Lys).

mentions.name: sevabertinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates: Rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) AUC increased 1.3-fold and C max 1.4-fold following concomitant use of HYRNUO 20 mg twice daily.

mentions.name: sodium phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: Sodium phenylbutyrate or phenylacetate is not a substrate of efflux transporters P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: sofosbuvir
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions Sofosbuvir is a substrate of drug transporter P-gp and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) while GS-331007 is not.

mentions.name: solriamfetol
mentions.excerpt: Solriamfetol does not appear to be a substrate or inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: sonidegib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggested that sonidegib is not a substrate of P-glycoprotein, MRP2 or BCRP.

mentions.name: sotagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Sotagliflozin was shown to have inhibitory effects on P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: sotorasib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP substrates : Coadministration of LUMAKRAS with rosuvastatin (a BCRP substrate) increased rosuvastatin C max by 70% and AUC by 34%.

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), pitavastatin (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, substrate), or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) were observed when co-administered with sparsentan.

mentions.name: stiripentol
mentions.excerpt: Stiripentol also inhibits CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and drug transporters, including P-gp and BCRP, at clinically relevant concentrations [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ].

mentions.name: suvorexant
mentions.excerpt: In addition, no clinically meaningful inhibition of OATP1B1, BCRP and OCT2 transporters is anticipated.

mentions.name: suzetrigine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Suzetrigine and M6-SUZ are not substrates of BCRP, OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: tafamidis
mentions.excerpt: BCRP substrates: Tafamidis inhibits breast cancer resistant protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: tafenoquine
mentions.excerpt: Tafenoquine is not an inhibitor of human breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), P-glycoprotein (P-gp), Organic anion transporter 1/3 (OAT1 or OAT3), Organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1/1B3 (OATP1B1 or OATP1B3) mediated transport at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: talazoparib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Transporters: Talazoparib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP transporters, but not a substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BSEP, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: taletrectinib adipate
mentions.excerpt: Taletrectinib inhibits P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, MATE1 and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: tapinarof
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Tapinarof is not an inhibitor of BCRP, MATE1, MATE-2K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, or P-gp.

mentions.name: tazemetostat
mentions.excerpt: Tazemetostat is not a substrate of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP); renal transporters organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), organic anion transporter 3 (OAT3), and multidrug and toxin extrusion transporter 1 (MATE1); or hepatic transporters organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1) and organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B3 (OATP1B3).

mentions.name: tecovirimat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Tecovirimat inhibited Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP) in vitro .

mentions.name: tedizolid
mentions.excerpt: Membrane Transporters Coadministration of multiple oral doses of SIVEXTRO (200 mg once daily) increased the C max and AUC of rosuvastatin (10 mg single oral dose), a known BCRP substrate, by approximately 55% and 70%, respectively, in healthy adult subjects [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: telotristat ethyl
mentions.excerpt: In vitro telotristat ethyl inhibited P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but telotristat did not inhibit P-gp and BCRP at the clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: telotristat etiprate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro telotristat ethyl inhibited P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but telotristat did not inhibit P-gp and BCRP at the clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tenapanor
mentions.excerpt: Membrane Transporter Mediated Drug Interactions Tenapanor inhibited OATP2B1, but is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: tenofovir disoproxil
mentions.excerpt: TDF is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters.

mentions.name: tepotinib
mentions.excerpt: Tepotinib may inhibit intestinal BCRP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: teriflunomide
mentions.excerpt: BCRP and OATP1B1/1B3 substrates There was an increase in mean rosuvastatin C max and AUC (2.65- and 2.51-fold, respectively) following repeated doses of teriflunomide, suggesting that teriflunomide is an inhibitor of BCRP transporter and organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1B1/1B3) [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

mentions.name: ticagrelor
mentions.excerpt: Ticagrelor is a BCRP inhibitor.

mentions.name: tirbanibulin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Transporters: Neither tirbanibulin nor the metabolite KX2-5036 was a substrate of MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MRP2, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: tivozanib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Tivozanib inhibits BCRP but does not inhibit P-gp, OCT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1 or MATE2-K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tolvaptan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Substrates Tolvaptan is a substrate of P-gp and an inhibitor of P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: tovorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Tovorafenib is not a substrate of BCRP, P-glycoprotein (P-gp), OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: tradipitant
mentions.excerpt: Tradipitant is a P-gp substrate and is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1 or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: trametinib
mentions.excerpt: Trametinib is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, OCT1, MRP2, or MATE1 in vitro.

mentions.name: trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide
mentions.excerpt: Trametinib is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, OCT1, MRP2, or MATE1 in vitro.

mentions.name: trastuzumab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : DXd is not an inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, BCRP, or BSEP.

mentions.name: treosulfan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Treosulfan does not inhibit BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, or OCT2.

mentions.name: tretinoin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Tretinoin on Transporters: Tretinoin does not inhibit P-gp and BCRP in vitro.

mentions.name: trifarotene
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : AKLIEF Cream is not expected to inhibit MATE, OATP, OAT, OCT, BCRP, P-gp, BSEP, or MRP.

mentions.name: trilaciclib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Trilaciclib did not inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: trofinetide
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Trofinetide inhibits P-gp [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ] , BCRP, and BSEP.

mentions.name: tucatinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Tucatinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but is not a substrate of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Ubrogepant is a substrate of BCRP and P-gp transporters in-vitro; therefore, use of inhibitors of BCRP and/or P-gp may increase the exposure of ubrogepant.

mentions.name: ulipristal
mentions.excerpt: Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP) transporter: In vitro data indicate that ulipristal acetate may be an inhibitor of BCRP at the intestinal level.

mentions.name: upadacitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that upadacitinib does not inhibit the transporters P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, and MATE2K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vadadustat
mentions.excerpt: Figure 1 Impact of Other Drugs on Pharmacokinetics of Vadadustat BCRP: breast cancer resistance protein;

mentions.name: valbenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies suggest that valbenazine and [+]-α-HTBZ are unlikely to inhibit the transporters (BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Vamorolone is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATBP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vemurafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Vemurafenib on Transporters: In vitro studies suggest that vemurafenib is both a substrate and an inhibitor of the efflux transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: venetoclax
mentions.excerpt: Ketoconazole Concomitant use of ketoconazole (a strong CYP3A, P-gp, and BCRP inhibitor) 400 mg once daily for 7 days increased venetoclax C max by 130% and AUC 0-INF by 540% [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 )] .

mentions.name: vepdegestrant
mentions.excerpt: Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP) Substrates : Rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) AUC increased 1.2-fold and C max 1.2-fold following concomitant use of a single dose of VEPPANU 200 mg.

mentions.name: vericiguat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: vericiguat is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) but is not a substrate of organic cation transporter (OCT1) or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: vibegron
mentions.excerpt: Vibegron did not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: viloxazine
mentions.excerpt: Viloxazine is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MATE2-K, OATP1B1*1a, and OATP1B3 transporters.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: Viltolarsen is not metabolized by CYP enzymes and is not a substrate of transporters BCRP, BSEP, MDR1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: vimseltinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Vimseltinib is a P-gp substrate but is not a substrate of BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: vismodegib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Vismodegib is an inhibitor of the transporter BCRP and is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: voclosporin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, voclosporin is not a substrate for breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) or organic anion transporting polypeptides OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: vorasidenib
mentions.excerpt: P-gp and BCRP Substrates: No clinically significant difference in the pharmacokinetics of digoxin (P-gp substrate) or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) is predicted when used concomitantly with vorasidenib.

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Vortioxetine on PK of Other Drugs Figure 3 In Vitro Vortioxetine and its metabolite(s) are unlikely to inhibit the following CYP enzymes and transporter based on in vitro data: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: vosoritide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, vosoritide is considered unlikely to inhibit the human drug uptake or efflux transporters such as OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations and therefore, no effect of vosoritide is anticipated on concomitantly administered drugs that are substrates of these transporters.

mentions.name: voxelotor
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : voxelotor is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) were observed when coadministered with zanubrutinib.

mentions.name: zavegepant
mentions.excerpt: Zavegepant is not a substrate for BCRP, OATP1B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, BSEP, MRP2, MRP3, and MRP4.

mentions.name: zidesamtinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Zidesamtinib inhibits P-glycoprotein (P-gp), BCRP, and MATE1.

mentions.name: ziftomenib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ziftomenib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not BSEP or MRP.

mentions.name: zilucoplan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that zilucoplan is not a substrate of major cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: zoliflodacin
mentions.excerpt: Zoliflodacin is a substrate for P-gp and BCRP and possible substrate for OATP1B1/3.

mentions.name: zongertinib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP Substrates : Rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) C max increased 3-fold and AUC 2.3-fold following concomitant use of HERNEXEOS 120 mg daily for 12 days.

mentions.name: zuranolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Zuranolone is not a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), BCRP, OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: abiraterone
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C8 substrates: The AUC of pioglitazone (CYP2C8 substrate) was increased by 46% when pioglitazone was given to healthy subjects with a single dose of 1,000 mg abiraterone acetate.

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Abrocitinib and its metabolites M1 and M2 are not inhibitors or inducers of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Acalabrutinib is an inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9, but not CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: acoramidis
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Acoramidis is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP2C9, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: adagrasib
mentions.excerpt: Adagrasib inhibits its own CYP3A4 metabolism following multiple dosing to steady-state which permits CYP2C8, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 to contribute to its metabolism at steady-state.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP enzymes: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Alectinib on Other Drugs No clinically meaningful effect on the exposure of midazolam (sensitive CYP3A substrate) or repaglinide (sensitive CYP2C8 substrate) is expected following co-administration with ALECENSA.

mentions.name: alogliptin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on the Pharmacokinetic Exposure of Alogliptin In Vitro Studies Effect of Alogliptin on CYP Enzymes Alogliptin is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alpelisib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP2B6 Substrates: Coadministration of repeated doses of alpelisib 300 mg with a single-dose of sensitive substrates of CYP3A4 (midazolam), CYP2C8 (repaglinide), CYP2C9 (warfarin), CYP2C19 (omeprazole) and CYP2B6 (bupropion), administered as a cocktail did not show clinically significant pharmacokinetic interactions.

mentions.name: amiodarone
mentions.excerpt: Amiodarone is metabolized to DEA by the cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzyme group, specifically cytochrome P4503A (CYP3A) and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , amisulpride was not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: anacaulase bcdb
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of NEXOBRID on Other Drugs Bromelain, a component of anacaulase-bcdb, exhibited CYP2C8 time-dependent inhibition in human hepatocytes and inhibited human microsomal CYP2C9.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Apalutamide is primarily metabolized by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 to form active metabolite, N-desmethyl apalutamide.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro data: Apremilast is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: asciminib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C8 Substrates: The repaglinide (substrate of CYP2C8, CYP3A4, and OATP1B) AUC inf and C max increased by 8% and 14%, respectively, following coadministration of repaglinide with SCEMBLIX 40 mg twice daily.

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Atazanavir is also a direct inhibitor for UGT1A1 (K i =1.9 µM) and CYP2C8 (K i =2.1 µM).

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Atrasentan inhibits in vitro CYP3A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9 and induces CYP3A and CYP2B6, but is not expected to cause clinically significant interactions with these CYP450 enzymes in the liver.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: Effect of TAVNEOS on Other Drug Substances In vitro studies indicate that avacopan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6, and does not induce CYP1A2 and CYP2B6, but shows induction and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avanafil
mentions.excerpt: Omeprazole, Rosiglitazone, and Desipramine The effect of avanafil on the pharmacokinetics of omeprazole (a CYP2C19 substrate), rosiglitazone (a CYP2C8 substrate), and desipramine (a CYP2D6 substrate) was evaluated in an open-label, three cohort, crossover study.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Avapritinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP enzymes: Avatrombopag does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A, does not induce CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C or CYP3A, and weakly induces CYP2C8 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Avutometinib is a CYP3A4 substrate, but not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Co-administered Drugs and Hepatic Impairment on Axitinib Pharmacokinetics Figure 1 Effects of INLYTA on Other Drugs In vitro studies demonstrated that axitinib has the potential to inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Both baloxavir marboxil and baloxavir do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes: Baxdrostat did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: belinostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Belinostat and its metabolites are CYP2C8 and CYP2C9 inhibitors.

mentions.name: belumosudil
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Belumosudil is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8, CYP2D6, and UGT1A9, in vitro .

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Belzutifan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: bepotastine
mentions.excerpt: The effect of bepotastine besilate on the metabolism of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, and CYP2D6 was not studied.

mentions.name: bepotastine besilate
mentions.excerpt: The effect of bepotastine besilate on the metabolism of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2C8 and CYP2D6 was not studied.

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data suggested a potential for bexarotene to inhibit CYP2C8 and induce CYP3A4.

mentions.name: birch triterpenes
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Betulin inhibited CYP3A and CYP2C8 with an IC 50 value of >0.17 µmol/L (75 ng/mL).

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Brensocatib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8 and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Brigatinib is primarily metabolized by CYP2C8 and CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: brincidofovir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP Enzymes: Brincidofovir is a direct and reversible inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP4F2.

mentions.name: cabazitaxel
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cabazitaxel is extensively metabolized in the liver (>95%), mainly by the CYP3A4/5 isoenzyme (80% to 90%), and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C8 Substrates: No clinically-significant effect on single-dose rosiglitazone (a CYP2C8 substrate) exposure (C max and AUC) was observed when co-administered with a cabozantinib capsule formulation at steady-state concentrations.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: CYP2C8 Substrates: No clinically-significant effect on single-dose rosiglitazone (a CYP2C8 substrate) exposure (C max and AUC) was observed when co-administered with a cabozantinib capsule formulation at steady-state concentrations.

mentions.name: canagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Canagliflozin did not inhibit the CYP450 isoenzymes (1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, or 2E1) and weakly inhibited CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 based on in vitro studies with human hepatic microsomes.

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions Drug Metabolizing Enzymes [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 , 7.2 )] Cannabidiol has the potential to inhibit CYP2B6 and CYP2C8, and to induce CYP2B6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, or CYP2D6 in vitro .

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes Cenobamate inhibits CYP2B6, CYP2C19, and CYP3A, but cenobamate does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: It is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and CYP2A6, and mild-to-moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies: Clobazam did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, UGT1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, or UGT2B4 in vitro.

mentions.name: clofazimine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Clofazimine inhibits the metabolism of CYP2C8, CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5 drug substrates.

mentions.name: clopidogrel bisulfate
