mentions.excerpt: Treprostinil is primarily metabolized by CYP2C8 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C9.

mentions.name: triclabendazole
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Triclabendazole and its sulfoxide and sulfone metabolites have the potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A at clinically relevant plasma concentrations, with the highest potential of inhibition on CYP2C19.

mentions.name: trifarotene
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Trifarotene is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9, CYP3A4, CYP2C8, and to a lesser extent by CYP2B6 in vitro .

mentions.name: triheptanoin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Heptanoate is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: trilaciclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicated that trilaciclib is primarily metabolized by aldehyde oxidase (AO), cytochrome P450 (CYP) 3A4 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: tucatinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Tucatinib is metabolized primarily by CYP2C8 and to a lesser extent via CYP3A.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: Ubrogepant is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, 2C9, 2D6, 2C19, MAO-A, and UGT1A1.

mentions.name: upadacitinib
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Upadacitinib to Influence the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro studies indicate that upadacitinib does not inhibit the activity of cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: uridine triacetate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro enzyme inhibition data did not reveal meaningful inhibitory effects of uridine triacetate or uridine on CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of vamorolone is mediated through CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8, UGT1A3, UGT2B7, and UGT2B17.

mentions.name: venetoclax
mentions.excerpt: Venetoclax is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and UGT1A1.

mentions.name: vepdegestrant
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Vepdegestrant is primarily metabolized through direct sulfation via multiple SULT isoforms and oxidation via CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: vibegron
mentions.excerpt: Vibegron did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: vilazodone
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on Vilazodone Pharmacokinetics In vitro studies indicate that vilazodone is unlikely to inhibit or induce the metabolism of substrates for CYP1A1, 1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, 3A4 or 3A5, except for CYP2C8.

mentions.name: viloxazine
mentions.excerpt: Viloxazine does not inhibit CYP2C8, 2C9 or 2C19 activities.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Viltolarsen did not inhibit CYP3A4/5, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, or UGT2B7.

mentions.name: vimseltinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP 450 enzymes: Vimseltinib is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A.

mentions.name: vismodegib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with vismodegib: rosiglitazone (a CYP2C8 substrate) or ethinyl estradiol and norethindrone (oral contraceptive).

mentions.name: vorasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Vorasidenib is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2 with minor contributions from CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Vortioxetine is extensively metabolized primarily through oxidation via cytochrome P450 isozymes CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, and CYP2B6 and subsequent glucuronic acid conjugation.

mentions.name: voxelotor
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Voxelotor on CYP450 Enzymes: in vivo voxelotor inhibits CYP3A4, but not CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2C8, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes : Zanubrutinib is an inducer of CYP2B6 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: zidesamtinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Zidesamtinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A with minor contributions from CYP1A2 and CYP2C8.

mentions.name: ziftomenib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: Ziftomenib is not predicted to have clinically significant effects on the exposure of repaglinide (CYP2C8 substrate), ( S )-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), omeprazole (CYP2C19 substrate), and raltegravir (UGT1A1 substrate).

mentions.name: zoliflodacin
mentions.excerpt: CYP-mediated metabolism is predominantly via CYP 3A4/5 enzymes, with lesser contributions from CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: zongertinib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following were observed when used concomitantly with zongertinib: midazolam (a CYP3A substrate), dabigatran (a P-gp substrate), metformin (a OCT2 and MATE1/2-K substrate), or repaglinide (a sensitive CYP2C8 substrate).

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism The metabolism of abrocitinib is mediated by multiple CYP enzymes, CYP2C19 (~53%), CYP2C9 (~30%), CYP3A4 (~11%) and CYP2B6 (~6%).

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Acalabrutinib is an inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9, but not CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: acoramidis
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 Enzymes: Acoramidis is a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP2C9, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: adagrasib
mentions.excerpt: Adagrasib inhibits its own CYP3A4 metabolism following multiple dosing to steady-state which permits CYP2C8, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, and CYP2D6 to contribute to its metabolism at steady-state.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies CYP enzymes: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alogliptin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on the Pharmacokinetic Exposure of Alogliptin In Vitro Studies Effect of Alogliptin on CYP Enzymes Alogliptin is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alpelisib
mentions.excerpt: CYP3A4, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP2B6 Substrates: Coadministration of repeated doses of alpelisib 300 mg with a single-dose of sensitive substrates of CYP3A4 (midazolam), CYP2C8 (repaglinide), CYP2C9 (warfarin), CYP2C19 (omeprazole) and CYP2B6 (bupropion), administered as a cocktail did not show clinically significant pharmacokinetic interactions.

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450-Related Metabolism In vitro , amisulpride did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4, or induce CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Apalutamide and N-desmethyl apalutamide induce and inhibit CYP2B6.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro data: Apremilast is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: CYP450 enzymes: Aprocitentan inhibits CYP3A4 and all members of the CYP2C family, but did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Clinically significant interactions are not expected between atazanavir and substrates of CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2B6, CYP2A6, CYP1A2, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: atogepant
mentions.excerpt: Atogepant is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: atrasentan
mentions.excerpt: Atrasentan inhibits in vitro CYP3A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8 and CYP2C9 and induces CYP3A and CYP2B6, but is not expected to cause clinically significant interactions with these CYP450 enzymes in the liver.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: Effect of TAVNEOS on Other Drug Substances In vitro studies indicate that avacopan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6, and does not induce CYP1A2 and CYP2B6, but shows induction and time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A4.

mentions.name: avapritinib
mentions.excerpt: Avapritinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP enzymes: Avatrombopag does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A, does not induce CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C or CYP3A, and weakly induces CYP2C8 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Avutometinib is a CYP3A4 substrate, but not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Both baloxavir marboxil and baloxavir do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6 and do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes: Baxdrostat did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP3A4/5, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Belzutifan does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Brensocatib does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: brincidofovir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP Enzymes: Brincidofovir is a direct and reversible inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP4F2.

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabotegravir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, cabotegravir did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4. ‎ Simulations using PBPK modeling show that no clinically significant interaction is expected during coadministration of cabotegravir with drugs that inhibit UGT1A1.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: canagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Canagliflozin did not inhibit the CYP450 isoenzymes (1A2, 2A6, 2C19, 2D6, or 2E1) and weakly inhibited CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 based on in vitro studies with human hepatic microsomes.

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: CYP2B6 Substrates Coadministration of EPIDIOLEX (7.5 mg/kg twice daily) with a single dose of bupropion (150 mg), a CYP2B6 substrate, decreased bupropion exposure by 19% for C max and 20% for AUC compared to bupropion administered alone.

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, or CYP2D6 in vitro .

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: The primary metabolic pathways are by glucuronidation via UGT2B7 and to a lesser extent by UGT2B4, and by oxidation via CYP2E1, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: The major metabolic pathway of clobazam involves N-demethylation, primarily by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: clopidogrel bisulfate
mentions.excerpt: The active metabolite is formed mostly by CYP2C19 with contributions from several other CYP enzymes, including CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Drug Interactions In vitro studies in human liver microsomes have shown that colchicine is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4 activity.

mentions.name: copper histidinate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro Studies: Copper histidinate is a weak inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 (IC 50 >100 μM).

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP Enzymes: Crizotinib inhibits CYP2B6 in vitro.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data demonstrate that dabrafenib is an inducer of CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 via activation of the pregnane X receptor (PXR) and constitutive androstane receptor (CAR) nuclear receptors.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Dacomitinib and O-desmethyl Dacomitinib on CYP Enzymes: Dacomitinib and its metabolite O-desmethyl dacomitinib do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: Effects of Dalfampridine on Co-administered Drugs In vitro data with human liver microsomes showed that dalfampridine was not a direct or time-dependent inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Effect of Danicopan on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs: Dedicated clinical drug interaction studies showed no clinically significant drug interactions with danicopan as an inhibitor or inducer of CYP2B6 (bupropion), CYP2C9 (warfarin), CYP2C19 (omeprazole), CYP3A4 (midazolam), and UGT1A1 and UGT2B7 (mycophenolic acid).

mentions.name: daprodustat
mentions.excerpt: Daprodustat is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: datopotamab deruxtecan dlnk
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : DXd does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: defactinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Avutometinib is a CYP3A4 substrate, but not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: delafloxacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Delafloxacin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit the cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 in vitro in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: deucravacitinib
mentions.excerpt: Deucravacitinib is also metabolized by CYP2B6, CYP2D6, carboxylesterase (CES) 2, and uridine glucuronyl transferase (UGT) 1A9.

mentions.name: deuruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Deuruxolitinib is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: deutetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of AUSTEDO/AUSTEDO XR on Other Drugs CYP Enzymes In vitro studies showed that at clinically relevant concentrations, deutetrabenazine, and its active metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4 enzymes, and did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, and CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: diazoxide choline
mentions.excerpt: It is not an inhibitor of CYP2B6, 2C19, 2C8, 2C9, 2D6 or 3A4.

mentions.name: dichlorphenamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dichlorphenamide is not a substrate for CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 isoforms when tested in vitro .

mentions.name: difamilast
mentions.excerpt: Difamilast is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: difelikefalin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Difelikefalin did not inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A, or CYP2D6), or induce CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A) and is not a substrate of CYP450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C19, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6 or CYP3A).

mentions.name: diroximel
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies found diroximel fumarate and its metabolites did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4/5 enzymes in human liver microsomes or induce CYP1A2, 2B6, or 3A4/5 in cultured human hepatocytes.

mentions.name: donepezil
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, donepezil shows little or no evidence of direct inhibition of CYP2B6, CYP2C8 and CYP2C19 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: dordaviprone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Dordaviprone is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 with minor contribution from CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: dronedarone
mentions.excerpt: Dronedarone has no significant potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2C8 and CYP2B6.

mentions.name: dutasteride
mentions.excerpt: Dutasteride is not metabolized in vitro by human cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: edaravone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that, at the recommended dosage, edaravone and its metabolites are not expected to significantly inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A), conjugating enzymes UGT1A1 and UGT2B7, or other transporters (P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K) in humans.

mentions.name: efavirenz
mentions.excerpt: The in vitro studies suggest that CYP3A and CYP2B6 are the major isozymes responsible for efavirenz metabolism.

mentions.name: elacestrant
mentions.excerpt: Elacestrant is not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: elafibranor
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Effect of IQIRVO on the Pharmacokinetics of Other Drugs In vitro Studies: Elafibranor, GFT1007 and GFT3351 did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: elamipretide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies CYP enzymes: Elamipretide does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: elexacaftor ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Elexacaftor, Tezacaftor and/or Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Based on in vitro results, elexacaftor and tezacaftor have a low potential to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, whereas ivacaftor has the potential to inhibit CYP2C8, CYP2C9 and CYP3A.

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate that eluxadoline is neither an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4, nor an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6 at clinically relevant systemic concentrations.

mentions.name: emtricitabine
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations up to 14-fold higher than those observed in vivo, FTC did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: enasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism of enasidenib is mediated by multiple cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (e.g., CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4), and by multiple UDP glucuronosyl transferases (UGTs) (e.g., UGT1A1, UGT1A3, UGT1A4, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, and UGT2B15) in vitro.

mentions.name: encorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of encorafenib on Other CYP Substrates: There was no clinically significant effect of repeat dose administration of BRAFTOVI 450 mg once daily and binimetinib 45 mg twice daily on the exposure of substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2D6.

mentions.name: ensartinib

mentions.excerpt: The glyco- and tauro- conjugates of chenodiol are high affinity substrates for BSEP, and in vitro studies suggest that chenodiol may inhibit OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 at the recommended dose of 250 mg TID (clinical significance unknown), but chenodiol and its glyco- and tauro- conjugates are not predicted to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Cladribine is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), equilibrative nucleoside transporter 1 (ENT1) and concentrative nucleoside transporter 3 (CNT3).

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: Clobazam and N-desmethylclobazam do not inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but are P-gp substrates.

mentions.name: cobimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Cobimetinib: Cobimetinib is a substrate of efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but is not a substrate of Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP), Organic Anion Transporting Polypeptide (OATP1B1 or OATP1B3) or Organic Cation Transporter (OCT1) in vitro.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Colchicine is a substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: crofelemer
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies have shown that crofelemer has the potential to inhibit transporters MRP2 and OATP1A2 but not P-gp and BCRP at concentrations expected in the gut.

mentions.name: dabigatran etexilate
mentions.excerpt: Dabigatran etexilate is a substrate of the efflux transporter P-gp.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin 2 3 butanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin propanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: daridorexant
mentions.excerpt: P-gp = P-glycoprotein;

mentions.name: darolutamide

mentions.name: darunavir

mentions.name: darunavir ethanolate

mentions.name: darunavir propylene glycolate
mentions.excerpt: In vivo data suggest that darunavir/ritonavir is an inhibitor of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporters.

mentions.name: dasatinib

mentions.name: delgocitinib

mentions.name: deoxycholic acid
mentions.excerpt: Deoxycholic acid does not inhibit the following transporters: P-gp, BCRP, MRP4, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP2B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, NTCP, and ASBT.

mentions.name: desvenlafaxine
mentions.excerpt: Desvenlafaxine is not a substrate or an inhibitor for the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporter.

mentions.name: diazoxide choline
mentions.excerpt: It is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MATE1/2-K, OATP1B1/3, OCT1/2 at the therapeutic dose range.

mentions.name: duvelisib
mentions.excerpt: Duvelisib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and BCRP in vitro.

mentions.name: edoxaban
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro Drug Interactions Studies In vitro studies indicate that edoxaban does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8/9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, or 3A4) and does not induce CYP1A2, CYP3A4 or the P-gp transporter (MDR1).

mentions.name: eliglustat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , eliglustat is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: eltrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Eltrombopag is a substrate of BCRP, but is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: eltrombopag choline
mentions.excerpt: Eltrombopag is a substrate of BCRP, but is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: enfortumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic (PBPK) Modeling Predictions: Dual P-gp and Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitor: Concomitant use of PADCEV with ketoconazole (a dual P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inhibitor) is predicted to increase unconjugated MMAE C max by 15% and AUC by 38%.

mentions.name: entrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Entrectinib on Transporters: Coadministration of a single 600 mg dose of ROZLYTREK capsule with digoxin [a sensitive P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate] increased digoxin C max by 28% and AUC by 18%.

mentions.name: erdafitinib
mentions.excerpt: Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitors Erdafitinib mean ratios for C max and AUC inf were 105% and 134%, respectively, when BALVERSA was co-administered with itraconazole (a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and P-gp inhibitor) relative to BALVERSA alone.

mentions.name: ertugliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Ertugliflozin is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters and is not a substrate of organic anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3).

mentions.name: ertugliflozin pidolate
mentions.excerpt: Ertugliflozin is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters and is not a substrate of organic anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3).

mentions.name: etravirine
mentions.excerpt: Etravirine is an inducer of CYP3A and inhibitor of CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and P-gp.

mentions.name: everolimus
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism Everolimus is a substrate of CYP3A4 and P-gp.

mentions.name: fidaxomicin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vivo studies were conducted to evaluate intestinal drug-drug interactions of fidaxomicin as a P-gp substrate, P-gp inhibitor, and inhibitor of major CYP enzymes expressed in the gastrointestinal tract (CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19).

mentions.name: finerenone
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed or predicted when used concomitantly with finerenone: S-warfarin (CYP2C9 substrate), digoxin (P-gp substrate), and rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP substrate).

mentions.name: flibanserin
mentions.excerpt: Flibanserin 100 mg was administered once daily over 5 days followed by a single dose of 0.5 mg digoxin, a P-gp substrate.

mentions.name: fostamatinib
mentions.excerpt: P-gp substrate : Concomitant use of digoxin (0.25 mg once daily) with 100 mg twice daily TAVALISSE increased digoxin AUC by 37% and C max by 70% .

mentions.name: fostemsavir
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Temsavir is a substrate of CYP3A, esterases, P-glycoprotein (P-gp), and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: gefitinib
mentions.excerpt: Gefitinib is a substrate for the membrane transport P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but it is unlikely to influence gefitinib absorption as P-gp is saturated at higher concentrations.

mentions.name: gepirone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : EXXUA and its metabolites are unlikely to cause clinically significant inhibition of the following transporters based on in vitro data: P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: gilteritinib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Combined P-gp and Strong CYP3A Inducers : Gilteritinib C max decreased approximately 30% and AUC decreased approximately 70% when co-administered with rifampin (a combined P-gp and strong CYP3A inducer).

mentions.name: givinostat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that givinostat is a substrate of the intestinal transporters: P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: ibrutinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that ibrutinib is not a substrate of p-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: idelalisib

mentions.name: iloperidone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Interaction : Iloperidone and P88 are not substrates of P-gp and iloperidone is a weak P-gp inhibitor.

mentions.name: imlunestrant
mentions.excerpt: P-gp Substrates: Digoxin (P-gp substrate) AUC increased 1.4-fold and C max increased 1.6-fold following concomitant use of imlunestrant.

mentions.name: inotuzumab ozogamicin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro Effect of Metabolic Pathways and Transporter Systems on BESPONSA N-acetyl-gamma-calicheamicin dimethylhydrazide is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: iptacopan
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Based on a clinical drug interaction study in healthy volunteers, iptacopan exposure did not change to a clinically relevant degree when coadministered with clopidogrel (a moderate CYP2C8 inhibitor) or cyclosporine (a P-gp, BCRP, and OATP 1B1/1B3 inhibitor).

mentions.name: isavuconazonium
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Isavuconazole is an inhibitor of P-gp-, BCRP- and OCT2.

mentions.name: ivacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Potential for Ivacaftor to Affect Other Drugs Based on in vitro results, ivacaftor and metabolite M1 have the potential to inhibit CYP3A and P-gp.

mentions.name: ivosidenib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Transporter Systems Ivosidenib is a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: ixabepilone

mentions.name: ixazomib

mentions.name: lamivudine

mentions.name: lapatinib ditosylate

mentions.name: lasmiditan

mentions.name: lenalidomide

mentions.name: levacetylleucine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Levacetylleucine is a substrate of organic anion transporter (OAT)1 and OAT3, but not organic cation transporter (OCT)2, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), or P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: linaclotide
mentions.excerpt: In addition, linaclotide does not interact with common efflux and uptake transporters (including the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp)).

mentions.name: linagliptin

mentions.name: linerixibat

mentions.name: lomitapide
mentions.excerpt: Lomitapide is not a P-gp substrate.

mentions.name: lonafarnib

mentions.name: loxapine

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan

mentions.name: macitentan

mentions.name: maralixibat

mentions.name: maraviroc

mentions.name: mavacamten

mentions.name: midostaurin
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Midostaurin on P-gp, BCRP, and OATP1B1 Substrates Coadministration of a single dose of RYDAPT (100 mg) with a single dose of rosuvastatin (BCRP and OATP1B1 substrate) increased the AUC last of rosuvastatin by 48%.

mentions.name: mifepristone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also indicated an interaction potential for drug transport mediated by P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: milsaperidone

mentions.name: mirabegron

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine
mentions.excerpt: There were no differences in exposure between patients who received concomitant weak or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors or P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inhibitors and those who did not.

mentions.name: mirvetuximab soravtansine gynx
mentions.excerpt: There were no differences in exposure between patients who received concomitant weak or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors or P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inhibitors and those who did not.

mentions.name: mitapivat

mentions.name: moxidectin

mentions.name: nifurtimox

mentions.name: nilotinib

mentions.name: nintedanib

mentions.name: nintedanib esylate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies also showed that nintedanib has weak inhibitory potential on OCT-1, BCRP, and P-gp; these findings are considered to be of low clinical relevance.

mentions.name: nitisinone

mentions.name: olaparib

mentions.name: olezarsen

mentions.name: olodaterol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug interaction studies were carried out using fluconazole as a model inhibitor of CYP 2C9 and ketoconazole as a potent P-gp (and CYP3A4, 2C8, 2C9) inhibitor.

mentions.name: omadacycline
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Administration of oral verapamil (P-gp inhibitor) two hours prior to a single 300 mg oral dose of NUZYRA increased omadacycline AUC by approximately 25% and C max by approximately 9%.

mentions.name: oritavancin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that oritavancin is neither a substrate nor an inhibitor of the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: osimertinib

mentions.name: oteseconazole

mentions.name: ozanimod

mentions.name: pafolacianine
mentions.excerpt: Pafolacianine is not an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, or BCRP 12.1 Mechanism of Action Pafolacianine binds to alpha and beta folate receptors (FR) on cells, is internalized via receptor-mediated endocytosis, and accumulates intracellularly.

mentions.name: palbociclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, palbociclib has the potential to inhibit OCT1 at clinically relevant concentrations, as well as the potential to inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) in the gastrointestinal tract at the proposed dose.

mentions.name: pasireotide

mentions.name: pasireotide diaspartate

mentions.name: pazopanib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that pazopanib is a substrate for P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: pemigatinib

mentions.name: plecanatide
mentions.excerpt: Plecanatide and its active metabolite were neither substrates nor inhibitors of the transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) in vitro .

mentions.name: plozasiran

mentions.name: pomalidomide

mentions.name: ponesimod

mentions.name: posaconazole

mentions.name: pralatrexate
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Pralatrexate is a substrate for BCRP, MRP2, MRP3, and OATP1B3, but is not a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: primaquine

mentions.name: propranolol

mentions.name: prucalopride
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Drugs on Prucalopride Ketoconazole Ketoconazole (200 mg twice daily), a strong CYP3A inhibitor and inhibitor of P-gp and BCRP, increased the C max and AUC of prucalopride by approximately 40%.

mentions.name: quinine sulphate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of other drugs on quinine Quinine is a P-gp substrate and is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.

mentions.name: relacorilant
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following drugs were observed when used concomitantly with relacorilant: metoprolol (CYP2D6), tolbutamide (CYP2C9), omeprazole (CYP2C19), or dabigatran etexilate (P-gp).

mentions.name: repotrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies Strong CYP3A and P-gp inhibitors: Repotrectinib AUC 0-inf increased by 5.9-fold and C max by 1.7-fold following concomitant use with itraconazole (strong CYP3A and P-gp inhibitor).

mentions.name: rifaximin
mentions.excerpt: The effect of rifaximin on P-gp transporter was not evaluated in vivo .

mentions.name: rilzabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inhibitor : Coadministration of quinidine (P-gp inhibitor) increased rilzabrutinib C max and AUC by approximately 13% at steady state.

mentions.name: riociguat

mentions.name: ripretinib

mentions.name: ritlecitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ritlecitinib is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or bile salt export pump (BSEP).

mentions.name: roflumilast

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ruxolitinib is not expected to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 transporter systems following topical application.

mentions.name: safinamide
mentions.excerpt: Safinamide is not a substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: sapropterin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies In healthy subjects, administration of a single dose of sapropterin dihydrochloride at the maximum therapeutic dose of 20 mg/kg had no effect on the pharmacokinetics of a single dose of digoxin (P-gp substrate) administered concomitantly.

mentions.name: saxagliptin
mentions.excerpt: Saxagliptin is a P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate but is not a significant inhibitor or inducer of P-gp.

mentions.name: selexipag
mentions.excerpt: Selexipag is a substrate of P-gp, and the active metabolite is a substrate of the transporter of breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: silodosin
mentions.excerpt: P-glycoprotein (P-gp) Inhibitors In vitro studies indicated that silodosin is a P-gp substrate.

mentions.name: sirolimus
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Sirolimus is a substrate for both CYP3A4 and P-gp.

mentions.name: sodium phenylbutyrate
mentions.excerpt: Sodium phenylbutyrate or phenylacetate is not a substrate of efflux transporters P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: sofosbuvir
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions Sofosbuvir is a substrate of drug transporter P-gp and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) while GS-331007 is not.

mentions.name: solriamfetol
mentions.excerpt: Solriamfetol does not appear to be a substrate or inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: sotagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Sotagliflozin was shown to have inhibitory effects on P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: sotorasib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs : No clinically meaningful effect on the exposure of sotorasib was observed following coadministration of LUMAKRAS with itraconazole (a combined strong CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibitor) and a single dose of rifampin (an OATP1B1/1B3 inhibitor), or metformin (a MATE1/MATE2-K substrate).

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: P-gp substrates : Concomitant use with sparsentan increased the exposure of digoxin (P-gp substrate) C max by 61% and AUC 0-inf by 18%.

mentions.name: stiripentol
mentions.excerpt: Stiripentol also inhibits CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and drug transporters, including P-gp and BCRP, at clinically relevant concentrations [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ].

mentions.name: suvorexant
mentions.excerpt: Figure 1: Effects of Co-Administered Drugs on the Pharmacokinetics of Suvorexant Figure 1 Effects of BELSOMRA on Other Drugs In vitro metabolism studies demonstrate that suvorexant has the potential to inhibit CYP3A and intestinal P-gp; however, suvorexant is unlikely to cause clinically significant inhibition of human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19 or CYP2D6.

mentions.name: taletrectinib adipate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies and Model-Informed Approaches Strong CYP3A and P-gp Inhibitors : Taletrectinib C max increased by 1.8-fold and AUC by 3.3-fold following concomitant administration of itraconazole (strong CYP3A and P-gp inhibitor) 200 mg daily.

mentions.name: tedizolid
mentions.excerpt: No clinically relevant interactions are expected to occur with drug efflux transporter P-gp and drug uptake transporters OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2 based on in vitro studies.

mentions.name: telisotuzumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: MMAE is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: telisotuzumab vedotin tllv
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: MMAE is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: telotristat ethyl
mentions.excerpt: In vitro telotristat ethyl inhibited P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but telotristat did not inhibit P-gp and BCRP at the clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: telotristat etiprate
mentions.excerpt: In vitro telotristat ethyl inhibited P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but telotristat did not inhibit P-gp and BCRP at the clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tenofovir disoproxil
mentions.excerpt: TDF is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters.

mentions.name: ticagrelor
mentions.excerpt: P-gp inhibitors (e.g., cyclosporine) increase ticagrelor exposure.

mentions.name: tigecycline
mentions.excerpt: Tigecycline is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) based on an in vitro study using a cell line overexpressing P-gp.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: MMAE is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but not an inhibitor of P-gp.

mentions.name: tisotumab vedotin tftv
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: MMAE is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but not an inhibitor of P-gp.

mentions.name: tocilizumab
mentions.excerpt: Its effect on CYP2C8 or transporters (e.g., P-gp) is unknown.

mentions.name: tocilizumab aazg
mentions.excerpt: Its effect on CYP2C8 or transporters (e.g., P-gp) is unknown.

mentions.name: tocilizumab anoh
mentions.excerpt: Its effect on CYP2C8 or transporters (e.g., P-gp) is unknown.

mentions.name: tocilizumab bavi
mentions.excerpt: Its effect on CYP2C8 or transporters (e.g., P-gp) is unknown.

mentions.name: tolvaptan
mentions.excerpt: P-gp Substrates Digoxin: Digoxin 0.25 mg was administered once daily for 12 days.

mentions.name: topotecan
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of single oral dose of cyclosporine A (15 mg/kg), an inhibitor of P-gp, multidrug-resistance-associated protein (MRP-1) and CYP3A4, within 4 hours of oral topotecan increased the dose-normalized AUC 0-24h of topotecan lactone and total topotecan 2- to 3-fold compared to topotecan alone [see Drug Interactions (7.1)].

mentions.name: trastuzumab emtansine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, DM1 was a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: tretinoin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Tretinoin on Transporters: Tretinoin does not inhibit P-gp and BCRP in vitro.

mentions.name: trifarotene
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : AKLIEF Cream is not expected to inhibit MATE, OATP, OAT, OCT, BCRP, P-gp, BSEP, or MRP.

mentions.name: triptorelin
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Triptorelin was a poor P-gp substrate and had no inhibitory effect toward P-gp.

mentions.name: trofinetide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies CYP3A and/or P-gp Substrates: Coadministration of trofinetide 12,000 mg twice daily with 4 mg of loperamide (a moderately sensitive CYP3A substrate and a P-gp substrate) increased the AUC of loperamide by 1.73-fold and the C max by 1.95-fold [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ] .

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Ubrogepant is a substrate of BCRP and P-gp transporters in-vitro; therefore, use of inhibitors of BCRP and/or P-gp may increase the exposure of ubrogepant.

mentions.name: ulipristal
mentions.excerpt: P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporter: In vitro data indicate that ulipristal may be an inhibitor of P-gp at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: umeclidinium
mentions.excerpt: Elimination Metabolism: In vitro data showed that umeclidinium is primarily metabolized by the enzyme cytochrome P450 2D6 (CYP2D6) and is a substrate for the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporter.

mentions.name: uridine triacetate
mentions.excerpt: Due to the potential for high local (gut) concentrations of the drug after dosing, the interaction of VISTOGARD with orally administered P-gp substrate drugs cannot be ruled out.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Vamorolone is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATBP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vemurafenib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Vemurafenib on Transporters: In vitro studies suggest that vemurafenib is both a substrate and an inhibitor of the efflux transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: vericiguat
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences on vericiguat pharmacokinetics were observed with co-administration of mefenamic acid (UGT1A9 inhibitor), ketoconazole (multi-pathway CYP and transporter inhibitor), rifampin (inducer), digoxin (P-gp substrate), warfarin, aspirin, sildenafil, or the combination of sacubitril/valsartan in healthy subjects.

mentions.name: vilazodone
mentions.excerpt: P-gp = P-glycoprotein.

mentions.name: viloxazine
mentions.excerpt: Viloxazine is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MATE2-K, OATP1B1*1a, and OATP1B3 transporters.

mentions.name: vismodegib
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Clinical Studies No clinically significant differences in vismodegib pharmacokinetics were observed when used concomitantly with fluconazole (moderate CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 inhibitor), itraconazole (strong CYP3A4 inhibitor and P-gp inhibitor) and rabeprazole (gastric acid reducing agent, proton pump inhibitor).

mentions.name: voclosporin
mentions.excerpt: P-gp = P-glycoprotein;

mentions.name: vorasidenib
mentions.excerpt: P-gp and BCRP Substrates: No clinically significant difference in the pharmacokinetics of digoxin (P-gp substrate) or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) is predicted when used concomitantly with vorasidenib.

mentions.name: voriconazole
mentions.excerpt: P-gp inducer) –In an independent published study in healthy volunteers who were given multiple oral doses of St. John's Wort (300 mg LI 160 extract three times daily for 15 days) followed by a single 400 mg oral dose of voriconazole, a 59% decrease in mean voriconazole AUC 0 –∞ was observed.

mentions.name: vorinostat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that vorinostat is not a substrate of human P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: vosoritide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, vosoritide is considered unlikely to inhibit the human drug uptake or efflux transporters such as OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations and therefore, no effect of vosoritide is anticipated on concomitantly administered drugs that are substrates of these transporters.

mentions.name: zanamivir
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Zanamivir is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isoenzymes or P-glycoprotein (P-gp), does not inhibit renal transporters OAT1-4, OCT1-3, or URAT1, and does not inhibit CYP isoenzymes CYP1A1/2, 2A6, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Coadministration of multiple doses of zanubrutinib increased digoxin (P-gp substrate) C max by 34% and AUC by 11%.

mentions.name: zilucoplan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that zilucoplan is not a substrate of major cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: zongertinib
mentions.excerpt: Other Drugs: No clinically significant differences in zongertinib pharmacokinetics were observed when used concomitantly with strong CYP3A, P-gp, BCRP inhibitors and rabeprazole (proton pump inhibitor).

mentions.name: zonisamide
mentions.excerpt: Transporters An in-vitro study showed that zonisamide is a weak inhibitor of P-gp (MDR1).

mentions.name: abaloparatide
mentions.excerpt: Abaloparatide is not a substrate of the renal transporters OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: abemaciclib
mentions.excerpt: Abemaciclib and its major metabolites at clinically relevant concentrations do not inhibit the hepatic uptake transporters OCT1, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3 or the renal uptake transporters OAT1 and OAT3.

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: The metabolites of abrocitinib, M1 and M2 are excreted predominantly in urine, and are substrates of OAT3 transporter.

mentions.name: acalabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Acalabrutinib and its active metabolite, ACP-5862, are not inhibitors of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), organic anion transporter (OAT) 1, OAT3, organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1, OATP1B3, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: aficamten
mentions.excerpt: Aficamten is not expected to inhibit BCRP, OCT2, OCT3, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1 or MATE2-K drug transporters at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: Alectinib did not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2 transport activity in vitro.

mentions.name: alpelisib
mentions.excerpt: Alpelisib has a low potential to inhibit BCRP, MRP2, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: amantadine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that amantadine has negligible or no inhibitory activity against cellular transporters (P-gp, BCRP, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3) at plasma concentrations observed in patients with Parkinson's disease on a GOCOVRI 274 mg dose.

mentions.name: apalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Apalutamide and N-desmethyl apalutamide inhibit OCT2, OAT3, and MATEs, but do not inhibit OAT1.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: Apremilast is a substrate, but not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and is not a substrate or an inhibitor of organic anion transporter (OAT)1 and OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)2, organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1 and OATP1B3, or breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: Aprocitentan does not inhibit organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: arimoclomol
mentions.excerpt: Arimoclomol is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1 and MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: atogepant
mentions.excerpt: Atogepant is not a substrate of OAT3, OCT2, or MATE1.

mentions.name: avacopan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that avacopan and M1 do not inhibit the transporters P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, and MATE2K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Avatrombopag is not a substrate for OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1 or OAT3.

mentions.name: avutometinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Avutometinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 and OCT2.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: Azacitidine does not inhibit, breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion transporters (OAT) OAT1 and OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP) OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, or organic cation transporter (OCT) OCT2 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: baloxavir marboxil
mentions.excerpt: Baloxavir does not inhibit organic anion-transporting polypeptides (OATP) 1B1, OATP1B3, organic cation transporter (OCT) 1, OCT2, organic anion transporter (OAT) 1, OAT3, multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) 1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: Baricitinib is a substrate of the Pgp, BCRP, OAT3 and MATE2-K transporters, which play roles in drug distribution.

mentions.name: belzutifan
mentions.excerpt: Belzutifan does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, or MATE1.

mentions.name: bempedoic acid
mentions.excerpt: Transporter-mediated Drug Interactions In vitro drug interaction studies suggest bempedoic acid, as well as its active metabolite and glucuronide form, are not substrates of commonly characterized drug transporters with the exception of bempedoic acid glucuronide, which is an OAT3 substrate.

mentions.name: bexagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Bexagliflozin is not expected to inhibit drug transporters including breast cancer resistance protein (BRCP), bile salt export pump (BSEP), organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3), anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), and multidrug and toxin extrusion transporters (MATE1, MATE2-K) at clinically relevant plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: bosutinib
mentions.excerpt: I n Vitro Studies Transporters Systems: Bosutinib inhibits breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP)but, does not inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: brensocatib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Brensocatib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but is not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Transporters on Brigatinib: Brigatinib is not a substrate of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP1B1, OATP1B3), organic anion transporter (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporter (OCT1, OCT2), multidrug and toxin extrusion protein (MATE1, MATE2K), or bile salt export pump (BSEP).

mentions.name: brivaracetam
mentions.excerpt: Brivaracetam did not inhibit or weakly inhibit BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, MATE2/K, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or P-gp, suggesting that brivaracetam is unlikely to inhibit these transporters in vivo .

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: In vitro studies have shown that no clinically relevant interactions are expected for efflux transporters including MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, and MATE2K and uptake transporters including OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: In vitro studies have shown that no clinically relevant interactions are expected for efflux transporters including MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, and MATE2K and uptake transporters including OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: cabotegravir
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, cabotegravir inhibited renal OAT1 (IC 50 = 0.81 microM) and OAT3 (IC 50 = 0.41 microM).

mentions.name: cannabidiol
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Cannabidiol and the cannabidiol metabolite, 7-OH-CBD, are not anticipated to interact with BCRP, BSEP, MDR1/P‑gp, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2‑K, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: capivasertib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Capivasertib inhibits BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, and OCT2.

mentions.name: capmatinib
mentions.excerpt: Capmatinib reversibly inhibits MATE1 and MATE2K, but does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT1, OAT3, or MRP2.

mentions.name: carglumic acid
mentions.excerpt: Carglumic acid is not a substrate of MDR1, BCRP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Cariprazine and its major active metabolites were poor or non-inhibitors of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BCRP, organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), and organic anion transporters 1 and 3 (OAT1 and OAT3) in vitro .

mentions.name: casimersen
mentions.excerpt: Casimersen was not metabolized by human hepatic microsomes and was not a substrate or strong inhibitor of the key human drug transporters tested (OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, BCRP, and MRP2).

mentions.name: ceftobiprole medocaril
mentions.excerpt: Ceftobiprole is an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MRP2 and BSEP but is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, or MATE1.

mentions.name: ceritinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Ceritinib on Transporters: Based on in vitro data, ceritinib is unlikely to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, or OCT2 at clinical concentrations.

mentions.name: chenodiol
mentions.excerpt: The glyco- and tauro- conjugates of chenodiol are high affinity substrates for BSEP, and in vitro studies suggest that chenodiol may inhibit OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 at the recommended dose of 250 mg TID (clinical significance unknown), but chenodiol and its glyco- and tauro- conjugates are not predicted to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: clofarabine
mentions.excerpt: An in vitro transporter study suggested that clofarabine is a substrate of human transporters OAT1, OAT3, and OCT1.

mentions.name: cobimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Cobimetinib on Transporters: In vitro data suggest that cobimetinib at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: copper histidinate
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Copper histidinate is not a substrate of BCRP, P-gp, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OAT1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: Crizotinib does not inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP) B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter (OAT) 1, OAT3, or bile salt export pump transporter (BSEP).

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: Dabrafenib and its metabolites, hydroxy-dabrafenib, carboxy-dabrafenib, and desmethyl-dabrafenib, are inhibitors of organic anion transporter (OAT1 and OAT3) in vitro.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: Dacomitinib does not inhibit organic anion transporters (OAT)1 and OAT3, OCT2, organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Danicopan is an inhibitor of BCRP and P-gp, but not an inhibitor of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, Organic Anion Transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, Organic Cation Transporter 2 (OCT2), or Multidrug And Toxin Extrusion 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2-K).

mentions.name: dapagliflozin 2 3 butanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin propanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: defactinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Avutometinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 and OCT2.

mentions.name: deoxycholic acid
mentions.excerpt: Deoxycholic acid does not inhibit the following transporters: P-gp, BCRP, MRP4, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP2B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, NTCP, and ASBT.

mentions.name: deuruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Deuruxolitinib is not an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3 and OCT1 but is an inhibitor of BCRP, BSEP, OAT3 and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: diazoxide choline
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Diazoxide choline is a substrate for OAT1, OAT3, and BCRP.

mentions.name: dichlorphenamide
mentions.excerpt: Dichlorphenamide is not an inhibitor of OAT3, but is an inhibitor of OAT1 based on in vitro studies [see Drug Interactions ( 7.4 )].

mentions.name: difelikefalin
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Difelikefalin did not inhibit BCRP, Pgp, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, or, MATE2-K human transporters and is not a substrate of OAT1, OAT2, OAT3, OATP1A2, OCT2, OCT3, LAT1, PEPT1, PEPT2, ASBT, BSEP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, OCT1, OCTN1, OCTN2, Pgp, BCRP, OSTα/β, MATE1, or, MATE2-K.

mentions.name: diroximel
mentions.excerpt: The major circulating inactive metabolite of diroximel fumarate, HES, did not inhibit P-gp and was neither a substrate nor an inhibitor of BCRP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: doravirine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro assays, doravirine is not likely to be an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, P-glycoprotein, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: dronedarone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro dronedarone and the metabolites SR35021 and SR90154 show no significant potential to inhibit the organic anion transporters OAT1 and OAT3 or the organic cation transporter OCT1.

mentions.name: duvelisib
mentions.excerpt: Duvelisib does not inhibit OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BCRP, or P-gp.

mentions.name: edoxaban
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data also indicate that edoxaban does not inhibit the following transporters at clinically relevant concentrations: P-gp, the organic anion transporters OAT1 or OAT3; the organic cation transporters OCT1 or OCT2; or the organic ion transporting polypeptides OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: elacestrant
mentions.excerpt: Elacestrant is not an inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, OCT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3 or OATP2B1.

mentions.name: elexacaftor ivacaftor tezacaftor
mentions.excerpt: Tezacaftor has a low potential to inhibit BCRP, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: elinzanetant
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following oral drugs were observed when used concomitantly with elinzanetant: tamoxifen (substrate of CYP2D6, CYP3A4 and P-gp) and rosuvastatin (substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1/OATP1B3, and OAT3).

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: I n vitro studies suggest that eluxadoline is a substrate for OAT3, OATP1B1, BSEP and MRP2, but not for OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OATP1B3, P-gp and BCRP.

mentions.name: enasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Enasidenib and AGI-16903 are not substrates of multidrug resistance-associated protein 2 (MRP2), organic anion transporter 1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporter family member 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, and organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2).

mentions.name: encorafenib
mentions.excerpt: Encorafenib is an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OCT2, organic anion transporter (OAT1, OAT3), OATP1B1, and OATP1B3, but not of OCT1 or MRP2 at clinically relevant plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: ensartinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ensartinib is a P-gp substrate but is not a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: ensifentrine
mentions.excerpt: Ensifentrine and Uptake Transporters: Ensifentrine does not inhibit the transporters, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1 or MATE2-K, at therapeutically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: ensitrelvir
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Transporter Systems : Ensitrelvir is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: eravacycline

mentions.name: imetelstat
