mentions.name: imlunestrant
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Imlunestrant is not a substrate of BCRP, OCT1, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: inavolisib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Inavolisib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), but is not a substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2K, OAT1, OAT2.

mentions.name: istradefylline
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Istradefylline was not a substrate for drug transporters P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 when tested in vitro .

mentions.name: ivosidenib
mentions.excerpt: Ivosidenib is not a substrate for BCRP or hepatic transporters OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: ixazomib
mentions.excerpt: Ixazomib is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: lenalidomide
mentions.excerpt: Lenalidomide is not an inhibitor of P-gp, bile salt export pump (BSEP), BCRP, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: leniolisib
mentions.excerpt: BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3 substrates: When co-administered, leniolisib increased rosuvastatin (a substrate of BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3) systemic exposure by 2-fold.

mentions.name: levacetylleucine
mentions.excerpt: Levacetylleucine inhibits P-gp, BCRP, bile salt export pump (BSEP), OAT1 and OAT3, but does not inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: Levoketoconazole does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2D6, does not induce CYP2B6, and does not inhibit the OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: linerixibat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that there is a potential for linerixibat to inhibit organic anion transporter polypeptide 1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Lonafarnib is not a substrate of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or BCRP, but is likely a marginal substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: It showed little to no inhibition of OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B3, or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 dotatate
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan
mentions.excerpt: Vipivotide tetraxetan did not inhibit BCRP, P-gp, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 or OCT2 in vitro.

mentions.name: lutetium oxodotreotide lu 177
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: maralixibat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Other Drugs on Maralixibat Maralixibat is not a substrate of the drug transporters MDR1 (P-gp), BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OATP2B2; therefore, concomitant drug products are not predicted to affect the disposition of maralixibat.

mentions.name: migalastat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Migalastat is not a known inhibitor or inducer of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, nor is it an inhibitor of BCRP, MDR1, P‑glycoprotein (P‑gp), or BSEP human efflux transporters, or OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2‑K human uptake transporters.

mentions.name: naloxegol
mentions.excerpt: Naloxegol is not a significant inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: niraparib
mentions.excerpt: Niraparib and M1 did not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir
mentions.excerpt: Nirmatrelvir is a substrate for P-gp, but not BCRP, MATE1, MATE2K, NTCP, OAT1, OAT2, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, PEPT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, or OATP4C1.

mentions.name: nirmatrelvir ritonavir
mentions.excerpt: Nirmatrelvir is a substrate for P-gp, but not BCRP, MATE1, MATE2K, NTCP, OAT1, OAT2, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, PEPT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, or OATP4C1.

mentions.name: nirogacestat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Nirogacestat is a P-gp substrate, but not of BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Nitisinone does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3 and OCT2-mediated transports at therapeutically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: odevixibat
mentions.excerpt: BCRP; organic anion transporter polypeptide 1B1 and 1B3(OATP1B1 and OATP1B3); organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3; organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), multidrug and toxin extrusion transporter 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2K).

mentions.name: olezarsen
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Olezarsen is not a substrate or inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP.

mentions.name: omadacycline
mentions.excerpt: Omadacycline is not an inhibitor of P-gp and organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: opicapone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Opicapone is a substrate of P-gp (MDR1) (see Clinical Studies), BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B3, and OATP2B1.

mentions.name: osimertinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Osimertinib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein and BCRP and is not a substrate of OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: ozanimod
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Ozanimod, CC112273, CC1084037, and other metabolites do not inhibit P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: pafolacianine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Pafolacianine is a substrate for OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OAT1.

mentions.name: palbociclib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Palbociclib on Transporters: In vitro evaluations indicated that palbociclib has a low potential to inhibit the activities of drug transporters organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)2, and organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, OATP1B3 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: pexidartinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Pexidartinib is not a substrate for P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OATP2B1, and BSEP.

mentions.name: phenobarbital
mentions.excerpt: Phenobarbital is not a substrate of OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, or MATE2K transporters.

mentions.name: plozasiran
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Plozasiran is not a substrate or an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: ponesimod
mentions.excerpt: Ponesimod is not a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 transporters.

mentions.name: pralatrexate
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Pralatrexate is a substrate for BCRP, MRP2, MRP3, and OATP1B3, but is not a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: prucalopride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Based on in vitro study results, the potential for prucalopride to inhibit CYP enzymes (1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 3A4) and transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, BSEP, and MRP2 transporters) or induce CYP enzymes (1A2, 2B6, and 3A4) is low at the clinical concentration.

mentions.name: quizartinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters Quizartinib is a substrate for P-gp but not for BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT2, MATE1, or MRP2.

mentions.name: remdesivir
mentions.excerpt: GS-704277 is a substrate for OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: remimazolam
mentions.excerpt: BYFAVO was not a relevant substrate of a panel of human drug transporters (OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BCRP).

mentions.name: resmetirom
mentions.excerpt: Simvastatin: Simvastatin (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 substrate) C max increased 1.4-fold and AUC 1.7-fold following concomitant use of a single oral dose of simvastatin (20 mg) with resmetirom at steady state (100 mg/day) in healthy subjects [see Drug Interactions (7.2) ] .

mentions.name: revefenacin
mentions.excerpt: Revefenacin and Uptake Transporters The active metabolite of revefenacin is a substrate of OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: rifaximin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro rifaximin is a substrate of P-glycoprotein, OATP1A2, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: rilzabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters : Rilzabrutinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate for OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or BSEP.

mentions.name: rimegepant
mentions.excerpt: Rimegepant is not a substrate of OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: risdiplam
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that risdiplam and its major metabolite are not significant inhibitors of human MDR1, organic anion-transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter 1 and 3 (OAT 1 and 3) transporters, and human organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: rolapitant
mentions.excerpt: Substrates for other transporters In vitro studies suggest that oral rolapitant is unlikely to inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptides 1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3), organic anion transporters 1 and 3 (OAT1 and OAT3), organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), and multidrug and toxin extrusion proteins 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2K) in vivo .

mentions.name: rucaparib
mentions.excerpt: Rucaparib is not a substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ruxolitinib is not expected to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 transporter systems following topical application.

mentions.name: safinamide
mentions.excerpt: Safinamide and its metabolites did not inhibit P-gp or other transporters OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BSEP, OAT1/3/4.

mentions.name: sapropterin
mentions.excerpt: The potential for sapropterin to inhibit OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 has not been adequately studied.

mentions.name: seladelpar lysine
mentions.excerpt: Cyclosporine Seladelpar AUC 0–inf increased by 2.1-fold and C max by 2.9-fold following concomitant use of a single 10 mg seladelpar dose with 600 mg cyclosporine (OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and BCRP inhibitor) in healthy subjects.

mentions.name: selexipag
mentions.excerpt: Selexipag and its active metabolite are substrates of OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: solriamfetol
mentions.excerpt: Solriamfetol does not appear to be a substrate or inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: sonidegib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggested that sonidegib inhibits BCRP, but not P-glycoprotein, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: sotagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Sotagliflozin is a substrate of the human uptake transporters organic anion transporter (OAT)3, organic-anion-transporting polypeptides (OATP)1B1, and OATP1B3, but not OAT1 and organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2).

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of midazolam (CYP3A4 substrate), pitavastatin (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, substrate), or rosuvastatin (BCRP substrate) were observed when co-administered with sparsentan.

mentions.name: tafenoquine
mentions.excerpt: Tafenoquine is not an inhibitor of human breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), P-glycoprotein (P-gp), Organic anion transporter 1/3 (OAT1 or OAT3), Organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1/1B3 (OATP1B1 or OATP1B3) mediated transport at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tedizolid
mentions.excerpt: No clinically relevant interactions are expected to occur with drug efflux transporter P-gp and drug uptake transporters OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2 based on in vitro studies.

mentions.name: telotristat ethyl
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, in vivo drug interaction potential via inhibition of organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1), OCT2, organic anion transporter 1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, or bile salt export pump (BSEP) transporters by telotristat ethyl and telotristat is low at the recommended dosage.

mentions.name: telotristat etiprate
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, in vivo drug interaction potential via inhibition of organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1), OCT2, organic anion transporter 1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, or bile salt export pump (BSEP) transporters by telotristat ethyl and telotristat is low at the recommended dosage.

mentions.name: tenofovir alafenamide
mentions.excerpt: Tenofovir alafenamide as a lipophilic cell-permeant compound enters primary hepatocytes by passive diffusion and by the hepatic uptake transporters OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: tirbanibulin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Transporters: Neither tirbanibulin nor the metabolite KX2-5036 was a substrate of MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MRP2, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: trofinetide
mentions.excerpt: Trofinetide inhibits OAT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, and MATE2-K, but is not expected to result in clinically significant drug interactions.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: Ubrogepant is a weak substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OAT1, but not a substrate of OAT3.

mentions.name: valbenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies suggest that valbenazine and [+]-α-HTBZ are unlikely to inhibit the transporters (BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vericiguat
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: vericiguat is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) but is not a substrate of organic cation transporter (OCT1) or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: viloxazine
mentions.excerpt: Viloxazine is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MATE2-K, OATP1B1*1a, and OATP1B3 transporters.

mentions.name: voclosporin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, voclosporin is not a substrate for breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) or organic anion transporting polypeptides OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: vorasidenib
mentions.excerpt: Vorasidenib is not a substrate of P-gp, BCRP, or OATP1B1 and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: vosoritide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, vosoritide is considered unlikely to inhibit the human drug uptake or efflux transporters such as OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations and therefore, no effect of vosoritide is anticipated on concomitantly administered drugs that are substrates of these transporters.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Zanubrutinib is not a substrate or inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: zidesamtinib
mentions.excerpt: Zidesamtinib does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2 or MATE2K.

mentions.name: zilucoplan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that zilucoplan is not a substrate of major cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes (1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, and 3A) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3).

mentions.name: zoliflodacin
mentions.excerpt: Zoliflodacin is an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: zuranolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Zuranolone is not a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), BCRP, OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: abiraterone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: In vitro studies show that at clinically relevant concentrations, abiraterone acetate and abiraterone are not substrates of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and that abiraterone acetate is an inhibitor of P-gp.

mentions.name: ado trastuzumab emtansine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, DM1 was a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that alectinib is not a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but M4 is a substrate of P-gp.

mentions.name: alvimopan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that alvimopan and its ‘metabolite’ are substrates for p-glycoprotein.

mentions.name: ambrisentan
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that ambrisentan is a substrate of the Organic Anion Transporting Polypeptides OATP1B1 and OATP1B3, and P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: aprepitant
mentions.excerpt: Aprepitant is unlikely to interact with drugs that are substrates for the P-glycoprotein transporter.

mentions.name: armodafinil
mentions.excerpt: An in vitro study demonstrated that armodafinil is a substrate of P-glycoprotein.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: Axitinib is an inhibitor of the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp) in vitro.

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggest that baricitinib is not an inhibitor of the transporters, P-glycoprotein (Pgp) or Organic Anion Transporting Polypeptide (OATP) 1B1.

mentions.name: belumosudil
mentions.excerpt: P-glycoprotein (P-gp) Substrates: Concomitant use of belumosudil increased dabigatran (P-gp substrate) C max and AUC by 2-fold.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Bendamustine Hydrochloride: Bendamustine hydrochloride is a substrate of P-glycoprotein and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: benznidazole
mentions.excerpt: Other mechanisms include higher efflux activity due to over expression of TcPGP 1 and TcPGP 2 genes that encode p-glycoprotein as well as TcABCG1 genes that encode ATP-binding cassette transporters.

mentions.name: bexagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Bexagliflozin is a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) .

mentions.name: binimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Binimetinib: Binimetinib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP).

mentions.name: bosutinib
mentions.excerpt: P-gp Substrates: No clinically significant differences in bosutinib pharmacokinetics were observed when used concomitantly with dabigatran etexilate mesylate (a P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate).

mentions.name: canagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Canagliflozin is also a substrate of drug transporters P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and MRP2.

mentions.name: carfilzomib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Carfilzomib: Carfilzomib is a P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate in vitro.

mentions.name: caspofungin
mentions.excerpt: Caspofungin is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein and is a poor substrate for CYP enzymes.

mentions.name: ceftobiprole medocaril
mentions.excerpt: Ceftobiprole is an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MRP2 and BSEP but is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, or MATE1.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Cladribine is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), equilibrative nucleoside transporter 1 (ENT1) and concentrative nucleoside transporter 3 (CNT3).

mentions.name: clobazam
mentions.excerpt: Clobazam and N-desmethylclobazam do not inhibit P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but are P-gp substrates.

mentions.name: cobimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Cobimetinib: Cobimetinib is a substrate of efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp), but is not a substrate of Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP), Organic Anion Transporting Polypeptide (OATP1B1 or OATP1B3) or Organic Cation Transporter (OCT1) in vitro.

mentions.name: crisaborole
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicate that under the condition of clinical use, crisaborole and metabolites 1 and 2 are not expected to cause clinically significant interactions with substrates of P-glycoprotein and organic anionic or cationic transporters.

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: Crizotinib is a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) in vitro.

mentions.name: dactinomycin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Published in vitro studies report that dactinomycin may be a substrate of the P-glycoprotein and OATP1B3 transporter systems.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , dalfampridine is not a substrate or an inhibitor for the p-glycoprotein transporter.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin 2 3 butanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin propanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin is a weak substrate of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) active transporter, and dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide is a substrate for the OAT3 active transporter.

mentions.name: daridorexant
mentions.excerpt: P-gp = P-glycoprotein;

mentions.name: darunavir
mentions.excerpt: In vivo data suggest that darunavir/ritonavir is an inhibitor of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporters.

mentions.name: darunavir ethanolate
mentions.excerpt: In vivo data suggest that PREZISTA/ritonavir is an inhibitor of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporters.

mentions.name: darunavir hydrate
mentions.excerpt: In vivo data suggest that darunavir/ritonavir is an inhibitor of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporters.

mentions.name: darunavir propylene glycolate
mentions.excerpt: In vivo data suggest that darunavir/ritonavir is an inhibitor of the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporters.

mentions.name: degarelix
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that degarelix is not a substrate, inducer or inhibitor of the CYP450 or p-glycoprotein transporter systems.

mentions.name: delgocitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Delgocitinib does not inhibit or induce cytochrome P450 enzymes or inhibit transporter systems such as P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), organic anion transporting proteins (OATP), organic anion transporters (OAT), organic cation transporters (OCT), or multidrug and toxin extrusion protein (MATE) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: desvenlafaxine
mentions.excerpt: Desvenlafaxine is not a substrate or an inhibitor for the P-glycoprotein (P-gp) transporter.

mentions.name: dimethyl
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies No potential drug interactions with dimethyl fumarate or MMF were identified in in vitro CYP inhibition and induction studies, or in P-glycoprotein studies.

mentions.name: donepezil
mentions.excerpt: An in vitro study showed that donepezil was not a substrate of P-glycoprotein.

mentions.name: doravirine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro assays, doravirine is not likely to be an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, P-glycoprotein, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: duvelisib
mentions.excerpt: Duvelisib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and BCRP in vitro.

mentions.name: eliglustat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , eliglustat is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp).

mentions.name: eltrombopag
mentions.excerpt: Eltrombopag is a substrate of BCRP, but is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: eltrombopag choline
mentions.excerpt: Eltrombopag is a substrate of BCRP, but is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: enfortumab vedotin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Transporter Systems: MMAE is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and is not an inhibitor of P-gp.

mentions.name: entrectinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Entrectinib on Transporters: Coadministration of a single 600 mg dose of ROZLYTREK capsule with digoxin [a sensitive P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrate] increased digoxin C max by 28% and AUC by 18%.

mentions.name: enzalutamide
mentions.excerpt: Coadministration of XTANDI 160 mg orally once daily with digoxin (a P-glycoprotein substrate) increased digoxin AUC by 33% and C max by 17%.

mentions.name: eplerenone
mentions.excerpt: Eplerenone is not a substrate or an inhibitor of P-Glycoprotein at clinically relevant doses.

mentions.name: ertapenem

mentions.excerpt: Drug Transporters: Neither tirbanibulin nor the metabolite KX2-5036 was a substrate of MDR1, BCRP, BSEP, MRP2, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: tivozanib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Tivozanib inhibits BCRP but does not inhibit P-gp, OCT1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1 or MATE2-K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: trametinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Trametinib: Trametinib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and BSEP.

mentions.name: trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Transporters on Trametinib: Trametinib is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and BSEP.

mentions.name: trastuzumab deruxtecan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : DXd is not an inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, BCRP, or BSEP.

mentions.name: treosulfan
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Treosulfan does not inhibit BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, or OCT2.

mentions.name: trifarotene
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : AKLIEF Cream is not expected to inhibit MATE, OATP, OAT, OCT, BCRP, P-gp, BSEP, or MRP.

mentions.name: trilaciclib
mentions.excerpt: Trilaciclib was a substrate of BCRP and P-gp, but not bile salt export pump (BSEP), MATE1, MATE-2K, or OCT.

mentions.name: trofinetide
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Trofinetide inhibits P-gp [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ] , BCRP, and BSEP.

mentions.name: tucatinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Tucatinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but is not a substrate of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: It is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MRP3, MRP4, OAT1, OAT3, or NTCP transporters, but is a weak inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OCT2 transporters.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Vamorolone is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATBP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vericiguat
mentions.excerpt: Vericiguat is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1/1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: Viltolarsen is not metabolized by CYP enzymes and is not a substrate of transporters BCRP, BSEP, MDR1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: vimseltinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter systems: Vimseltinib is a P-gp substrate but is not a substrate of BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Vortioxetine on PK of Other Drugs Figure 3 In Vitro Vortioxetine and its metabolite(s) are unlikely to inhibit the following CYP enzymes and transporter based on in vitro data: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: vosoritide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, vosoritide is considered unlikely to inhibit the human drug uptake or efflux transporters such as OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations and therefore, no effect of vosoritide is anticipated on concomitantly administered drugs that are substrates of these transporters.

mentions.name: voxelotor
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : voxelotor is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP.

mentions.name: zavegepant
mentions.excerpt: Zavegepant is not a substrate for BCRP, OATP1B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, BSEP, MRP2, MRP3, and MRP4.

mentions.name: ziftomenib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ziftomenib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not BSEP or MRP.

mentions.name: zuranolone
mentions.excerpt: Zuranolone does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2.

mentions.name: acetylcysteine
mentions.excerpt: A small fraction of an ingested dose is metabolized in the liver by isozyme CYP2E1 of the cytochrome P-450 mixed function oxidase enzyme system to form a reactive, potentially toxic, intermediate metabolite.

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , amisulpride was not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In vitro data: Apremilast is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 and not an inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: aprepitant
mentions.excerpt: No metabolism by CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1 was detected.

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: CYP450 enzymes: Aprocitentan inhibits CYP3A4 and all members of the CYP2C family, but did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: arformoterol
mentions.excerpt: Arformoterol did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A9/11 enzymes at >1,000-fold higher concentrations than the expected peak plasma concentrations following a therapeutic dose.

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Clinically significant interactions are not expected between atazanavir and substrates of CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2B6, CYP2A6, CYP1A2, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: avatrombopag
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP enzymes: Avatrombopag does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A, does not induce CYP1A, CYP2B6, CYP2C or CYP3A, and weakly induces CYP2C8 and CYP2C9.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicated that axitinib does not inhibit CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or UGT1A1 at therapeutic plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: azacitidine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: An in vitro study at azacitidine concentrations up to 100 mcM (IV C max = 10.6 mcM) in human liver microsomes indicated that azacitidine does not cause any inhibition of CYP isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP3A4, or CYP2E1 at clinically achievable concentrations.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: Baxdrostat was not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A5.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: benzgalantamine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Galantamine on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies In vitro studies show that galantamine did not inhibit the metabolic pathways catalyzed by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP4A, CYP2C, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Bexarotene on Other Drugs Bexarotene did not significantly inhibit the following enzymes in human liver microsomes: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: calcium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: capecitabine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Capecitabine and its metabolites (5’-DFUR, 5’-DFCR, fluorouracil, and FBAL) did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Cariprazine was also a weak inhibitor of CYP2C19, CYP2A6, and CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: cefiderocol
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Cefiderocol is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: The primary metabolic pathways are by glucuronidation via UGT2B7 and to a lesser extent by UGT2B4, and by oxidation via CYP2E1, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: cladribine
mentions.excerpt: Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Cladribine is not a substrate of cytochrome P450 enzymes and does not show significant potential to act as inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Drug Interactions In vitro studies in human liver microsomes have shown that colchicine is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4 activity.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies with human liver microsomes indicate that CYP2E1 was the major enzyme responsible for the 3-hydroxylation of dalfampridine.

mentions.name: delafloxacin
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Drug Metabolizing Enzymes Delafloxacin at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit the cytochrome P450 isoforms CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 in vitro in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: diazepam
mentions.excerpt: No inhibition was demonstrated in the presence of inhibitors selective for CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2, indicating that these enzymes are not significantly involved in metabolism of diazepam.

mentions.name: difamilast
mentions.excerpt: Difamilast is not expected to inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: dutasteride
mentions.excerpt: Dutasteride is not metabolized in vitro by human cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: efavirenz
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies, efavirenz did not inhibit CYP2E1 and inhibited CYP2D6 and CYP1A2 (Ki values 82-160 μM) only at concentrations well above those achieved clinically.

mentions.name: elamipretide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies CYP enzymes: Elamipretide does not inhibit CYP1A, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: eluxadoline
mentions.excerpt: Although CYP2E1 was slightly inhibited by eluxadoline (IC 50 of approximately 20 micromolar [11 mcg/mL]), clinically meaningful interactions are unlikely.

mentions.name: eribulin
mentions.excerpt: No significant inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 was detected with eribulin concentrations up to 5 μM in pooled human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: eslicarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: In in vitro studies in human liver microsomes, eslicarbazepine had no clinically relevant inhibitory effect on the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4, and only a moderate inhibitory effect on CYP2C19.

mentions.name: estazolam
mentions.excerpt: The ability of estazolam to induce or inhibit human enzyme systems The results from in vitro human liver microsomal studies suggest that at therapeutic concentrations, estazolam has no significant inhibitory effect on the major human cytochrome P450 enzyme activities (i.e., CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A).

mentions.name: estetrol
mentions.excerpt: E4 is unlikely to induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP3A4 or inhibit CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A9, UGT2B7, drug transporters P-pg, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1 and MATE2-K or at clinically relevant dose.

mentions.name: eszopiclone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that CYP3A4 and CYP2E1 enzymes are involved in the metabolism of eszopiclone.

mentions.name: fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibrate and fenofibric acid are not inhibitors of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fenofibric acid
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies using human liver microsomes indicate that fenofibric acid is not an inhibitor of cytochrome (CYP) P450 isoforms CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP1A2.

mentions.name: fosamprenavir
mentions.excerpt: Amprenavir does not inhibit CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or uridine glucuronosyltransferase (UDPGT).

mentions.name: fosaprepitant dimeglumine
mentions.excerpt: No metabolism by CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1 was detected.

mentions.name: gabapentin enacarbil
mentions.excerpt: Neither gabapentin enacarbil nor gabapentin are substrates, inhibitors, or inducers of the major cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: galantamine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Galantamine on Other Drugs: • In Vitro Studies : In vitro studies show that galantamine did not inhibit the metabolic pathways catalyzed by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP4A, CYP2C, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: iberdomide
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Iberdomide does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: icotrokinra
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Icotrokinra does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: iloperidone
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Based on the in vitro data, iloperidone is not a substrate for CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP2E1 enzymes.

mentions.name: lemborexant
mentions.excerpt: Lemborexant and M10 do not inhibit other CYP isoforms (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1) or transporters (P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K).

mentions.name: lenvatinib
mentions.excerpt: Lenvatinib does not inhibit CYP2A6 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: letermovir
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, the metabolism of letermovir is not mediated by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C18, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP4A11, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A7, UGT1A8, UGT1A9, UGT1A10, UGT2B4, UGT2B7, UGT2B15, or UGT2B17.

mentions.name: levomilnacipran
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that levomilnacipran is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: lonafarnib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Lonafarnib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A and to a lesser extent by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: loncastuximab tesirine lpyl
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: SG3199 does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 at clinically relevant unconjugated SG3199 concentrations.

mentions.name: lurasidone
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, lurasidone hydrochloride is not a substrate of CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP4A11, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1 enzymes.

mentions.name: lurbinectedin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes : Lurbinectedin is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: maribavir
mentions.excerpt: At clinically relevant concentrations, clinically significant interactions are not expected when LIVTENCITY is coadministered with substrates of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, CYP2D6, CYP3A4; uridine diphosphate-glucuronosyltransferase (UGT)1A1, UGT1A4, UGT1A6, UGT1A9, UGT2B7;

mentions.name: mavorixafor
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes: Mavorixafor is a substrate of CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP3A5, and CYP2C19, but is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and CYP4A11.

mentions.name: metaxalone
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism: Metaxalone is primarily metabolized by CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 and, to a lesser extent, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, and CYP2C19.

mentions.name: methylnaltrexone
mentions.excerpt: In addition, methylnaltrexone did not induce CYP2E1.

mentions.name: midostaurin
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Effect of Midostaurin on CYP Enzymes Midostaurin inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP2E1;

mentions.name: mifepristone
mentions.excerpt: Drug-Drug Interactions In Vitro Assessment of Drug Interactions In vitro studies indicate a potential for CYP-mediated drug interactions by mifepristone and/or its metabolites with substrates of CYP2A6, CYP2C8/2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: miglustat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Miglustat does not inhibit the metabolism of various substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes including, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A11 in vitro ; consequently, significant interactions via inhibition of these enzymes are unlikely with drugs that are substrates of cytochrome P450 enzymes.

mentions.name: milnacipran
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies: In general, milnacipran, at concentrations that were at least 25 times those attained in clinical trials, did not inhibit human CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce human CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP3A4/5 enzyme systems, indicating a low potential of interactions with drugs metabolized by these enzymes.

mentions.name: mirabegron
mentions.excerpt: Mirabegron is unlikely to inhibit the metabolism of co-administered drugs metabolized by the following cytochrome P450 enzymes: CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 because mirabegron did not inhibit the activity of these enzymes at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: naldemedine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Naldemedine on Other Drugs In in vitro studies at clinically relevant concentrations, naldemedine did not inhibit the major CYP enzymes (including CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A11 isozymes) and is not an inhibitor of transporters (including OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, BCRP, or P-gp).

mentions.name: nelfinavir
mentions.excerpt: The potential ability of nelfinavir to inhibit the major human cytochrome P450 enzymes (CYP3A, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, CYP1A2 and CYP2E1) has been investigated in vitro .

mentions.name: nepafenac
mentions.excerpt: Nepafenac at concentrations up to 3000 ng/mL and amfenac at concentrations up to 1000 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of six specific marker substrates of cytochrome P450 (CYP) isozymes (CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Nitisinone is a moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9, and a weak inducer of CYP2E1 (Table 5).

mentions.name: olopatadine
mentions.excerpt: Olopatadine at concentrations up to 33,900 ng/mL did not inhibit the in vitro metabolism of specific substrates for CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: oxcarbazepine
mentions.excerpt: Results demonstrate that oxcarbazepine and its pharmacologically active 10-monohydroxy metabolite (MHD) have little or no capacity to function as inhibitors for most of the human cytochrome P450 enzymes evaluated (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP4A9 and CYP4A11) with the exception of CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: palonosetron
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro studies indicated that palonosetron is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 (CYP2C19 was not investigated) nor does it induce the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: paricalcitol
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions An in vitro study indicates that paricalcitol is neither an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A nor an inducer of CYP2B6, CYP2C9 or CYP3A.

mentions.name: perampanel
mentions.excerpt: Perampanel did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, UGT1A4, and UGT1A6 up to a concentration of 30 µmol/L.

mentions.name: phenobarbital
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Published literature reports that phenobarbital is primarily metabolized by CYP2C9 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and UGTs.

mentions.name: potassium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: pramipexole
mentions.excerpt: Pramipexole does not inhibit CYP enzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: quinine sulphate
mentions.excerpt: Depending on the in vitro experimental conditions, other enzymes, including CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1 were shown to have some role in the metabolism of quinine.

mentions.name: rasagiline
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies showed that rasagiline at a concentration of 1 mcg/mL (equivalent to a level that is 160 times the average C max ~ 5.9 to 8.5 ng/mL in Parkinson’s disease patients after 1 mg rasagiline multiple dosing) did not inhibit cytochrome P450 isoenzymes, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4 and CYP4A.

mentions.name: revumenib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: Revumenib inhibits CYP3A4, but does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: ribociclib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro Studies Effect of Ribociclib on CYP Enzymes: In vitro , ribociclib was a reversible inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4/5 and a time-dependent inhibitor of CYP3A4/5, at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: rivastigmine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, no pharmacokinetic drug interactions with drugs metabolized by the following isoenzyme systems are expected: CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP3A4/5, CYP2E1, CYP2C9, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, or CYP2B6.

mentions.name: rolapitant
mentions.excerpt: Substrates for other CYP enzymes In vitro studies suggest that rolapitant is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2 and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: romidepsin
mentions.excerpt: At therapeutic concentrations, romidepsin did not competitively inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4 in vitro .

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: ropeginterferon alfa 2b njft
mentions.excerpt: BESREMi did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 in human liver microsomes.

mentions.name: sarecycline
mentions.excerpt: Sarecycline does not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5 isozymes, and does not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, or BCRP.

mentions.name: sebetralstat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies CYP450 Enzymes : Sebetralstat is a substrate of CYP3A4 and CYP2C8, and is not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: selumetinib
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Selumetinib is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19, CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2E1, and CYP3A5.

mentions.name: sevabertinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro studies CYP450 Enzymes: Sevabertinib inhibits CYP1A1 and CYP2C8 but does not inhibit CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, CYP2C19, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: silodosin
mentions.excerpt: Other Metabolic Enzymes and Transporters In vitro studies indicated that silodosin administration is not likely to inhibit the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4 or induce the activity of CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP3A4, and P-gp.

mentions.name: sodium oxybate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions Studies Studies in vitro with pooled human liver microsomes indicate that sodium oxybate does not significantly inhibit the activities of the human isoenzymes CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A up to the concentration of 3 mM (378 mcg/mL), a level considerably higher than levels achieved with recommended doses.

mentions.name: sunitinib
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies In vitro studies in human hepatocytes and microsomes indicated that sunitinib and the primary active metabolite do not induce CYP1A2, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4/5, or inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, and CYP4A9/11 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tasimelteon
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies No potential drug interactions were identified in in vitro studies with CYP inducers or inhibitors of CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9/2C19, CYP2E1, CYP2D6, and transporters including P-glycoprotein, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, and OAT3.

mentions.name: tecovirimat
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically CYP Enzymes: Tecovirimat is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4, and is not an inducer of CYP1A2.

mentions.name: tenofovir disoproxil
mentions.excerpt: Assessment of Drug Interactions At concentrations substantially higher (~300-fold) than those observed in vivo, tenofovir did not inhibit in vitro drug metabolism mediated by any of the following human CYP isoforms: CYP3A4, CYP2D6, CYP2C9, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: tepotinib
mentions.excerpt: Tepotinib and M506 do not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1, and do not induce CYP1A2 or 2B6 at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: tetrabenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies do not suggest that tetrabenazine, α-HTBZ, β-HTBZ or 9‑ desmethyl-β-DHTBZ are likely to result in clinically significant inhibition of CYP2D6, CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A.

mentions.name: ticagrelor
mentions.excerpt: Ticagrelor and AR-C124910XX were shown to have no inhibitory effect on human CYP1A2, CYP2C19, and CYP2E1 activity.

mentions.name: tinidazole
mentions.excerpt: In an in vitro metabolic drug interaction study, tinidazole concentrations of up to 75 µg/mL did not inhibit the enzyme activities of CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: uridine triacetate
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In vitro enzyme inhibition data did not reveal meaningful inhibitory effects of uridine triacetate or uridine on CYP3A4, CYP1A2, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: viltolarsen
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Drug Interaction Studies Viltolarsen did not inhibit CYP3A4/5, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, UGT1A1, or UGT2B7.

mentions.name: vortioxetine
mentions.excerpt: Impact of Vortioxetine on PK of Other Drugs Figure 3 In Vitro Vortioxetine and its metabolite(s) are unlikely to inhibit the following CYP enzymes and transporter based on in vitro data: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: abaloparatide
mentions.excerpt: Abaloparatide is not a substrate of the renal transporters OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: abrocitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Abrocitinib is an inhibitor of organic cation transporter (OCT)1 but is not an inhibitor of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1/1B3, bile salt export pump (BSEP), OAT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: alectinib
mentions.excerpt: Alectinib did not inhibit OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2 transport activity in vitro.

mentions.name: amantadine
mentions.excerpt: Amantadine was a poor substrate of the cationic transporters OCT2 and MATE1.

mentions.name: baricitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data indicate baricitinib does inhibit organic anionic transporter (OAT) 1, OAT2, OAT3, organic cationic transporter (OCT) 1, OCT2, OATP1B3, Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP) and Multidrug and Toxic Extrusion Protein (MATE) 1 and MATE2-K, but clinically meaningful changes in the pharmacokinetics of drugs that are substrates for these transporters are unlikely.

mentions.name: bexagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Bexagliflozin is not expected to inhibit drug transporters including breast cancer resistance protein (BRCP), bile salt export pump (BSEP), organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3), anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), and multidrug and toxin extrusion transporters (MATE1, MATE2-K) at clinically relevant plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: bosutinib
mentions.excerpt: I n Vitro Studies Transporters Systems: Bosutinib inhibits breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP)but, does not inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, organic cation transporter (OCT)1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: brigatinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Transporters on Brigatinib: Brigatinib is not a substrate of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP1B1, OATP1B3), organic anion transporter (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporter (OCT1, OCT2), multidrug and toxin extrusion protein (MATE1, MATE2K), or bile salt export pump (BSEP).

mentions.name: capivasertib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Capivasertib inhibits BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, and OCT2.

mentions.name: carglumic acid
mentions.excerpt: Carglumic acid is not a substrate of MDR1, BCRP, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: ceftobiprole medocaril
mentions.excerpt: Ceftobiprole is an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MRP2 and BSEP but is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, or MATE1.

mentions.name: ceritinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Ceritinib on Transporters: Based on in vitro data, ceritinib is unlikely to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, or OCT2 at clinical concentrations.

mentions.name: chenodiol
mentions.excerpt: The glyco- and tauro- conjugates of chenodiol are high affinity substrates for BSEP, and in vitro studies suggest that chenodiol may inhibit OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 at the recommended dose of 250 mg TID (clinical significance unknown), but chenodiol and its glyco- and tauro- conjugates are not predicted to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP2B1, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: cobimetinib
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Cobimetinib on Transporters: In vitro data suggest that cobimetinib at clinically relevant concentrations does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: crizotinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Crizotinib inhibits P-gp, organic cation transporter (OCT) 1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: dabrafenib
mentions.excerpt: Dabrafenib and desmethyl-dabrafenib are inhibitors of OCT2 and BCRP in vitro.

mentions.name: dacomitinib
mentions.excerpt: Dacomitinib does not inhibit organic anion transporters (OAT)1 and OAT3, OCT2, organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATP)1B1, and OATP1B3.

mentions.name: dalfampridine
mentions.excerpt: Cimetidine In a single-dose clinical study, 23 healthy volunteers took the OCT2 inhibitor cimetidine 400 mg every 6 hours concurrently with dalfampridine 10 mg single dose.

mentions.name: danicopan
mentions.excerpt: Danicopan is an inhibitor of BCRP and P-gp, but not an inhibitor of transporters OATP1B1, OATP1B3, Organic Anion Transporter (OAT)1, OAT3, Organic Cation Transporter 2 (OCT2), or Multidrug And Toxin Extrusion 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2-K).

mentions.name: dapagliflozin 2 3 butanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin or dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide did not meaningfully inhibit P-gp, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 active transporters.

mentions.name: dapagliflozin propanediol
mentions.excerpt: Dapagliflozin or dapagliflozin 3-O-glucuronide did not meaningfully inhibit P-gp, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 active transporters.

mentions.name: deoxycholic acid
mentions.excerpt: Deoxycholic acid does not inhibit the following transporters: P-gp, BCRP, MRP4, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP2B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, NTCP, and ASBT.

mentions.name: doravirine
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro assays, doravirine is not likely to be an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, P-glycoprotein, BSEP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: dronedarone
mentions.excerpt: Dronedarone inhibits in vivo the tubular secretion of creatinine a substrate of the organic cation transporter (OCT2) [see Warnings and Precautions (5.9) ] .

mentions.name: duvelisib
mentions.excerpt: Duvelisib does not inhibit OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BCRP, or P-gp.

mentions.name: edaravone
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies demonstrated that, at the recommended dosage, edaravone and its metabolites are not expected to significantly inhibit CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A), conjugating enzymes UGT1A1 and UGT2B7, or other transporters (P-gp, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K) in humans.

mentions.name: edoxaban
mentions.excerpt: In vitro data also indicate that edoxaban does not inhibit the following transporters at clinically relevant concentrations: P-gp, the organic anion transporters OAT1 or OAT3; the organic cation transporters OCT1 or OCT2; or the organic ion transporting polypeptides OATP1B1 or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: erdafitinib
mentions.excerpt: OCT2 Substrates : No clinically meaningful effect on the exposure of metformin (an OCT2 substrate) was observed following coadministration with BALVERSA.

mentions.name: ertugliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Ertugliflozin is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters and is not a substrate of organic anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3).

mentions.name: ertugliflozin pidolate
mentions.excerpt: Ertugliflozin is a substrate of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) and breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP) transporters and is not a substrate of organic anion transporters (OAT1, OAT3), organic cation transporters (OCT1, OCT2), or organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATP1B1, OATP1B3).

mentions.name: etelcalcetide
mentions.excerpt: Etelcalcetide was also not an inhibitor of common transporter proteins (Pgp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, or bile salt export pump [BSEP]).

mentions.name: fostamatinib
mentions.excerpt: R406 is a substrate of P-gp but not of other major transporters (OAT1/3, OCT2, OATP1B1/3, MRP2, and BCRP).

mentions.name: fostemsavir
mentions.excerpt: P-gp; multidrug resistance protein (MRP)2; bile salt export pump (BSEP); sodium taurocholate co-transporting polypeptide (NTCP); multidrug and toxin extrusion protein (MATE)1/2K; organic anion transporters (OAT)1 and OAT3; organic cation transporters (OCT)1 and OCT2 based on in vitro and clinical drug interaction results ( Table 6 ).

mentions.name: gabapentin enacarbil
mentions.excerpt: Gabapentin renal excretion is believed to involve a component of active secretion via an organic cation transporter (OCT2) present in the kidney.

mentions.name: gepirone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : EXXUA and its metabolites are unlikely to cause clinically significant inhibition of the following transporters based on in vitro data: P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K.

mentions.name: gepotidacin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, gepotidacin is not a substrate of any of the hepatic organic anion transporting polypeptides (OATPs) 1B1, 1B3, and 2B1, organic anion transporters (OATs) OAT1, OAT2 and OAT3, organic cation transporters (OCTs) OCT2 and OCT3.

mentions.name: givinostat
mentions.excerpt: In Vivo A weak inhibition of the renal uptake transporter OCT2 by givinostat was seen in clinical trials by creatinine (OCT2 substate) measurements [see Drug Interactions (7.1) ] .

mentions.name: idelalisib
mentions.excerpt: Idelalisib is not a substrate of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: isavuconazonium
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Isavuconazole is an inhibitor of P-gp-, BCRP- and OCT2.

mentions.name: ivosidenib
mentions.excerpt: Ivosidenib does not inhibit BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, and OCT2.

mentions.name: ixazomib
mentions.excerpt: Ixazomib is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: lamivudine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Other Agents on the Pharmacokinetics of Lamivudine Lamivudine is a substrate of MATE1, MATE2-K, and OCT2 in vitro.

mentions.name: lenalidomide
mentions.excerpt: Lenalidomide is not an inhibitor of P-gp, bile salt export pump (BSEP), BCRP, MRP2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or OCT2.

mentions.name: levoketoconazole
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Levoketoconazole is a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, as well as an inhibitor of the drug transporters P-gp, OCT2, and MATE1 in vivo.

mentions.name: lumateperone
mentions.excerpt: It showed little to no inhibition of OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B3, or OATP1B1.

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 dotatate
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: lutetium lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: Vipivotide tetraxetan is not a substrate of BCRP, P-gp, MATE1, MATE2-K, OAT1, OAT3 or OCT2.

mentions.name: lutetium oxodotreotide lu 177
mentions.excerpt: Transporters: The non-radioactive lutetium Lu 175 dotatate is not an inhibitor of P-glycoprotein, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3 in vitro.

mentions.name: maralixibat
mentions.excerpt: In vitro, maralixibat did not inhibit the transporters MDR1 (P-gp), BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, PEPT1, OCT1, OCT2, OCT3, OCTN1, OCTN2, MRP2, MATE1, or MATE2-K at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: methylene blue
mentions.excerpt: Methylene Blue is a substrate for the P-glycoprotein (P-gp, ABCB1) transporter, but not for BCRP or OCT2 in vitro .

mentions.name: migalastat
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro Studies Migalastat is not a known inhibitor or inducer of cytochrome P450 (CYP450) enzymes, nor is it an inhibitor of BCRP, MDR1, P‑glycoprotein (P‑gp), or BSEP human efflux transporters, or OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2‑K human uptake transporters.

mentions.name: mirabegron
mentions.excerpt: Mirabegron is a substrate for CYP3A4, CYP2D6, butyrylcholinesterase, UGT, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein (P-gp), and the influx organic cation transporters (OCT) OCT1, OCT2, and OCT3.

mentions.name: nifurtimox
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Nifurtimox is not a substrate or inhibitor of P-glycoprotein (P-gp) or breast cancer resistant protein (BCRP), and is not an inhibitor of organic anion transporting polypeptide (OATPs), multidrug and toxin extrusion (MATE) proteins (MATE1/MATE2-K), organic anion transporter 1/3 (OAT1/OAT3), or organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2).

mentions.name: nitisinone
mentions.excerpt: Nitisinone does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3 and OCT2-mediated transports at therapeutically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: odevixibat
mentions.excerpt: BCRP; organic anion transporter polypeptide 1B1 and 1B3(OATP1B1 and OATP1B3); organic anion transporter (OAT)1, OAT3; organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), multidrug and toxin extrusion transporter 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2K).

mentions.name: olaparib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters : Olaparib is an inhibitor of BCRP, OATP1B1, OCT1, OCT2, OAT3, MATE1, and MATE2K.

mentions.name: olezarsen
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Olezarsen is not a substrate or inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP.

mentions.name: osimertinib
mentions.excerpt: Osimertinib is an inhibitor of BCRP and does not inhibit OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2K and OCT2.

mentions.name: pafolacianine
mentions.excerpt: Pafolacianine is not an inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, P-gp, or BCRP 12.1 Mechanism of Action Pafolacianine binds to alpha and beta folate receptors (FR) on cells, is internalized via receptor-mediated endocytosis, and accumulates intracellularly.

mentions.name: pemigatinib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in glucose levels were observed when metformin (OCT2/MATE1 substrate) was co-administered with pemigatinib.

mentions.name: pivmecillinam
mentions.excerpt: Mecillinam does not inhibit breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), P-glycoprotein (PgP), MATE1, MATE2-K, organic anion transporter-1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptides -1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1 B1/B3), and organic cation transporter-2 (OCT2) drug transporters.

mentions.name: plozasiran
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Plozasiran is not a substrate or an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: pralatrexate
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Pralatrexate is a substrate for BCRP, MRP2, MRP3, and OATP1B3, but is not a substrate of P-gp, OATP1B1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3.

mentions.name: prucalopride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Based on in vitro study results, the potential for prucalopride to inhibit CYP enzymes (1A2, 2A6, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 2E1, and 3A4) and transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, MATE2-K, BSEP, and MRP2 transporters) or induce CYP enzymes (1A2, 2B6, and 3A4) is low at the clinical concentration.

mentions.name: remdesivir
mentions.excerpt: GS-704277 and GS-441524 are not substrates for OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2k.

mentions.name: remimazolam
mentions.excerpt: No relevant inhibition of human drug transporters (OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, BCRP) was seen with BYFAVO or CNS7054.

mentions.name: rilzabrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporters : Rilzabrutinib is a substrate of P-gp and BCRP, but not a substrate for OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, or BSEP.

mentions.name: rimegepant
mentions.excerpt: Considering its low renal clearance, rimegepant was not evaluated as a substrate of the OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: risdiplam
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies have shown that risdiplam and its major metabolite are not significant inhibitors of human MDR1, organic anion-transporting polypeptide (OATP) 1B1, OATP1B3, organic anion transporter 1 and 3 (OAT 1 and 3) transporters, and human organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: rolapitant
mentions.excerpt: Substrates for other transporters In vitro studies suggest that oral rolapitant is unlikely to inhibit organic anion transporting polypeptides 1B1 and 1B3 (OATP1B1 and OATP1B3), organic anion transporters 1 and 3 (OAT1 and OAT3), organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2), and multidrug and toxin extrusion proteins 1 and 2K (MATE1 and MATE2K) in vivo .

mentions.name: ruxolitinib
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems: Ruxolitinib is not expected to inhibit P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, OCT2, OAT1, or OAT3 transporter systems following topical application.

mentions.name: safinamide
mentions.excerpt: Safinamide and its metabolites did not inhibit P-gp or other transporters OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, BSEP, OAT1/3/4.

mentions.name: sapropterin
mentions.excerpt: In vitro sapropterin did not inhibit OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2-K transporters.

mentions.name: sofpironium
mentions.excerpt: C max (ng/mL) 1.30 (3.16) AUC 0-t (ng∙hr/mL) 14.6 (35.0) t max (hr) 4.0 (0.9, 23.1) Drug Interaction Studies No clinically significant differences in sofpironium pharmacokinetics were observed when used concomitantly with inhibitors of CYP3A4, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2-K.

mentions.name: solriamfetol
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems : Solriamfetol is a low-avidity substrate of OCT2, MATE1, OCTN1, and OCTN2.

mentions.name: sonidegib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies suggested that sonidegib inhibits BCRP, but not P-glycoprotein, MRP2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1 or OCT2.

mentions.name: sotagliflozin
mentions.excerpt: Sotagliflozin is a substrate of the human uptake transporters organic anion transporter (OAT)3, organic-anion-transporting polypeptides (OATP)1B1, and OATP1B3, but not OAT1 and organic cation transporter 2 (OCT2).

mentions.name: sparsentan
mentions.excerpt: In addition, sparsentan had no clinically significant effect on serum creatinine levels (an endogenous biomarker of OAT2, OCT2, MATE1, and MATE2K) or on 6β‑hydroxycortisol (an endogenous biomarker of OAT3).

mentions.name: suvorexant
mentions.excerpt: In addition, no clinically meaningful inhibition of OATP1B1, BCRP and OCT2 transporters is anticipated.

mentions.name: tafenoquine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Where Drug Interaction Potential Was Not Further Evaluated Clinically Tafenoquine inhibited metformin transport via human OCT2, MATE1 and MATE2-K transporters [see Drug Interactions ( 7 )] .

mentions.name: tedizolid
mentions.excerpt: No clinically relevant interactions are expected to occur with drug efflux transporter P-gp and drug uptake transporters OAT1, OAT3, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OCT1, and OCT2 based on in vitro studies.

mentions.name: telotristat ethyl
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, in vivo drug interaction potential via inhibition of organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1), OCT2, organic anion transporter 1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, or bile salt export pump (BSEP) transporters by telotristat ethyl and telotristat is low at the recommended dosage.

mentions.name: telotristat etiprate
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, in vivo drug interaction potential via inhibition of organic cation transporter 1 (OCT1), OCT2, organic anion transporter 1 (OAT1), OAT3, organic anion transporting polypeptide 1B1 (OATP1B1), OATP1B3, or bile salt export pump (BSEP) transporters by telotristat ethyl and telotristat is low at the recommended dosage.

mentions.name: trofinetide
mentions.excerpt: Trofinetide inhibits OAT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, and MATE2-K, but is not expected to result in clinically significant drug interactions.

mentions.name: ubrogepant
mentions.excerpt: It is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, MRP3, MRP4, OAT1, OAT3, or NTCP transporters, but is a weak inhibitor of OATP1B1, OATP1B3, and OCT2 transporters.

mentions.name: valbenazine
mentions.excerpt: The results of in vitro studies suggest that valbenazine and [+]-α-HTBZ are unlikely to inhibit the transporters (BCRP, OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3) at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vamorolone
mentions.excerpt: Transporter Systems Vamorolone is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATBP1B3, OCT2, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, or BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations.

mentions.name: vandetanib
mentions.excerpt: Vandetanib inhibits the uptake of the selective OCT2 marker substrate 14 C-creatinine by HEK-OCT2 cells, with a mean IC 50 of 2.1 μg/mL.

mentions.name: varenicline
mentions.excerpt: Renal elimination of varenicline is primarily through glomerular filtration along with active tubular secretion possibly via the organic cation transporter, OCT2.

mentions.name: vericiguat
mentions.excerpt: Vericiguat is not an inhibitor of P-gp, BCRP, BSEP, OATP1B1/1B3, OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, MATE1, or MATE2K.

mentions.name: vosoritide
mentions.excerpt: Based on in vitro studies, vosoritide is considered unlikely to inhibit the human drug uptake or efflux transporters such as OAT1, OAT3, OCT1, OCT2, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, MATE1, MATE2-K, BCRP, P-gp, and BSEP at clinically relevant concentrations and therefore, no effect of vosoritide is anticipated on concomitantly administered drugs that are substrates of these transporters.

mentions.name: zanubrutinib
mentions.excerpt: Zanubrutinib is not a substrate or inhibitor of OAT1, OAT3, OCT2, OATP1B1, or OATP1B3.

mentions.name: zilucoplan
mentions.excerpt: Based on the results from in vitro drug interaction testing, clinically relevant interactions between zilucoplan and substrates of CYP enzymes (1A2, 2B6, 2C8, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A, and 4F), uridine diphosphoglucuronosyl transferases (UGTs; 1A1, 1A3, 1A4, 1A6, 1A9, 2B7, and 2B15), and transporters (P-gp, BCRP, OATP1B1, OATP1B3, OAT1, OAT3, MATE1, MATE2-K, OCT1, and OCT2) is unlikely.

mentions.name: zongertinib
mentions.excerpt: No clinically significant differences in the pharmacokinetics of the following were observed when used concomitantly with zongertinib: midazolam (a CYP3A substrate), dabigatran (a P-gp substrate), metformin (a OCT2 and MATE1/2-K substrate), or repaglinide (a sensitive CYP2C8 substrate).

mentions.name: amisulpride
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450-Related Metabolism In vitro , amisulpride did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP3A4, or induce CYP1A2, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, or CYP3A4.

mentions.name: apremilast
mentions.excerpt: In vitro , CYP metabolism of apremilast is primarily mediated by CYP3A4, with minor contributions from CYP1A2 and CYP2A6.

mentions.name: aprocitentan
mentions.excerpt: CYP450 enzymes: Aprocitentan inhibits CYP3A4 and all members of the CYP2C family, but did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2D6, and CYP2E1.

mentions.name: arformoterol
mentions.excerpt: Arformoterol did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9/10, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or CYP4A9/11 enzymes at >1,000-fold higher concentrations than the expected peak plasma concentrations following a therapeutic dose.

mentions.name: atazanavir
mentions.excerpt: Clinically significant interactions are not expected between atazanavir and substrates of CYP2C19, CYP2C9, CYP2D6, CYP2B6, CYP2A6, CYP1A2, or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: axitinib
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies indicated that axitinib does not inhibit CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, CYP3A4/5, or UGT1A1 at therapeutic plasma concentrations.

mentions.name: baxdrostat
mentions.excerpt: Baxdrostat was not a substrate of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, or CYP3A5.

mentions.name: belinostat
mentions.excerpt: Belinostat also undergoes hepatic metabolism by CYP2A6, CYP2C9, and CYP3A4 enzymes.

mentions.name: bendamustine
mentions.excerpt: Bendamustine hydrochloride did not induce metabolism of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2E1, or CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: benzgalantamine
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Galantamine on Other Drugs In Vitro Studies In vitro studies show that galantamine did not inhibit the metabolic pathways catalyzed by CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP4A, CYP2C, CYP2D6 or CYP2E1.

mentions.name: bexarotene
mentions.excerpt: Effect of Bexarotene on Other Drugs Bexarotene did not significantly inhibit the following enzymes in human liver microsomes: CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: bulevirtide gmod
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies Effect of Bulevirtide on Other Drugs Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes: In vitro studies have shown, bulevirtide is not an inhibitor of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cabozantinib
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: cabozantinib s malate
mentions.excerpt: Inhibition of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C19, CYP2D6 and CYP2E1 had no effect on cabozantinib metabolite formation.

mentions.name: capecitabine
mentions.excerpt: In Vitro Studies Cytochrome P450 (CYP) Enzymes : Capecitabine and its metabolites (5’-DFUR, 5’-DFCR, fluorouracil, and FBAL) did not inhibit CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP3A4, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, or CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: cariprazine
mentions.excerpt: Cariprazine was also a weak inhibitor of CYP2C19, CYP2A6, and CYP2E1 in vitro.

mentions.name: ceftaroline fosamil
mentions.excerpt: In vitro studies in human liver microsomes indicate that ceftaroline does not inhibit the major cytochrome P450 isoenzymes CYP1A1, CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 and CYP3A4.

mentions.name: cenobamate
mentions.excerpt: The primary metabolic pathways are by glucuronidation via UGT2B7 and to a lesser extent by UGT2B4, and by oxidation via CYP2E1, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, and to a lesser extent by CYP2C19 and CYP3A4/5.

mentions.name: choline fenofibrate
mentions.excerpt: It is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8, CYP2C19, and CYP2A6, and mild-to-moderate inhibitor of CYP2C9 at therapeutic concentrations.

mentions.name: colchiceine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interactions In Vitro Drug Interactions In vitro studies in human liver microsomes have shown that colchicine is not an inhibitor or inducer of CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1 or CYP3A4 activity.

mentions.name: cyclophosphamide
mentions.excerpt: Metabolism Cyclophosphamide is metabolized by cytochrome P450s including CYP2A6, 2B6, 3A, 2C9, and 2C19.

mentions.name: cysteamine
mentions.excerpt: Drug Interaction Studies An in vitro study indicates cysteamine bitartrate is not an inhibitor of CYP enzymes (CYP1A2, CYP2A6, CYP2B6, CYP2C8, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, CYP2D6, CYP2E1, and CYP3A4).

mentions.name: dalfampridine
